name: Jade
description_html:
Meet Jade 💚

If you’re looking for a big love bug with an even bigger heart, Jade is your girl.

Jade is an 9 year old pitbull who completely redefines what “senior” means. With a medium energy level more like a 5-7 year old dog, she enjoys a nice walk or a burst of play- but her true specialty? Being the ultimate cuddle companion. She is incredibly sweet, affectionate, and happiest when she’s snuggled up next to her people.

Jade is fully house trained, does well being home alone for extended periods, and is respectful of household rules (she’ll happily get off the furniture when asked—though she’d love an invite back up for snuggles!). She also loves car rides and is always ready to be your co-pilot.

A few of Jade’s favorite things:

🐾 Snacks (her love language!)

🐾 Cozy naps

🐾 Sunbathing

🐾 Walks & car rides

Jade adores kids and brings a fun, playful energy—but due to her size and enthusiasm, she may do best with older children who won’t be easily knocked over during playtime.

Jade would thrive as the only pet in the home, as she prefers to have all the love and attention to herself. She can be reactive to other dogs on walks, so a home with a backyard or space to stretch her legs would set her up for success.

On walks, Jade really shines once she knows and trusts her person. With her owner, she can sit and walk nicely at a heel. With new people, she may test boundaries and can pull (she is strong!), but she improves as that relationship builds.

Like many big, lovable goofballs, Jade can get a little overexcited at times and may try to hump when she’s extra happy but she responds well to redirection and structure. She is also a quiet dog & rarely barks.

The best part? Jade has no adoption fee and no known medical needs—just a heart full of love ready to give.

If you’re looking for a loyal, affectionate companion who will fill your home with warmth (and take up most of your couch—and your sunny spots), Jade might just be your perfect match. 💛

name: Cleo
description_html:
Cleo is a beautiful, sweet, healthy 10-month old Mastiff mix who is a loyal companion and playful friend. She is young enough to easily acclimate to a new home and owner. She knows basic commands and is crate trained and house trained. Cleo loves to go on walks, play tug of war, and chase (but never harm) lizards. She is a strong and healthy girl. When playing, she sometimes nips, but she stops when corrected. She responds to "sit," lay down," "walk," "food," "no bite," and "lizards."


Cleo loves to be around other dogs. With humans, she can be shy at first and needs slow introductions. Once she gets familiar with someone, though, she is eager to greet. She is best suited in a home without young kids due to her quick-to-startle nature. She does well with two walks a day (morning and evening). Having a backyard is great for her so she can roam and get some young dog energy out. She is pretty calm and naps during the day.


Cleo would benefit from an experienced dog owner who will enjoy helping her grow and appreciate her playful and protective nature.


Potty trained: yes

Crate trained: yes

Car rides: she enjoys them

Baths: she likes a bath

Good with dogs: yes - very excited to meet and play with dogs

Good with cats: untested

Good with kids: best suited in a home without kids

Health: good.

Vaccines: she is up to date on vaccines

Heart worm: she is negative for heart worm

Behavior: she can be hesitant around new people and situations. If a dog is present, though, she is much more comfortable. She has no aggression or bite history.

name: Kermit
description_html:
Kermit is a very good boy who walks well on leash and will "sit" & "shake" for a treat. He is housetrained and crate trained, as well. Kermit is affectionate with people and loves cuddles!


Kermit is a sweet, calm and gentle boy. He’s also one of the most housetrained dogs at the shelter. He does well meeting new people and he seems comfortable being around other dogs. He has lived with two different dogs in foster matching their vibes (one younger more playful and the other a senior professional relaxer!). Kermit has the potential to live with another medium/large dog and would require a meet and greet with the behavior team at AAS.


Kermit has done well on outings and in new environments. He takes it all in but will also sit at your feet while you enjoy a coffee in the sunshine. He is also turning out to be a great running companion!


Kermit loves to get out and explore, walking and sniffing like a champion. He also happily rides in the car, windows down if possible for the best sniffs!

He likes to play with toys and will play ball and with ropes toys especially. As well as being a great adventure buddy Kermit loves to relax and chill at home. A wonderful couch buddy!

name: Cranberry
description_html: The heart on her nose is no joke, Cranberry is truly full of love. If you're looking for a companion to greet you like you're in the honeymoon phase for life, this is your girl. If you're looking for a girl who trots right by your side, this is your girl. If you're looking for a calm, peaceful, and aware presence while exploring the outside world together, this is your girl. If you're looking for a partner who can be nervous at times, but calmed but your validating words, pets, and built trust, this is your girl. If you're looking for a pet who gets excited about adventures and just being together, this is your girl. If you're looking for a pup who appreciates human company, company of other nice dogs, chew toys, walks, close snuggles, treats with tricks and great listening skills, this is your girl. If you're looking for a young dog who is beautiful inside and out, this is your girl.

name: Dobby
description_html:
Dobby is a big, affectionate young dog with big puppy enthusiasm and an equally big heart. His human friends describe him as sweet and extremely affectionate. He loves fetch, tug-of-war, chase, and being involved in whatever his people are doing.


Dobby already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'down'. In a home setting, he has done well with house-training and being crated when home alone. He previously lived with a three-year-old child and cats, and his family said he got along with them.


Dobby also has promising dog skills. During his first shelter playgroup, he was nervous about the initial greetings and asked the other dogs for some space. Once he realized he was safe, he relaxed and spent the rest of the session enjoying soft play. He has potential to live with a well-matched dog, so ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


At ten months old, Dobby is still very much a teenager. An active family prepared to provide exercise, training, appropriate chew toys, and gradual alone-time practice will be rewarded with an outgoing, playful, and deeply affectionate companion.

name: Babushka
description_html: Babushka is a precious little pocket pittie. She may be a little shy at first but soon warms up. Babushka is quiet in her kennel, walks easily on leash and calmly passes barking dogs. In the play yard, she enjoys exploring and checking out a few toys. This sweet young girl especially likes to be close to her person and loves cuddling. She is ready to find her forever home and become a cherished companion. Come meet Babushka and fall in love. ❤️

name: Mr Kitten
description_html:
Built like a tank but with a heart as squishy as a land manatee, this big blockhead is impossible not to love.

Mr. Kitten has excellent leash manners and is wonderfully patient with newer volunteers—he’ll let beginners practice harnessing without a fuss. He’s calm and collected walking past kennels or other dogs, taking everything in stride with his signature mellow confidence.

Under that handsome gray coat is the sweetest heart you’ll ever meet. Don’t let his size fool you: he’s a gentle giant through and through. On the leash, he’s a loose-leash pro; off the leash, he becomes the world’s cuddliest couch companion with plenty of surface area for snuggles.

Kind, loving, and endlessly mellow, Mr. Kitten is the dog who wins people over instantly. Come meet him—your only regret will be not doing it sooner.


Additional Foster Notes

Wow, he's amazing! In addition to the notes above, he's rarely vocal, doesn't beg for food, allows bathing and grooming, he's potty trained, and he does well in crowds with screaming kiddos and music. He's a great car passenger and was fantastic with my 6 year old niece.


His ideal home would include a yard and maybe another dog friend, but he's happy anywhere he can be with his people. He has some separation anxiety, but I feel this might be remedied with time and feeling secure.


He may be okay with cats, but this requires time and close supervision for a while to be sure.


Austin Animal Shelter tested him as heartworm positive, but Emancipet tested months later prior to treatment and said he was clear.

name: Max
description_html: Meet Max, a big, handsome guy with a sweet personality and great leash manners! Max is a loose-leash walker who enjoys exploring and gives lots of check-ins with his handler. He may be a little jumpy at first when he’s excited, but he settles nicely. He’s also treat motivated, which can make training and building a bond with him extra fun. Max was neutral toward both people and dogs, and mostly ignored them while out walking. He did show some mild interest in squirrels, but overall he was a pleasure to walk.

name: Pixie
description_html:
Pixie is a small bundle of sweetness looking for a cozy place to call home. This quiet, gentle girl is already showing how quickly she learns—she’s doing great practicing her leash walking and improving every day.


Pixie has a calm, easygoing personality and absolutely loves being close to her people. She happily allows nail trims and handles gentle care like a champ, showing just how trusting and well-mannered she is.


Her favorite thing in the world? Snuggling. Pixie would be thrilled to curl up beside you—or even better, right in your lap—for some quality cuddle time. If you’re looking for a soft-hearted companion who will happily keep you company and shower you with quiet affection, Pixie might be the perfect match.

name: Lady
description_html: Lady is a playful, sweet, loving Black Mouth Cur mix. She is very housetrained and looooves people! Lady loves to go on walks, run around the play yard, play fetch, and say hi to every human she sees. She loves her emotional support tennis balls. A lover of all pools. She is a playful pup in the play yard and then can be the calm cuddle partner in a home. She is gentle with toys and treats. She is easy to harness and get out of her kennel, she does have some dog reactivity - but she can be EASILY redirected, she is not one to linger. Super smart and can play fetch for hours if you'd let her. She is treat motivated, very curious, and eager to learn new tricks and please her human. Lady is a snuggly, cuddly girl, and very affectionate. This playful, loving girl loves to sit in her human's lap and give all the kisses and she'd prefer to be your one and only so she can soak up ALLL the love you have to give. Lady is an all around gem and is ready and waiting for her forever home and people to love on! Come meet Miss Lady girl today, she's waiting for you!

name: Cheech
description_html:
Cheech is a goofy, affectionate, ball-loving dog who takes friendship seriously. Once he knows you, volunteers describe him as a total love bug who adores affection. He’s also a fetch superstar—he’ll bring the ball back and even nudge it toward you to keep the game going.


Cheech has plenty of home experience. He has lived with children and other dogs, is familiar with a crate routine, and has been reported as house-trained when he has been outside the shelter in a home environment. He knows sit and down, enjoys tug, squeaky toys, enrichment activities, and treats, and would thrive with someone who likes an active, interactive dog.


Cheech’s social world works best when introductions are thoughtful. He can be unsure of unfamiliar people at first. Once given time to build trust, however, volunteers have repeatedly seen a much softer, affectionate dog emerge. Slow introductions are the key to helping Cheech feel safe.


He also has experience with other dogs and may do well in a multi-dog household given the right match. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dog to determine compatibility. Cheech has also lived with younger and older children in the past and did great after calm, respectful introductions.


Cheech is beloved by shelter staff and volunteers, and is looking for his forever person. Someone who can move at his pace and who loves fetch, treats, and playtime just as much as him.
very cuddly, affectionate, playful kitten!!

name: Boomerang
description_html:
Meet Boomerang, a bundle of joy with the sweetest smile and the most adorable speckled ears! True to his name, this fun-loving pup is always ready to bring endless happiness right back into your life.

Boomerang is a dream on walks, making daily strolls an absolute breeze. He loves zooming around the yard, showing off his energetic, playful personality before settling in for cuddles. Having successfully lived with another dog, Boomerang would make a wonderful companion for a multi-pet home or any family looking for a loyal, happy-go-lucky sidekick.

name: Maiev
description_html:
After six years in a home, Maiev was sadly left behind. Thankfully, caring neighbors stepped in—one made sure she was fed, and another reached out for help.


Despite everything, Maiev remains a sweet, affectionate cat with so much love left to give. She’s gentle, grateful, and ready for a quiet forever home where she can finally feel safe and cherished again.


Older cats like Maiev make deeply loyal companions, and she is hoping for someone to give her the second chance she truly deserves.

name: Sunny
description_html:
Sunny is a sweet, goofy, playful young pup. He is house-trained, crate-trained, and currently living in foster with a toddler and a doggie sibling. He absolutely loves playing - with toys, with dogs, and with his food (in the cutest possible way) - and lives for belly rubs. He is still figuring out how to walk on leash, but enjoys chasing balls in the backyard to get his energy out. Sunny is friendly with everyone and is a pretty easy guy who could fit into a lot of different homes.

It is suspected that Sunny was hit by a car and may have suffered some very mild head trauma. Due to this he can be a little uncoordinated at times and will occasionally spin in circles when tired or stressed. This doesn't stop him from living his best life though, and he remains a very happy go lucky dog. If you are interested in learning more about Sunny, click the "Get Started" link to be connected with his foster.

name: Donkey
description_html:
Donkey's health condition at arrival to the shelter required a quick exit and that he did! He's been on a journey ever since and is currently in a foster home. He stays along a small lake, having the time of his life, safely, securely, as an indoors pet with a small dog friend and a foster mom.


Donkey has a heart of gold, and is easy to manage and we want to give him every opportunity to return to health, if he can. His medical work is sponsored by ClassicCaninesATX who are determining what treatment needs he has.


Ever heard the fable of the old man and his old donkey? Well this old donkey is not giving up and staying down in the well, he's trying to climb back up. And he has a wonderful support crew behind him.


If you're interested in being his happily ever after please inquire on the Get Started link or write caring@classiccanines.org to get started.

name: Sabo
description_html:
With a large grin to match his large frame Sabo is ready to welcome everyone into his space. He adores people, adores friendly dogs, and adores children he has met along the path of life.

Sabo appreciates being part of the indoors family which is why shelter living is a shocker for this sweet guy. He's very house trained. He's stayed home alone for 4-8 hour stretches at a time, on his own with no troubles. He becomes his younger self when squishy toys are near, they're his favorite. He loves grooming and occasional water play.

He is RTG - Ready to Go - he's neutered, vaccinated, heart worm negative and ready to leave right away. See his short video here

Don't delay when a shelter dog is waiting for a helping hand out of the shelter.

name: Java
description_html:
From her foster:


Java is a one of a kind girl and ready for a home. Every day has been better than the last and she has really come around with manners and just being a sweetheart. She is down for anything and loves being outside but will also lay by you with some part of her body always touching. She would do great with someone who is patient and kind and willing to work with her on leash manners and keeping her attention. She’ll be a truly loyal dog when she finds her person.


Java is an incredibly intelligent puppy. She’s house broken. She easily learned sit and is starting to understand down and touch. While, she isn’t a fan of the crate, she quickly settles down and sleeps through the night in it. 


Java is very playful and energetic. She lives with two resident dogs, she is constantly trying to play with. She would love a sibling of equal size and energy who she can run around and play with. She absolutely loves toys and will empty out the toy bin one toy at a time hoarding them on the couch. Her favorite place is on the couch next to her foster dad chomping on a toy. 


Her most adorable feature is her incredibly long tongue that barely fits in her mouth. She loves to give kisses whether she means to or not.  


She is a very confident dog but can be nervous around new people. She also gets will be attached to her person. 

____

Java is a sweet, playful girl who may need just a moment to get comfortable before her personality comes shining through. Shelter staff describe her as shy at first, but quick to warm up, friendly, and very sweet.


Java has also shown lovely social skills with other dogs. During her shelter playgroup evaluation, she entered a little uncertain with her tail tucked, but quickly relaxed and began playing with another dog. When a more enthusiastic dog became too pushy, Java communicated appropriately and handled the situation well. She was paired with a doggy roommate, and may be a great candidate for a home with a well-matched canine companion. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs to make sure it’s a good fit!


If you enjoy watching a shy pup gain confidence and reveal her silly, playful side, Java may be exactly the kind of dog who steals your heart.

name: Baloo
description_html:
Baloo is the full package: house-trained, dog-friendly, well-mannered, affectionate, knows his commands, and non-destructive. He’s also perfect in the car, gentle with his toys, and absolutely LOVES everyone he meets. What more could you want?!


Still on the fence? Baloo’s adorable little prance on walks should seal the deal.


His foster mom reports that he is an absolute angel and would be a perfect fit for so many homes. Baloo's incredibly loving and makes a wonderful companion, but already has all the training and good habits that come with being an adult dog. He rarely barks and is happiest lounging on the porch, watching the world go by. And he's such a cuddle bug!


Think Baloo could be your guy? Hit the “Get Started” button to connect with his foster and learn more about making him yours.

name: Damon
description_html:
Damon is a sweet, adventurous pup who's always ready to head out and explore. He starts walks with plenty of enthusiasm and can pull on leash at first, but he settles into enjoying all the interesting sights and smells along the way. He's curious about other dogs and likes to check them out as he passes by.


Damon is very food motivated, making treats a great way to build his skills and strengthen your bond. He also loves the water, so splashy adventures could quickly become one of his favorite activities. One of Damon's quirks is that he may chew on his leash when he's excited, so bringing along a toy to redirect him can help set him up for success.


With an active family that can provide continued training, enrichment, and plenty of opportunities to explore, Damon has all the makings of a fun and loyal companion.

name: Mila Aka Jenna
description_html: aka Mila

name: Emmylou
description_html: It may take Emmylou a little while for her to warm up but when she does she welcomes pets and will be your best buddy. She is great on leash, a gentle treat taker and she is very house trained. She does have a playful side but you may not see that right away. Anyone considering Emmylou should be patient and go at her pace.

name: Benny
description_html:
Benny is such a fun, spunky guy! He likes other dogs, loves to play with toys, and is super smart. In fact, one volunteer was just about able to teach him to sit in about 3 minutes! (We say "just about able" because it takes routine practice, but Benny definitely got the idea and we know he'd learn even more tricks very quickly because he's a super smart cookie and is treat motivated!)


Benny is hoping for an adopter who loves to explore and adventure and will bring him along for the fun. He'd also be a great wingman if you need one - Benny loves everyone he meets!


Benny is a young pup who is so endearing. Still learning so much about the world. Absolutely hilarious and so playful around water. Seeks out pets and attention. Pretty easy on leash, just an all around wonderful dog!


Email his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Rufus
description_html:
Looking for a dog who is already a master of good manners? Look no further than Rufus. This sweet boy is the perfect mix of an obedient companion and a devoted cuddler.

Rufus thrives when given clear boundaries and is exceptionally eager to please. He gracefully respects your personal space, waiting for an invitation before hopping onto the couch, and keeping off the bed entirely. His impulse control is stellar—he waits calmly for permission before eating his meals and before walking through external doors.

Rufus has been living with another dog in foster care, and they love to play and sleep together. While he can be a bit reactive to other dogs while on his leash walks, he has been great with his doggie foster sibling. (He has no known history with cats or kids).

Ready to add a respectful, obedient, and affectionate boy to your life? Apply to meet Rufus today!

name: Marcus
description_html:
Marcus is a full-of-life, playful dog who approaches every activity with enthusiasm! His favorite things include fetch, tug-of-war, walks, squeaky toys, and chewing on bones. He already knows 'sit' and would love a family ready to channel his joyful energy into games, adventures, and positive training.

Marcus has wonderful family experience. He previously lived with children ages two and four, and his former family described him as friendly with both adults and children. He's doing great with our older children in his new foster home. He is still learning to handle his big feelings when excited, so continued work on calm greetings and appropriate play will help him become an even more polished companion. He's still learning to be comfortable with guests coming into the house, so proper introductions are necessary.

Marcus also has promising dog experience. During his first shelter playgroup, he also offered nice greetings, warmed up quickly, and enjoyed chase play and zoomies with another dog. He lives with a doggy roommate at the shelter and would likely do well in a multi-dog household. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs to make sure it’s a good fit!

Marcus is a young puppy and still working on house-training, leash manners, and feeling comfortable when left alone. He is doing great with crate training and is able to be at home by himself for a few hours. He will benefit from structure, enrichment, exercise, and lots of treats and praise for good behavior!

For an active family looking for a cheerful, exuberant companion with plenty of personality, Marcus could be exactly the dog they have been waiting for. Come meet him today!

name: Pooh
description_html: Pooh is a happy, playful boy. He is housetrained, walks nicely on leash with a harness, and is dog friendly. Pooh loves to romp around the play yard tossing around toys and chasing balls. He also enjoys running along the fence line with other friendly dogs and has done well playing with others. . Pooh is sweet, affectionate and ready for his forever home. Come meet this handsome fellow!

name: Angel
description_html:
~ Ears Up!

Angel is a sweet, easygoing girl who's turning a new page after her beloved owner who went into hospice. She's a total sweetheart who gets along with everyone and is super low-maintenance. Angel loves playing with her ball and pretending to lightly hide it outdoors, sunbathing indoors and outdoors, and going for sniff walks. She's perfectly content to relax inside and watch the world go by from a window view. She's house-trained, trustworthy, independent, and doesn't bother the local wildlife. If you're looking for a loving companion who will bring joy and peace to your life, without bringing a lot of new chores and routines, Angel is your girl!

Reach out on her link or contact her advocates at caring@classiccanines.org

name: Dom
description_html:
Dom is a fun, playful, and incredibly handsome boy who’s ready to find his forever home. He’s easy to harness, and once you toss a toy out of his kennel, he’s all in and ready to go! Dom can be strong at first on leash, but after he gets some energy out, he settles in nicely and relaxes.

Dom is very smart and listens well—he already knows tricks and is eager to learn more, especially when food and treats are involved (they’re his favorite!). He absolutely loves spending time playing in the yard, showing off his playful and goofy side.

With a medium energy level, Dom would be a great match for an active lifestyle, and he’ll likely relax even more once he’s out of the shelter environment. He’s leash trained, house trained, and full of personality—lovable, intelligent, and always ready for fun.


Interested in Dom? Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Mama Cat
description_html:
💔 Mama Cat lost the only home she’d known for five years. Can you help her find her next one? 


Mama Cat’s world was turned upside down when a family member developed allergies, and she had to leave the home and people she knew. Now she’s at the shelter, and understandably, she’s scared and overwhelmed. Her sister Uno was also surrendered.


But her previous family gave us something incredibly special: a glimpse into the amazing cat Mama Cat truly is. According to her former owner, Mama Cat is:

🐾 Playful and friendly

🐾 A total cuddle bug and lap cat

🐾 Happy to be picked up and held

🐾 Great about nail trims and brushing

🐾 Perfect with her litter box

🐾 Experienced living with children

🐾 Experienced living with small dogs


In other words, Mama Cat already knows how to be someone’s perfect companion. She just needs a home where she can feel safe again. Could that home be yours? Come meet Mama Cat today!

name: Uno
description_html:
💔 After 8 years in the only home she knew, Uno suddenly found herself at the shelter. 


Uno was surrendered with her sister, Mama Cat, after a family member developed allergies. Imagine spending your entire life with your family and then, overnight, everything familiar is gone. It’s no wonder Uno was terrified when our veterinary team examined her at intake. 


But her previous owner gave us something incredibly valuable: a glimpse of the sweet girl hiding behind that fear. Once she feels safe, Uno will jump right into your lap and snuggle. She’s a little shy, but she has plenty to say. She has lived with children and small dogs, and she is cooperative for nail trims and brushing. Oh, and she has perfect litter box manners!


Her biggest “flaw”? This girl LOVES food. She has a tendency to overeat, so her forever family will need to help her keep her portions in check.

name: Mr Carson
description_html:
Meet Mr. Carson 🎩


Mr. Carson arrived at the shelter as a stray, but we know someone cared about him at some point—he was already neutered when he came to us. ❤️


Intake was scary for this handsome boy, but even while frightened, Mr. Carson did his best to cooperate. And once he feels comfortable, you can see the sweet cat underneath it all.


Mr. Carson can get overstimulated, so he’s looking for someone who will learn his signals, respect his boundaries, and let him build trust at his own pace. We also think he is not a fan of other cat, so he’d prefer to be your one-and-only feline.

name: Snorri
description_html:
🐾 Meet Snorri! 


Snorri is a sweet, playful, curious little lovebug who starts purring the second you pick him up or pet him. He loves curling up in your lap for naps and being wherever his people are. 


He’s also a social butterfly who adores other cats. He may play a little enthusiastically sometimes, but he’s still a kitten with plenty of energy to burn! 😹


Snorri was surrendered with his slightly older sister, Weetzie, and their prior owner told us the two are bonded and would love to see them adopted together. If you’re looking for a purry, playful, affectionate pair of best friends, Snorri and Weetzie are waiting for you!

name: Weetzie
description_html:
👑 Meet Weetzie, a little princess with a heart of gold! 


Weetzie was surrendered with her brother, Snoori, when their owner could no longer care for them. She’s a sweet, gentle girl who may take a little time to warm up, but once she trusts you, she’ll cuddle, sit in your lap, and happily stay close by.


Weetzie loves to play, enjoys other cats, and is perfectly content doing her own thing, too. She’s truly a pure-hearted angel. Her previous owner told us Weetzie and Snoori are bonded, and we’d love to see these siblings find a home together.

name: Kaia
description_html:
Meet Kaia!


Kaia is a sweet young cat who is sure to charm you from the moment you meet her! She immediately approached when her kennel door opened and, after just a few pets, was already trying to climb into a lap. She purred happily while being petted and was easy to pick up and hold.


Kaia is confident, affectionate, friendly, and appears to be a wonderful lap cat who would love a home where she can shower her person with affection.😻

name: Yasmin
description_html:
Yasmin LOVES people! She was brought to AAS with a large wound on the inside of her left ankle and a fractured distal tibia very close to the joint. Surgical repair wasn't an option at the shelter due to the open wound, so we moved her into foster care for months of supportive care (including kennel rest).

The fracture has healed well, although her ankle bends outward a bit. Still, Yasmin runs and plays, and it doesn't seem to bother her. This ankle may be prone to arthritis in the future, so should be monitored closely for any issues.

Yasmin craves attention, and has been known to climb up on a shoulder (or even a back)! She'll greet you and stay near you, and is a lap cat when she's finished with playtime. She is fine with other cats/kittens, but slow intros are essential, as she can be selective.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Yasmin and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Kylie
description_html:
Meet Kylie ~ she's the sweetest nugget and is medium sized. She's gentle, relaxed, non-demanding, and an easy friend to people and friendly dogs. She appreciates comfort, snacks and good companionship. We expect she'll thrive in most home settings and may be a great fit with children too.


How did Kylie end up here? Kylie arrived stray with a microchip that has grown cold. She's so grateful for all the help she's getting to adjust to shelter life. Let's make her stay a short one.

See her short post and video

name: Sammy
description_html:
Meet Sammy - he arrived with another little friend a lot like him, Hammy-32505.

This sweet boy is also part entertainer like his friend but in a quieter way. He likes to explore.

He doesn't mind pickups and handling as needed. He has a nice, even energy about him and likes to cozy up to people. He tries to remember his housetraining skills on the long walk to get outside so we try to rush along to keep him successful.


Sammy needs a dedicated person or family to tend to his wellness and provide regular bathing so his skin and fur can return to it's full shine, matching his beautiful personality.


Are you ready to be a bridge to the future for Sammy?

name: Bubbles
description_html:
Meet Bubbles! 🐾


Bubbles is a sweet young girl who arrived at the shelter feeling a little scared and unsure of her new surroundings. But thanks to the love and patience of staff and volunteers, she’s becoming more comfortable every day—and her happy, wagging tail is proof that she’s starting to look forward to seeing her favorite people!


The shelter can be a noisy place, and all the barking can make Bubbles nervous. When she notices other dogs, though, she shows friendly curiosity and interest. While she hasn’t had the chance to meet any dogs yet, her positive interest is a promising sign.


Bubbles also loves to cuddle with her people, which helps her feel safe and secure. She’s easy to walk on a leash and would love a patient, loving family who will continue helping her build confidence.

With a little time, affection, and plenty of cuddles, Bubbles is sure to blossom into a wonderful companion. Could you be the safe and loving home this sweet girl has been waiting for? 💕🐶

name: Hammy
description_html:
Hammy LOVES LOVES people - he checks in nicely, is attentive, and is part entertainer, especially on his back legs. He's playful and engaging. He arrived with another small dog a lot like him but brown and black, 32504. He also saw cats behind the glass in the cat hallway and showed curious, friendly interest. He doesn't mind being picked up when needed. He tries hard to mind his potty training skills through a long walk out of the building, so we try not to pause.


Hammy needs a dedicated person or family to tend to his wellbeing. With a few bathes over time, his skin and fur will grow and shine just as brightly as he shows on the inside.


Ready to be a bridge to the future? Come meet him and also check out his friend 32504.

name: Abigail
description_html:
Tiny Abigail isn't just stinkin' adorable to look at, her personality is stinkin' adorable also!

She arrived at AAS as a very sick kitten, with a large abscess on top of her head (you can still see the scar). We moved Abigail into foster care, and after weeks of supportive care, she is ready for her new home. She has a bit of a head bob (she may have been born with it, or it may be a side effect of the abscess), but it doesn't stop her.

Abigail lives with other foster kittens who are twice her size, yet she runs and plays and keeps up with them with no issues. She would love to have a cat/kitten buddy in her new home. She is equally affectionate with humans, enjoying some lap time after she's played out.

name: Lindita
description_html:
Meet Lindita — a queen looking for her castle! 👑


Lindita was found as a stray after her finder had been feeding her for a while. She kept trying to sneak her way into the house, but she wasn’t exactly thrilled about sharing her space with the resident cats. So, we think Lindita would prefer to be the one and only queen of her castle! 


When she arrived at the shelter, she was friendly with our intake staff and even allowed them to pick her up! Volunteers describe her as affectionate and vocal, so she’s not shy about letting you know what she wants. 


If you’re looking for a loving, chatty companion who wants all the attention to herself, Lindita might be your girl!

name: Churro
description_html:
🐾 Meet Churro — a sweet boy waiting for someone to see his potential. 🐾


Churro came to us from a home with far too many cats, and after everything he’s been through, it’s understandable that he’s scared. Those big, dilated pupils may make him look nervous, but behind them is a gentle, affectionate cat just waiting to feel safe.


If you take your time, move slowly, and speak softly, Churro starts to let his guard down. Before long, he’ll roll onto his side, asking for affection and showing you the sweet boy we knew was in there all along.


Churro needs a quiet, patient home where he can decompress, build trust, and come out of his shell at his own pace. He may need a little extra time to shine—but we think he’ll be worth the wait!

name: Lorelai
description_html:
Fluffy Tail Alert--Meet Lorelai! ✨


Lorelai’s world was turned upside down when her owner moved out of state and couldn’t take her. She lost the only home she’s ever known, and now she’s looking for a forever family to call her own. 💔


This independent girl has a personality all her own! She’s the type to love you from a distance, happily lounging on your legs, soaking up head scratches, and keeping an eye on you. She’s also always hungry 😂 and gets adorably energetic when the toys come out! And just look at her gorgeous fluffy tail!


Lorelai has so much love to give in her own special way. Could you be the one to give her the second chance she deserves? ❤️

name: Daisy
description_html: She’s lovely! She was an extremely loose leash walker with wonderful leash manners. She even knows some tricks like sit and paw! She never once pulled and she was a delight to walk. She also likes treats and was gentle in taking them. A quiet, gentle girl.

name: Ronda Rousey
description_html: although she had a rough start in life. Ronda is amazing and working hard on recovering and gaining weight.

name: Elizabeth
description_html:
Stinkin' adorable with tons of personality, Elizabeth arrived at AAS after being rescued in the community. She had nerve damage to her left front paw and a broken but healing distal 1/3 left humerus that was fairly displaced. 

We moved Elizabeth into a foster home for weeks of kennel rest and range of motion PT. The fracture is now healed but in poor alignment, and the nerves have regenerated enough that she can place the paw in the correct position with every step. She will likely gain some strength in the left front leg muscles but may never have a normal stride in this limb. 

Elizabeth has no idea that her left front paw isn't absolutely perfect. She runs, plays, jumps, and does everything that her foster siblings do, and then some. She is very affectionate, and loves to be held, petted, brushed, etc. She would enjoy having a cat/kitten buddy in her new home.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Elizabeth and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Wren
description_html: Wren is a very shy boy, but if you sit quietly and sweet talk him, he will relax and squint his eyes. He and his friends came from an area that was unsafe for cats. He gets comfort from cat friends, so may do best in a home with friendly, social cats to guide him. He's joined the Cactus Cats program where he can get extra TLC from volunteers and have companionship with other shy kitties. Wren will thrive with a patient, cat savvy person to help him adjust to a new home. With a calm space and daily encouragement, this little guy will go far!

name: Cookie
description_html: Cookie is a shy young boy who came in with his siblings from an unsafe situation. He has joined our Cactus Cats to get extra attention from volunteers and feel secure with his fellow shy kitties in the cactus room. Cookie may need some patience and daily encouragement in a new home and may do best with a cat friend to guide him. With the right home, this boy could become brave and accomplish all his cat goal of becoming a life-long best boy companion.

name: Bumper
description_html: Sweet little Bumper has had a rough go of life. He's blind and a little weather worn but he's not giving up and hasn't lost his spirit. He's going to get rested, reconditioned and recovered with help from a wonderful foster family and his friends at Classic Canines. Stay tuned for updates. Sept 1st starts the 1st day of his journey to a new life ahead.

name: Jetson
description_html:
🐾 Jetson loves people — he doesn’t love the shelter. 💔


Jetson was surrendered because he didn’t get along with the other cat in his home. Now he finds himself in another stressful situation, surrounded by strange sights, sounds, and unfamiliar cats.


At first, we found Jetson hiding in his litter box. But as soon as a volunteer started petting him, he relaxed, came out, and approached for more pets! ❤️ He even tried to sit on a volunteer’s lap before becoming nervous again.


We think Jetson is scared of the shelter environment and other cats, not people. He may be happiest as the only cat in the home, where he can relax and show his affectionate personality. Jetson loves people. He just needs a home where he can feel safe.

name: Major Tom
description_html:
Major Tom is ready for liftoff… straight into your heart! 🐱🚀


Calling Ground Control! We’ve got a very special astronaut looking for his forever home.


Major Tom is social, friendly, and wonderfully easy-going. Give him some pets and he’s happy to spend time with you. And if you really want to get on his good side? Churu is the fuel that powers this mission.


He’s got the charm, the confidence, and the personality to be your perfect copilot. All he needs now is a loving human to bring him home.


🪐 Mission objective: Find Major Tom a forever family.

🐾 Special skills: Socializing, accepting pets, being marvelous.

🍗 Fuel of choice: Churu.


Adopt Major Tom and give this sweet boy his next great adventure!

name: Spottie Dottie
description_html:
Meet Spottie Dottie! She is a HIGH energy girl, thriving in her foster home with an older puppy brother to play with. She is affectionate and likes the people she has met (including two loud teenagers), but especially loves her foster dog brother.


Despite her young age, she is doing very well with crate and house training.


She needs her spay surgery before she can be officially adopted, but you can submit an application and meet her now to see if she's the right pup for you! Just submit your application if you're interested and her foster family will reach out to you.

name: Jay Jay
description_html:
Meet Jay Jay - he's an outdoorsmen, through and true!

He loves the water, loves a good run and all the exploring in between.

Looking for an activity partner? Here he is, with his webbed duck feet ready to go!

Make a plan to stop by and see.

He's brand new here.

name: Max
description_html:
Meet Max❤️ 


Max started hanging around a south Austin neighborhood earlier this summer. He claimed a neighbor’s porch as his favorite spot and would visit other yards for meals. After checking around the neighborhood, his finder came to believe that this sweet little guy didn’t have a home of his own.


With a little bribery involving Churu and treats, Max slowly learned that people were safe. Once he got comfortable, his sweet personality really came out. He absolutely loved getting pets, bumping his head into hands, and making sure people knew when he wanted some attention! He’s not a fan of pets around his hindquarters, but otherwise he’s a total lovebug.


We are so grateful that Max is now safe and being cared for while he waits for his forever home.

He deserves a loving forever home where he can feel safe, spoiled, and adored. 🐾❤️

name: Pearl
description_html:
🐾 Pearl is looking for a soft landing. ❤️


Pearl is a friendly girl who loves attention and affection. She actively seeks out pets and happily enjoys attention on her head, cheeks, chin, and back.


She may occasionally give a little love nip, but she’s a good girl who simply needs someone willing to listen to her signals and understand her communication. Once you know her cues, she’s happy to soak up the love!


Pearl seems like a young lady who could really use a soft, safe place to land — and a person who will appreciate her affectionate personality.

name: Erwin
description_html: Erwin is one handsome guy with striking features! He’s a little shy at first but warms up quickly and is gentle and sweet. Erwin is great on leash, knows how to sit, and is treat motivated. He enjoys sniffing and exploring while giving lots of check-ins with his handler. He seems to be housetrained and is dog friendly. This playful, easygoing boy would make a wonderful companion and is ready to find his forever home!

name: Velvet Sky
description_html:
💙 Meet Velvet Sky! 💙


Velvet Sky is every bit as smooth, sweet, and brilliant as his name implies! This handsome blue-and-white boy was friendly from the moment he arrived and has continued to show just how affectionate he is while waiting patiently in his kennel.


It’s clear that Velvet Sky has known people before — he’s comfortable with humans and seems to genuinely enjoy their attention. And as if his wonderful personality weren’t enough, he’s also seriously photogenic! 📸🐾


Velvet Sky deserves more than a kennel. He deserves a loving home where he can be someone’s cherished companion again. Could you be the person he’s been waiting for?

name: Otis
description_html:
Otis is a gentle, sensitive guy who’s looking for a loving home. He walks loosely on a leash which makes going for walks so enjoyable and peaceful.

He enjoys carrying around his emotional support tennis ball and splooting in your lap to snuggle. Otis is a special guy, and deserves a special home.

name: Oscar
description_html: This sweet boy seems overwhelmed in the shelter environment, but he's precious. He seems housetrained, keeping his kennel clean. He just wants to feel safe and lie with with you. He likes treats, especially peanut butter. With time in a home, he'll feel more confident and happy go lucky.

name: Ivan
description_html: Ivan is a big, playful goofball. He loves playing with toys, and his zest for playtime is infectious. Watching this big guy chase toys and wiggle with joy is so cute. And once playtime is over, Ivan is a great cuddle buddy, loving to sit close by and soak up all the pets. He walks great on a leash, is very house-trained, and would make such a great companion!

name: Jolene
description_html:
Chex Mix is an adorable and tiny girl who truly deserves a warm and loving home with someone special. She might be a bit shy initially, but she opens up fast, especially if treats are on the table! She takes them delicately and is kind and easy to walk while exploring and checking in with her handler. Even though she's a bit on the thin side, she has loads of energy and a fantastic zest for life.


Are you ready to give Chex Mix a cozy home life where she can feel safe, loved, and treasured? She can't wait to meet you.

name: Starling
description_html: Little Starling may give a little hiss with her first hello, but if you offer some Churu she will know you are a friend. Starling is still learning to trust us. Getting used to kennel life isn't easy! We think she will truly blossom in a home with a patient, cat savvy person willing to give her the time she needs to adapt to a new home. Starling would love to go to a quiet foster home if she isn't adopted soon!

name: Raichu
description_html: Raichu is happy, wiggly young pup with lots of love to give! She adores people and wants to be everybody's best friend. She is quickly learning good manners and commands. Raichu is super playful and loves toys. Her foster home doesn't have any other pets, but she seems very dog friendly!

name: Finn
description_html: Hoppie, Dream and Finn came in from the same home, and may enjoy each other's company but do not appear bonded. They have been very shy in the shelter, so need a slow approach. These kitties may do best in a low traffic home with lots of consistent positive interactions. We think a quiet space is just what they might need to help them come out of their shells and show their true purrsonalities. Hoppie, Dream and Finn can be adopted together or separately.

name: Wilder
description_html: Wilder may be shy at first, so give him a little time to warm up and experience new things at his own pace. Once comfortable, this sweet boy blossoms into a playful, cuddly companion! He loves fetch, knows commands, seems housetrained, and has the most amazing ice-blue eyes. Wilder enjoys exploring and will happily check in with his person on walks. He’s looking for someone patient who will let his sweet personality shine.

name: Metallica
description_html: Metallica came in from an unsafe situation with several other cats. He is still learning to trust us, but we can see in his green eyes that he's a friend. This boy gets along well with other cats and has joined our Cactus Cat program to get extra attention from volunteers and have the comfort of shy kitties to help him on his journey. He may prefer a home with cat companions to guide him and may do best in a low traffic space where he can get consistent positive interactions to build his confidence. This handsome boy has a bright future, we just know it!

name: Amadeus
description_html:
🐾 Help Goddard & Amadeus unfreeze their fear! 🐾


When these orange tabby brothers arrived, our intake staff described them as “frozen in fear.” Despite their terror, both boys allowed themselves to be examined.


Thankfully, they’re slowly learning that people can be good — and they’re making progress! ❤️

Goddard and Amadeus can be adopted separately or together, though we think having a feline friend at home would be wonderful for both of them.


Won’t you help these sweet but shy boys discover that the world can be a safe and loving place? A little patience could make all the difference. 🏠🐱

name: Goddard
description_html:
🐾 Help Goddard & Amadeus unfreeze their fear! 🐾


When these orange tabby brothers arrived, our intake staff described them as “frozen in fear.” Despite their terror, both boys allowed themselves to be examined.


Thankfully, they’re slowly learning that people can be good — and they’re making progress! ❤️

Goddard and Amadeus can be adopted separately or together, though we think having a feline friend at home would be wonderful for both of them.


Won’t you help these sweet but shy boys discover that the world can be a safe and loving place? A little patience could make all the difference. 🏠🐱

name: Lemon Bar
description_html:
Lemon Bar came in from an area where residents were doing their best to care for the community cats, however the location became unsafe for them. He's still learning to trust people at the shelter, but he was friendly with his caregivers and we think with a little time, he will come around with us and his new adopters.

Lemon Bar would make a great best friend to a cat in the home and can learn social skills by watching other cats engage with people. He has joined his shy cat friends in our Cactus Cats program to help him learn confidence boosting skills that lead to loving and lasting relationships with their human family members.

Lemon Bar may take time getting used to new spaces, but with some time and patience we think he will make a loyal cat companion in a home.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Lemon Bar and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Kadabra
description_html:
💙 Meet Kadabra—a sweet boy ready for his next chapter! 💙


Kadabra was surrendered alongside his brothers, Abra and Alakazam, after their owner began traveling and could no longer care for them. Suddenly finding himself in a shelter was a lot for this sweet boy, and at first, Kadabra hid under his bedding alongside Alakazam.


But little by little, Kadabra started to realize that maybe the shelter isn’t so scary after all. 🥹 And just like his brother Abra, he decided he’d like some attention, too!


His former owner describes Kadabra as very sweet and lovable, and we’re already seeing glimpses of that affectionate personality emerge. Now he’s eager to leave the shelter behind and find a forever home where he can feel safe, loved, and comfortable again. ❤️

name: Abra
description_html:
💙 Meet Abra—a wise soul with so much love to give. 


Abra’s world was turned upside down when his owner began traveling and could no longer care for him. He was surrendered alongside Kadabra and Alakazam, suddenly finding himself in a shelter after having a home and family of his own.


But despite all that change, Abra continues to be incredibly friendly. 🥹 His former owner described him as sweet and lovable, and he’s certainly showing us that side of himself! He can often be found right at the front of his kennel, hoping someone will stop by to give him some attention. He’s not hiding—he’s waiting.


And there’s something special about Abra’s eyes. They have a certain wisdom to them, as though he’s seen a thing or two. Maybe he has. But what he knows now is that he’s ready for a new chapter. 

Abra deserves a home where he can feel secure, loved, and appreciated for the wonderful cat he is.

name: Siren
description_html:
Meet Siren — a bewitching beauty with a heart full of love! 🚨💗


When Siren brought her five kittens to a kind member of the public, she was desperate, exhausted, and determined to survive. Thankfully, her finder opened their heart and home to this beautiful mama and her entire litter. Now it’s Siren’s turn to find a forever home of her own.


And what a girl she is! Siren is a stunning golden beauty with emerald green eyes — so mesmerizing that her finder named her “Siren” because she’s simply bewitching. But her looks are only part of her magic. 💚


Siren wants to be loved. While in foster care, she got attention on a daily basis, and that's something she's missing out on now! She really enjoys company and wants to be wherever you are. Get down on her level and she’ll happily reward you with intense snuggles while making biscuits like she’s kneading her way straight into your heart. And when she’s feeling especially relaxed? She prances! 🥰


After everything this devoted mama has been through, Siren deserves a life where she can finally relax, feel safe, and be completely adored.

name: Sprinkles
description_html: Sprinkles is still learning the joys of being our friend. She can be very shy at first and may hiss, but you can quickly win her over with either play time or snacks. Her favorite toy is a wand type toy that she can hunt as you drag it around in front of her. Sprinkle's favorite snack is Churu, which she will eagerly gobble up if offered. We think this girl will progress fastest in a home with lots of patient, consistent positive interactions. Ask staff about adoption or foster today!

name: Dream
description_html: Hoppie, Dream and Finn came in from the same home, and may enjoy each other's company but do not appear bonded. They have been very shy in the shelter, so need a slow approach. These kitties may do best in a low traffic home with lots of consistent positive interactions. We think a quiet space is just what they might need to help them come out of their shells and show their true purrsonalities. Hoppie, Dream and Finn can be adopted together or separately.

name: Hoppie
description_html: Hoppie, Dream and Finn came in from the same home, and may enjoy each other's company but do not appear bonded. They have been very shy in the shelter, so need a slow approach. These kitties may do best in a low traffic home with lots of consistent positive interactions. We think a quiet space is just what they might need to help them come out of their shells and show their true purrsonalities. Hoppie, Dream and Finn can be adopted together or separately.

name: Pup
description_html:
If you're looking for a dog for your dog, look no further! Pup absolutely LOVES having canine friends around. He lives for wrestling matches, backyard zoomies, and following his older foster siblings around. We think he'd thrive in a home with a playful dog sibling who can keep him company and show him the ropes.  He could also be a great fit for an active household ready to keep up with his puppy energy and include him in their adventures.

At around 6 months to 1 year old, Pup is a fast learner, highly food motivated, and will do just about anything for a treat. And once the playing is done? Pup is more than happy to curl up on the couch with his foster family and soak up some cuddles.

Pup is looking for a family who will keep helping him learn, give him plenty of opportunities to play and explore, and love having him by their side. In return, we think he’ll grow into an incredibly loyal companion.

name: Hedgehog
description_html: Want a kitten with a story? This little girl survived a mass murder event when some psychopath started poisoning cats with anti-freeze in the neighborhood where she was born. Snatched off the street with her siblings, Hedgehog has shown everyone that, despite her rough start in life, she is ready to open her heart and love. Loves pets and loves to purr. She is the first of her sibling crew to be curious and get pets from new people. She loves other cats and would do very well in a home with an older cat sibling or one of her brothers. Great with a litter box, up to date on her shots, and fixed. Give this tiny girl a chance to warm up to new people and places, and she will be the best companion.

name: Layla
description_html:
Layla is a fluffy, purring girl, who loves attention and will curl around your legs, asking to be petted. She plays with her 2 sibs most of the day, with low to sometimes medium energy, maybe a little more as she grows. Use the email below to reach out to her foster directly for more information or to set up a meet/greet.

 

- Email: adaywithfosters@gmail.com

- Pictures & Info: https://www.instagram.com/adaywithfosters

 

Layla is my most forward and social of the trio, letting you know she wants to be petted, but also loves to play with her sibs. She does kitten things throughout the day, first is play with her brother or sister but attention is welcome at any time. She purrs like motor boat when you talk to her, before you even pet her and she’s often hard to take pictures of as she wants to come close for pets as soon as you are close. Like her sister Cleo, once you pet her, you’re committed as she’ll want more.

 

She and her sibs were strays and pretty darn scared at the world when I took them on… and now she’s becoming a kitten again. During the day she plays- zoom, wrestle and chase all toys and she plays with them interchangeably with her sibs. She loves all toys- string, ping-pong balls, pieces of cardboard, springs and flat crinkle toys, etc. Lately, they’re learning and may come running when she hears a rattle mouse. Being picked up is still at work in progress and she’ll stay in my arms a little longer each time and sometimes over the shoulder. Belly rubs are always welcome too. She’s very gentle when you play and hand wrestle. If you pick her up when she’s playing or busy, she’s almost always fine to stop playing for pets.. but may politely squirm to get down if she’s super busy playing. She’s a nosey kitten and an explorer as she’s bigger and can jump higher on shelves. After playing and runs out of gas, she’ll nap most often on the cat tree in the sun, by the bird feeder, or lately on the middle of the bed all stretched out.

 

So far, she doesn’t talk much at all and has a very soft voice when it’s meal time. She’s regaining her kitten confidence, so her voice might grow. She climbs a tall sisal cat tree very well through the day. She’ll make small air biscuits when you talk to her, purring even before you pet her. At night she plays near the bed while I read and hangs out close on a small table and might come on the bed with her sister Cleo from time to time. I think she would do OK as a solo kitten for someone who works from home to give her a lot of attention and wants. She would do very well with either of her sibs- Cleo 30951 or Dante 30953, for someone who wants a sibling pair. I also think she would also do very well with a family who has a cat or kitten who wants a playmate… potentially even a dog who would like a playmate or cuddle buddy.

 

She is perfect with the litter box and it’s hard to tell if she covers or not with three kittens. She’s very good getting her front her nails trimmed weekly and we’re working on the backs, to make it routine. She’s she hasn’t met many new people yet, just a few friends so she might be a little shy around new folks. It takes her a few minutes to warm up with toys. I think she would do fine with children once used to their energy. Layla is fine w/ my older cat and sometimes wants to cuddle and works up the courage but my cat isn’t a fan. I have no idea if she’s met a dog, but think she would do OK with a one once she gets used to them, after slow introductions.

name: Cleo
description_html:
Cleo is a purr girl, who loves attention and will ask for it. She plays with her 2 sibs most of the day, with ~low to sometimes medium energy, maybe a little more as she grows. Use the email below to reach out to her foster directly for more information or to set up a meet/greet.

 

- Email: adaywithfosters@gmail.com

- Pictures & Info: https://www.instagram.com/adaywithfosters

 

Cleo is equal in being socially forward with her sister but she’s also a little independent too… as she has her sibs to play with. She does kitten things throughout the day, first is play with her brother and sister but attention is welcome at any time. She purrs like motor boat when you talk to her, before you even pet her and she shows she’s paying attention with her big wide eyes… and once you pet her, you’re committed and she’ll headbutt you for more.

 

She and her sibs were strays and pretty darn scared at the world when I took them on… and now she’s become a kitten again. During the day she plays- zoom, wrestle and chase all toys and she plays with them interchangeably with whichever sib is closest. She loves all toys- string, ping-pong balls, pieces of cardboard, springs and flat crinkle toys… or she snoozes inside the cat tube. She’s learning and may come running when she hears a rattle mouse. She’s learning it’s ~OK to be picked up and still a work on progress… belly rubs too. She’s very gentle when you play and hand wrestle. If you pick her up when she’s playing or busy, she’s learning that it’s OK and takes it in and if she’s not ready to be held, politely squirm to get down… work in progress. She’s a nosey kitten and an explorer as she’s bigger and can jump higher. After playing and runs out of gas, she’ll nap most often on the cat tree in the sun, by the bird feeder, or lately on the middle of the bed all stretched out.

 

So far, she doesn’t talk much at all and has a very soft voice when it’s meal time. She’s learning to be confident and so her voice might grow, as she learns how to be a kitten again. She climbs a tall sisal cat tree very well through the day. She’ll make small air biscuits when you talk to her, purring even before you pet her. At night, she’s often the first up on the bed while I read, and hangs out close by. I talk to her and don’t pet while reading as once you do, reading is out and she’ll headbutt and walk back/forth for more. I think she would do OK as a solo kitten for someone who works from home to give her a lot of attention, as she opens up and she’s less shy. She would do very well with either of her sibs- Layla 30952 or Dante 30953 for someone who wants a sibling pair. I also think she would also do very well with a family who has a cat or kitten who wants a playmate… even a dog who would like an energetic playmate.

 

She is perfect with the litter box and it’s hard to tell if she covers or not with three kittens. She’s pretty good with getting her nails trimmed when she’s sleepy and can easily get the front ones done… so we trim frequently to make it routine. She’s she hasn’t met many new people yet, just a few friends so she might be a little shy around new folks… and hoping she warms up quickly with toys. I think she would do fine with children once used to their energy. Cleo is fine w/ my older cat and sometimes wants to cuddle and still working up the courage to try. I have no idea if she’s met a dog, but think she would do OK with a one once she gets used to them, after slow introductions.

name: Angus
description_html: Angus came into the shelter with his sister when their owner passed away. He's had a rough time transitioning to shelter life. He's very shy and confused, which is common in these situations. In the home, Angus was a sensitive, affectionate boy who thrived with love and attention. The shelter isn't a home, so it's hard to provide that. We'd love to see him in foster care to help him regain his confidence and be able to relax with consistent daily care. Angus may do best in a calm, patient home that lets him come out of his shell at his own pace.

name: Fiona
description_html:
Fiona Deserves a Home Again 🩷


Nine-year-old Fiona has found herself at the shelter through no fault of her own. Her beloved owner passed away, and sadly, there was no family member able to take her in. With no one left to tell us her story, we don’t know much about Fiona’s life before this.

What we do know is that after spending her whole life in a home, the shelter is no place for a senior kitty. She is shy here but gets comfort from human interaction. She loves head scratches, will make biscuits, and purrs.

At nine years old, Fiona deserves a soft bed, a quiet place to decompress, and someone who will give her the patience and love she needs to feel safe again. She has already lost the person she knew as home. Please help us find Fiona a home she will never have to leave.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Fiona and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Ben
description_html:
Meet Ben! 🐾


Ben is the sweetest, most cuddly boy you could ever meet! He’s a young, energetic pup with a huge heart who absolutely loves being around his people. If you’re looking for a dog who will happily curl up in your lap, soak up all the love, and then be ready to play, Ben may be your perfect match.

Ben is the perfect medium size — big enough to be a fun adventure buddy but small enough to fit right in wherever you go. He’s treat-motivated and incredibly eager to learn, making him easy to train. After just a few days in his foster home, he’s already picking up on basic commands!

Ben is currently in foster with an 80-lb Boxer mix, and the two of them get along fantastically. He loves having a canine friend and has shown no signs of aggression or resource guarding in his foster home.

He’s playful, affectionate, silly, and incredibly loving. But his favorite thing might just be cuddling up with his people and getting as close as possible. ❤️

If you’re looking for a young, energetic puppy who loves to play and thinks he’s a lap dog, Ben is the one! He’s smart, loving, treat-motivated, dog-friendly, and ready to find his forever family.

name: Papucho
description_html:
Papucho is an absolute joy! This handsome, gentle guy is easygoing, slightly less shy, and loves nothing more than moseying along on a walk or sniffing around the play yard. He is a loose-leash walker, neutral with both people and dogs, and simply enjoys exploring at his own pace.


Papucho is bonded with Perlay, and their sweet connection is impossible to miss. When she was startled by a loud bark, Papucho immediately checked in on her. They clearly came from a loving home and have so much love to give in return. We would love to see these two stay together!


Papucho is housetrained, laid-back, independent, and leash trained. He’s an absolute sweetheart and would be a wonderful companion for the lucky person who takes him home.

name: Vivienne
description_html:
Vivienne Didn’t Deserve to Be Left Behind 💔


Vivienne was found abandoned in an apartment. She is microchipped, and we made every effort to reach her owner, but sadly, our calls and messages went unanswered.


Now this sweet girl is left trying to make sense of a world that suddenly changed. Vivienne is understandably confused and scared, but underneath that uncertainty is a sweet girl who deserves to feel safe again.


What Vivienne needs now is someone who will be patient with her, give her time to decompress, and most importantly, never give up on her. ❤️

name: Konrad
description_html: Konrad is a sweet and handsome boy with glorious perk-eared style and a heart full of play! With his warm amber eyes and bright, happy smile, he is always ready for his next big adventure. Konrad already knows "sit" and will happily show it off, especially if a tasty treat is involved—food motivation at its finest, which should make building trust and learning new things a lot of fun! Out on walks, he is a dream, strolling easily on the leash, enjoying sniffing and exploring. He is very house-trained and also does great in a crate. Whether you want a fun playmate for the yard or a loyal buddy for neighborhood walks, Konrad is ready to bring joy to his forever home.

name: Sister
description_html:
MEET SISTER: YOUR FUTURE LAP-DOG & PROFESSIONAL SUNBATHING QUEEN! ☀️💗


Hi! I’m Sister. I had a rough start on the streets of Austin with my siblings, but living in my foster home has shown me just how wonderful life can be. I’m a sweet, gentle girl who can be a bit shy at first, but once I warm up, my goofy, wiggle-worm personality completely shines!


WHY MY FOSTER SAYS I’M THE ULTIMATE LOVE BUG:

  • Housebroken & Kennel Trained: I’m a total pro with my routine! Whenever I'm in my kennel, you'll hear my little tail happily thumping away against the dog bed.
  • Smart & Eager to Learn: I’ve already mastered "sit," "come," and "kennel up," and I'm currently practicing "down" and "stay."
  • Pack Tested & Approved: I live with my brother Toast and two older resident dogs who help me build my confidence! I thrive in a multi-dog household and love taking my cues from other pups.
  • Patio Approved: I’ve done wonderfully out on dog-friendly patios! I can be a little nervous around fast things on wheels (like bikes or shopping carts), but my foster family is helping me learn the world isn't so scary.


MY DAILY VIBE: My motto is "play hard, sleep harder!" I love running around with other dogs, but my ultimate favorite thing in the whole world is basking in the warm sun. If there is a patch of sunshine, that's where you'll find me!

When playtime is over, my signature move is walking up to you, wiggling my whole body, and resting my chin right on your lap while you read or watch TV.

name: Toast
description_html:
MEET TOAST: YOUR FUTURE BEER GARDEN & SUNBATHING BUDDY! ☀️🍺

Hi! I’m Toast. I had a rough start on the streets of Austin, but living in my foster home has shown me just how wonderful life can be. I can be a little shy when we first meet, but give me just a moment to warm up and my sweet, fun-loving personality shines right through!


  • Housebroken & Kennel Trained: I’m a total pro with my house manners! I go right into my kennel for meals/treats and sleep quietly through the night.
  • Smart Cookie: I LOVE to learn! I’ve already mastered "sit," "lie down," "paw," and "roll over." Right now, we’re practicing "leave it" and "wait."
  • Total Gentleman on Leash: I'm an easy, chill walking buddy who won't drag you down the street!
  • Social & Beer-Garden Approved: I’ve done wonderfully out at local Austin spots! I love playing hard with my foster dog siblings (my specialty is stealthily "stalking" them in the backyard during playtime).


MY DAILY VIBE: I’m an easy-going guy with the perfect mix of fun and chill. I love a quick game of fetch, a neighborhood stroll, or sunbathing in the yard when it's warm out.

My absolute favorite thing, though? Couch time. I love curling up next to you while you drink your morning coffee, watch football on Sundays, or, no joke, sit with my foster siblings to watch Bluey on TV! 📺🐶

name: Stroop
description_html:
Meet Stroop (short for Stroopwafel)! 🧇

Weight: 55 lbs

Found Near: Barton Springs Pool area on 08/04

Stroop is a happy, gentle guy who has been a joy to foster. He weighs about 55 lbs, loves people, and makes friends everywhere he goes.


Personality & Household:

• House Trained: Fully house-trained with zero accidents.

• Night Routine: Sleeps quietly through the whole night.

• Home Alone: Free-roams during the day without any issues. No crate needed.

• Energy Level: Medium energy. He enjoys daily walks and playtime, then settles down easily.

• Dog Friendly: Gets along well with other dogs and currently lives with a resident dog.


Leash & Training:

Stroop is very food motivated, so training him is easy and rewarding. He is still working on leash manners. He gets excited when he sees squirrels, rabbits, or other dogs on walks because he wants to go say hi, but it is purely friendly excitement.


Health & Medical:

• Vaccinated (Rabies, Distemper, Parvo)

• Heartworm Negative

• Up-to-date on Flea & Tick preventatives

• Scheduled to be neutered via Austin Animal Center

(Note: Stroop has not been tested around cats or young kids yet.)

If you are looking for a cheerful, friendly companion, Stroop is ready to meet you!

name: Baby
description_html:
Baby may be little, but she has a BIG personality! This spunky girl loves to explore, play, and go on "hunts" for her favorite toys. Her top treasures? Tiny mice and jingle balls that she can proudly carry around in her mouth like the little hunter she is. 🐭✨

When playtime is over, Baby's favorite place to be is right with her people. She's a champion snuggler who will happily curl up on your chest for hours, purring away and soaking up all the love. 💕

Baby gets along wonderfully with her foster's resident cats and would likely thrive in a home with another friendly feline companion. She can be a little shy when meeting new people and may need some time to feel comfortable in a new environment, but once she trusts you, her sweet personality truly shines.

She's currently enjoying a mix of wet and dry food and has excellent litter box manners. If you're looking for a playful little adventurer who also happens to be a professional cuddler, Baby might be the perfect addition to your family! 🐾❤️

name: Margo
description_html: Margo is such a sweet, spunky girl. She loves to play and is slowly learning to snuggle. It doesn’t take her too long to warm up and will be happy with a small or big family!

name: Gator
description_html: Hi, I’m new here! My friends are still learning about me. If you have questions or would like to meet me, feel free to reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Kona
description_html:
Follow Kona's Progress On Instagram


Kona is a sweet & playful puppy who's ready to love her people. She settles down really well at night after some exercise, and sleeps quietly on a bed or in her crate area next to you. She also appears potty trained! She’s shy towards people, but once she gets to know them she seems to really open up. She also hasn’t seemed to meet a dog she doesn’t like, and she’s played great with her foster siblings!

Like many young dogs adjusting to new environments, she's still working on a couple of things. She's learning that the world outside the backyard isn't so scary. Neighborhood walks and the car are new and a little overwhelming for her right now. She's already shown how quickly she learns, and with a little patience, she's going to love going on adventures. While at her fosters' she'll continue to work hard on these things, and on basic obedience commands.

What she needs most is someone who understands that trust and confidence grow with kindness, consistency, and encouragement. In return, you'll get a loyal companion who wants nothing more than to be by your side. She also I think would love a confident sibling to play with and maybe help her see that walks are pretty awesome too!

If you're a patient family who is wanting to help give a young dog a new "leash" on life, she'd love to meet you!

name: Rabbit
description_html: Rabbit is a sweet kitten looking for a loving lap to live in. He is the epitome of a calm cuddle kitty. While it is unknown how he would do in a home with other pets, he does very well with kids - even young kids. Based on his personality, he would likely do great in any house as long as there is a lap of a person willing to provide pets.

name: Bentley
description_html:
🐾 Bentley is still waiting for his person. 🤎

 

Bentley arrived with his three siblings, and one by one, they found their homes. Now he’s the last of his litter, patiently waiting for someone to notice him.


He may be a shy brown tabby, and he may need a little time to come out of his shell. But underneath that initial shyness is a sweet, affectionate kitten just waiting to feel safe enough to show you who he really is.


His intake notes called him “flighty but sweet,” and we think that says it all. He’s the kitten who needs someone willing to sit with him, earn his trust, and discover the incredibly loving companion hiding behind those cautious eyes.

 

💔 Please don’t let being a shy brown tabby be the reason Bentley gets overlooked. He has been here for over a month!

name: Bella
description_html: Bella is a sweet little lady of less than 30 lbs who came into the shelter needing safety and while there became sick with a common dog cold. It became stubborn and Bella needed some extra time and care to recover. She's left for a foster home to finish feeling better in comfort and we've matched her with care from Classic Canines. Now she's having the time of her life, enjoying the sun on the deck, going on trips with her foster caregivers, and having doggy ice cream. Bella will soon be ready for adoption so if you're interested in adding a gentle, sweet lady dog to your home, submit your inquiry so we can be in touch! We think she'll be very open to having a small animal friend or two.

name: Mischief
description_html: Want a kitten with a story? This little guy survived a mass murder event when some psychopath started poisoning cats with anti-freeze in the neighborhood where he was born. Snatched off the street with his siblings, Mischief has shown that is name is really just for play. He is a little lover boy and so ready for his forever home! Mischief is also a tiny little guy, just a babby, but don't call him a runt! He runs this place. He enjoys the good wet food, bossing around his much bigger siblings, and pretending to be mad about pets (he isn't). Mischief would do best in a home with other cats or with one of his siblings. Despite his rough start to life, Mischief is ready for shenanigans at your home. Pro with the litter box and loves some evening zoomies. Fixed and up to date on his shots. Somebody come get him. He's ready.

name: Peace
description_html: Want a kitten with a story? Peace has shown everyone that, despite his rough start in life, he is ready to open his heart and love. This little guy survived a mass murder event when some psychopath started poisoning cats with anti-freeze in the neighborhood where he was born.
