Peace takes a minute to warm-up, but he loves the good wet food and gentle head scratches. He would do great in a home with another cat. Never misses the litter box and fixed.

name: Smudge
description_html: A bit shy and sassy at first, but once she feels comfortable with you she LOVES to be pet!

name: Sigourney (petco)
description_html:
Sigourney is available for adoption at Petco Lakeline! Go there to meet her.


Sigourney did everything a good mom should do—now she deserves a home of her own. 💕🐾


She arrived at the shelter with her two kittens, a little scared but caring for them beautifully. Both kittens have since been adopted, but Sigourney is still waiting. She’s a young, sweet cat with so much love left to give. After raising her babies, she deserves a safe, loving home where she can finally relax and enjoy sleeping on sofas and watching the world go by. She is extremely affectionate, loves pets and cuddles and has seemed relaxed around other cats.


Please don’t overlook this laid-back mama. Come meet Sigourney today!❤️🏡

name: Monte
description_html:
The shelter is no place for a 13-year old cat. 💔🐾

Meet Monte, a sweet senior boy who arrived as a stray. He’s clearly been someone’s beloved companion. But instead of a cozy home, Monte is spending his days in a kennel—and he deserves so much more.

Senior cats like Monte have endless love to give. He just needs a soft place to land, a warm bed, and a family to spend his golden years with. Please don’t let Monte wait any longer. He is available for foster or adoption. Come meet him today! ❤️🏡

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Monte and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Gertie
description_html:
🐾 Siblings Still Waiting for Their Chance 🐾


Meet Louie and Gertie! These siblings arrived with three other kittens, and all five came down with upper respiratory infections. Thankfully, they’ve recovered—and their three siblings have already been adopted. ❤️


Now it’s their turn.


Louie, the only boy, is so playful. He's also an escape artist--he hast busted out of his kennel, twice! Gertie is the shyest. It took us a while, but we finally got a better picture of her than her intake picture where she looks terrified. She just needs a little extra patience to feel safe and confident.


These two kittens have been through a lot and are ready for someone to give them a chance to blossom. Could you be the person they’ve been waiting for? They can be adopted separately together! 🏡🐱

name: Buck
description_html:
Buck’s former family summed up his best quality in three words: “Good dog, period.” This friendly, energetic boy is house-trained and reportedly did well when left alone for short periods, whether he was loose in the home or chilling in a crate.


Buck loves practically every dog activity he has encountered: fetch, tug-of-war, chase, walks, squeaky toys, and chew bones. He already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'come' and will be happiest with a family ready to provide regular exercise, playtime, and opportunities to keep learning.


Buck also has excellent dog experience. He previously lived with another large dog successfully and during his shelter playgroup evaluation, he offered polite greetings and quickly settled into soft play with the other dogs. Buck could be a wonderful addition to a multi-dog home—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


His former owner also described him as playful with cats. Slow introductions and thoughtful supervision would still be important in a new home. As a young dog, Buck can be exuberant. His enthusiasm should be a great match for an active adopter looking for a cheerful playmate and adventure partner. Looking to add a new adventure buddy to your family? Come meet this sweet pup!

name: Pickles
description_html:
Meet Pickles!

She’s a six-month-old female Plott Hound mastering the art of being a total goofball. If you are looking for a pup who combines the soul of an outdoor adventurer with couch-potato energy, Pickles is your gal.

She spends her days keeping up with her foster brother, a Border Collie named Finn. If you have another dog who loves to wrestle, play tag, and then immediately pass out on the floor, they will be fast friends.

Big music lover; her foster found “Classical Bangers” on Spotify really does it for her. 

She’d be a great addition to any home :)

name: Ghostbuster
description_html:
Ghostbuster is one super sweet boy with an especially impressive talent: he is VERY, VERY, VERY housetrained! He enjoys sniffing and exploring, has a laid-back, playful personality, and is treat motivated. He walks well with only mild pulling and has a nice medium-energy vibe.


Ghostbuster is independent but affectionate, knows tricks, and is already showing himself to be a lovely companion. He may be a little more reserved in his kennel, but once out and exploring, he is a sweet, happy guy. He’s still getting to know his handlers, so more interaction will help his personality shine even more.


If you’re looking for a playful, laid-back, housetrained pup, Ghostbuster deserves a chance to bust his way into your heart!

name: Kevin
description_html:
Meet Kevin!


Kevin came to us from a home with more cats than anyone could count and arrived absolutely terrified. So terrified, in fact, that we thought he was a girl and named him, Karen. But he’s not that type of Karen, neither by gender nor attitude!


While being treated for an upper respiratory infection, something beautiful happened: Kevin started to blossom. 🌸 Little by little, he came out of her shell, and now he seeks affection and is showing us the sweet cat hiding underneath all that fear.


Kevin has been through so much and deserves a loving home where he can continue to build confidence and finally feel safe. This Kevin, formerly known as Karen, doesn’t want to speak to the manager—he just wants to speak to his forever family. 🥹

name: Grace
description_html:
Meet Grace — a shy girl who just needs a little… well, a little grace. ❤️


Like her kennel mate Karen, Grace came to us from a home with more cats than anyone could count. She arrived terrified and is still a very shy girl.


While being treated for an upper respiratory infection, Grace slowly became more comfortable with human contact. She’s still learning that people can be kind and that she’s safe. 


The good news? Grace is wonderful with other cats. She just needs a patient person who will let her take her time, respect her boundaries, and give her the love and grace she deserves.

name: Zoey
description_html:
Zoey lived in a home her entire life, and her owner described her as playful and friendly. She sometimes likes to be by herself, but otherwise she’s a lap cat. She is shy with new people, and is especially afraid of men (although she will eventually warm to them).


Zoey is very much enjoying the apartment lifestyle in foster care after having a really hard time at the shelter. She is a sweetheart, makes a great couch buddy and also loves to play fetch! Her foster is currently working with the vet to determine the right diet to help her shed her love handles.


Zoey needs a quiet environment as the only pet with someone who will give her plenty of time to relax while ensuring she gets some daily activity and exercise! Once she decompresses, she will be a wonderful companion.


I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!


The adoption fee is waived for Zoey and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Murphy Lee
description_html: Murphy Lee is a smart, treat-motivated little guy who knows how to sit and is very easy to bathe. He is a strong puller on leash, so an Easy Walk harness would be helpful. He can be a little jumpy and easily distracted, but he’s a fun, medium-energy pup who would make a great Doggie Day Out companion. He also seems to be housetrained!

name: Eduardo
description_html:
Eduardo is a new member of our Cactus Cat family! He's not spicy, he's just a scaredy cat in new situations. But, all you have to do is offer a hand and he will gladly accept pets and relax. He loves his cat friends so he may do best with a cat companion in his new home.

Eduardo is a former community cat who was not thriving and may have actually been abandoned previously. His left eye is small or missing due to a chronic issue. It's not giving him trouble now but his vision is likely limited to the right eye.

Eduardo needs a calm place to relax and come out of his shell at his own pace. He's a loving and affectionate boy with people he knows, and having a cat friend will likely speed up his acclimation.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Eduardo and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Wyatt
description_html:
Wyatt LOVES other cats, and will be happiest with a cat buddy! He also likes people, but he’s a little shy at first. He is a former community cat, and when he was brought to AAS, x-rays revealed a fracture to his left front leg. Because the injury was older, surgical correction was not an option.

Wyatt moved into a foster home for medical management (including weeks of crate rest). Follow up x-rays confirmed that the fracture has formed a good bony callous, and we don’t anticipate any issues in the future (he must live indoors). 

Wyatt needs a quiet environment, and some time to warm up. He likes being petted, but if you pet him too long, he’ll give a little nip or simply walk away.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Wyatt and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Banana Cream
description_html:
Banana Cream is a shy-at-first sweetheart with a playful puppy hiding just beneath the surface. New situations can make her uncertain, but once she has a little time to settle in, she begins to show a much sillier side—play bows, soft puppy mouthing, and all.


Her first shelter playgroup followed that same pattern. Banana Cream initially sat quietly with her tail tucked and was uncomfortable when dogs approached too quickly. As the session went on, she relaxed, began throwing play bows, and eventually joined fellow shelter pups Polly Pocket and Dakota for chase play. She was comfortable enough afterward to be paired with a doggy roommate.


Banana Cream is looking for people who understand that confidence doesn’t always appear instantly. She does best when she isn’t rushed and is allowed to investigate at her own pace. Once she decides she feels safe, she can be playful, engaging, and downright goofy.


She has potential to live with a well-matched dog, particularly one who won’t overwhelm her with an intense greeting. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs.


For an adopter who enjoys watching a shy dog blossom into herself, Banana Cream could be an incredibly rewarding companion. Come meet her today!

name: Marty
description_html:
Meet Marty, a gentle, resilient soul. His people lost their housing and life was tough. They surrendered Marty so he could fine a happier, healthier life ahead. He's catching up on his weight and polishing his skin. He'll be as good as new to match the trusting, affectionate, kind soul he's always been with years of wisdom behind him.

Marty is housetrained, walks well on loose leash and loves to sniff and explore. He's a gentle friend who stays by your side for walks and doesn't mind stopping and talking to friends and passing other dogs. He also knows some basic cues. At home he's house trained and crate trained.

Time is precious for a dog waiting to recapture his life outside of the shelter walls. Don't delay when a shelter dog like Marty is spending another night sleeping in the shelter.

name: Tink Tink
description_html:
🐾💗 Meet Tink Tink — a sweet girl looking for someone who will let her shine! 

Tink Tink came from a home with far too many cats, so it’s no surprise that she can be a little shy and cautious at first. The good news? She’s already shown us what a sweetheart she can be! 

During her time in foster, we learned that Tink Tink likes catnip and enjoys head, shoulder, and body pets. She may not be a fan of being picked up, and she can be a bit hidey while she gets comfortable — but give her time, patience, and a safe place to settle in, and she’ll start to show you her sweet side.

Tink Tink may also benefit from having a confident feline friend to help her come out of her shell. 

Could you be the patient, loving person who helps Tink Tink discover just how wonderful life can be?

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Tink Tink and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Zeb
description_html: Zeb loves pets, you just have to go slowly making friends! He is playful and snuggly once he gets to know you. He may enjoy a cat friend in the home to teach him all the fun ways to cat around the house. Shy babies make the most loyal companions! Meet Zeb today.

name: Stanley
description_html:
🐾 Stanley & Hydro have been waiting 60 days for a home. 💔


These sweet brothers came to us with their mom and another kitten, who has already been adopted. After battling an upper respiratory infection, Stanley and Hydro are now healthy and ready for a safe, indoor home.


They arrived very fearful, but never aggressive — just shy boys who need a little patience and time to trust. Sadly, kittens like them are often overlooked while the outgoing ones get adopted first.


Please don’t let Stanley & Hydro grow up at the shelter. They deserve a loving home where they can blossom. ❤️

name: Hydro
description_html:
🐾 Stanley & Hydro have been waiting 60 days for a home. 💔


These sweet brothers came to us with their mom and another kitten, who has already been adopted. After battling an upper respiratory infection, Stanley and Hydro are now healthy and ready for a safe, indoor home.


They arrived very fearful, but never aggressive — just shy boys who need a little patience and time to trust. Sadly, kittens like them are often overlooked while the outgoing ones get adopted first.


Please don’t let Stanley & Hydro grow up at the shelter. They deserve a loving home where they can blossom. ❤️

name: Eva
description_html:
Eva is a young dog that is understandably nervous of the loud shelter environment. Go slow and at her pace, and she will warm up with tail wags and playful zooms. She enjoys sniffing and exploring.


Eva is a sweet girl that is shy and she just crave chest scratches then it all changed. She'll happily seat there for hours when the scratches get going.

She is determined and gave me the smart girl vibes. She seems very interested in going to meet doggy friends.

name: Rumble
description_html:
Rumble is a sweet, playful guy with a serious love for fetch! He’s an energetic pup who gets very excited about playtime, but once he’s on leash or in the play yard, he settles in nicely and is fairly easy to handle.

He absolutely lights up when he sees a ball and will happily chase and retrieve it. He's sometimes silly and may try to carry two balls at once, but with a little direction, he can quickly figure out the game of fetch. Rumble is also housetrained, making him an even more appealing companion.

This lovable boy would thrive with someone who enjoys an active, playful dog and can help him channel his excitement into fun activities. Rumble is ready to bring plenty of fetch, sweetness, and enthusiasm to his forever home!

name: Linda
description_html:
💕 Meet Linda — A Little Girl Waiting for Someone to Believe in Her 


Linda is still learning that people can be safe. When she first arrived, she would hiss and run whenever someone approached. But thanks to the patience and kindness of our volunteers, Linda is making progress! 


She has already discovered that people can bring some pretty wonderful things — especially Churu! 😋 She’ll happily take a tasty treat from a tongue depressor and sometimes even from a finger.


Linda loves chasing mouse toys and having fun with her feline friends. Her sibling Kiki was recently adopted, and now Linda is waiting and wondering when her own forever family will come along. 💔


Linda needs someone who understands that trust takes time. But for the person willing to be patient, her first purr, first cuddle, or first moment of choosing to come closer will be incredibly special. We think Linda would thrive with a confident, friendly cat companion who can help show her the ropes and make her feel more secure.


Linda has become excellent at nose boops with churu from a finger. She also really enjoys when you play with straw toys with her. She is still wary of hands and still hissy. She seemed lonely without her sibling so I think she would benefit from having a cat buddy in her new home with a patient, cat savvy adopter.

name: Charming
description_html: Charming lives up to his name! Very sweet and loves zooming around with toys in the shelter’s play yard. He is very well mannered when being haltered and after some pulling to get his potty break out, he relaxes into an easy pace ready for an active walk. Come meet this sweet boy today!

name: Boss
description_html:
Boss is an affectionate, outdoors-loving dog whose greatest talents are cuddling and making people feel loved. He is friendly with the people he meets and is ready to join his new family for both adventures and quality snuggle time.


Boss is house-trained and has experience with home life. He already knows 'sit' and 'stay' and has been left alone for several hours and done well. His favorite activities include fetch, tug-of-war, chase, wrestling, and spending time outside.


Boss also has excellent dog experience. He previously lived successfully with a 40-pound male dog, and he regularly participates in shelter playgroups. He began with soft, polite greetings and light play and has since become confident enough to enjoy a more physical, vocal play style with other dogs. He may be a wonderful match for another playful dog; ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


Boss is still polishing his leash manners and may jump when excited, but his enthusiasm is matched by his affectionate nature. He is frightened by thunderstorms and would appreciate a quiet, comfortable place to retreat when the weather gets loud.

name: Lady
description_html:
Looking for a professional cuddler? Lady may have found her calling.


Lady is a gentle, laid-back girl who absolutely loves her people. Treats are fine (especially cheese!), but what really motivates Lady is affection. Her perfect day involves a nice walk followed by plenty of time curled up beside her favorite humans.


She has wonderful leash manners and is an easy, loose-leash walker. She has also been calm around other dogs on walks, including during parallel walking. At home, Lady is house-trained, low-key, and perfectly content spending much of her day snoozing.


Lady prefers an open crate where she can come and go rather than being confined behind a closed crate door. More than anything, she’s a people dog through and through and would love a home where she can be part of the family.


If you’re looking for a calm companion with an enormous capacity for cuddles, Lady would love to meet you.

name: Blanca
description_html:
Blanca is ready for a calmer life. She is wonderful with other cats, but came from a situation with a large number of felines. Shy and scared in the shelter, Blanca will need patience and time to acclimate to a new home.

She can sometimes be handled, and we think that in a quiet home with an experienced cat adopter, Blanca will eventually relax and be a wonderful companion.

Blanca’s best situation will be with one or two cat friends.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Blanca and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Maria
description_html:
Maria arrived at AAS with a large number of other cats from the same situation. She is very shy and scared, and tends to run and hide when humans approach (she has not been aggressive).

Given where she was living, Maria probably didn’t receive any attention or socialization. She needs an experienced cat person to give her the necessary time and patience for her to feel comfortable in her surroundings.

Maria’s best situation will be in a quiet home with at least one cat buddy. That friend can help her adjust and feel more confident.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Maria and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Brandy
description_html:
Brandy has been a very good dog staying in the overflow crate room while space is tight at the shelter. She gets out for 4 walks a day and is a nice walking dog on a leash and very pleasant to be with. She enjoys yard time and hamming it up with her new human friends.


She's a very good girl for veterinary handling procedures. She's in good condition with a beautiful coat of fur. She's vaccinated and heart worm negative and will be spayed before a final adoption.


Come meet this very lovely girl today.

name: Darcy
description_html:
Foster Needed for Darcy 💙


Darcy is looking for a temporary hero!


This sweet kitten arrived at the shelter as a stray with his brother, Bingley. After recovering from an upper respiratory infection, we discovered Darcy has an eye injury that needs continued care while we determine the best treatment.


Despite everything, Darcy remains playful, curious, and incredibly affectionate. His eye condition doesn’t slow him down—he’s just a happy kitten who loves attention and playtime.


Now that Bingley has been adopted, Darcy is recovering without his brother by his side. A foster home would give him a quiet, comfortable place to heal and help him feel safe while he waits for his forever family. Could you open your home to this precious boy and help Darcy heal with love?

name: Zaire
description_html:
If you're looking for an active, engaging companion with personality to spare, he’s ready to bring so much joy into your life.

This handsome guy loves to greet you with a happy hello and gets super excited to start his day. He harnesses up easily with a tasty treat and is a fantastic walking partner. While he’s eager to get moving, he shows off great loose-leash walking manners as soon as he hits his stride out on the trail.

With his playful energy, he’d make an incredible running buddy for outdoor adventures or a great candidate for fun doggy day outings. He thrives in the play yard and loves making the most of his outdoor time.

Ready for an adventurous, fun-loving best friend? Ask to meet him today!

name: Sampson
description_html:
Sampson was living in the community before he was rescued and brought to AAS. He had terrible dental disease, so he moved him into foster care until he could have dental surgery (all of his teeth were extracted). Sampson doesn’t have any teeth, but that doesn’t keep him from eating dry food. He made a complete recovery and must live indoors only. We don’t anticipate any future oral issues, but his eating habits and weight should be monitored to ensure that his mouth stays comfortable.


Sampson is very shy and timid, and tends to hide from humans. In his foster home, he could be petted in his safe place. He seemed to enjoy it, and was never aggressive, although sometimes he would hiss. He is a member of our Cactus Cats and is receiving confidence boosting. He is great with other cats, and should have a cat buddy. With time and patience, he will likely turn into a wonderful companion.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Sampson and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

SaveDiscard changes

name: Zera
description_html:
Looking for a soft and easy friend? Zera had a very large hanging mass removed and she's recovering well. She's spayed, heart worm negative and otherwise healthy. She goes at her own speed, in her own way, the way she's learned to adjust her body over time with well worn hips. She's the sweetest lady who loves being with one person, or being with a crowd - she loves all dogs, big and small. She has a great grasp of verbals too.


She's house trained and loves to pick her laying spots at home. She'll need a single story arrangement but she can handle curbs and a few stairs.

She'll need help getting in and out of a vehicle.


If you would like a soft older friend and don't mind eventually giving a full ride for this sweet caboose that will someday lead into the train station, but it's not here, not today, not near, we would like to talk to you. Reach out to her advocates at caring@classiccanines.org or apply on her link.


TAKE A LOOK AT HER "BEFORE" SHELTER VIDEO so you can appreciate how far she's come to be here today.

name: Josh
description_html:
Josh is a sweet, food-loving guy with great house manners and a softer side around other dogs. Shelter staff describe him as housetrained—he will hold it as long as possible until he can take care of business outside his kennel.


Josh is highly motivated by treats, which gives his future family a great tool for training. He can be enthusiastic and strong on leash, so continued work on walking skills will help turn outings into an even more enjoyable experience.


Josh has also shown promising social skills with other dogs. During shelter playgroup, he started out a little stiff and uncertain, but gradually relaxed enough to coexist comfortably and engage in some light, dainty play. He currently lives with a doggy roommate at the shelter, and has great potential to live with a compatible canine companion outside the shelter. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs. :)


Josh seems like the kind of dog who benefits from a little time to settle into a situation. Give him some treats, a chance to stretch his legs, and clear guidance, and this sweet boy is ready to keep learning.

name: Chandler
description_html:
Meet Chandler. 🖤


Shelter life is overwhelming for Chandler, and he can be quite shut down. But our volunteers haven’t given up on him. When you go slowly and let him set the pace, he begins to accept pets—and even offers the sweetest little head butts. 🥹❤️


Those moments are proof there’s a loving, trusting cat waiting to come out. This handsome boy needs someone willing to see the sweet cat hiding underneath his fear. He needs patience, understanding, and a calm home where he can feel safe. Imagine the day this scared boy finally realizes he’s home. 


Please don’t overlook Chandler. Give this beautiful boy a chance to show who he really is.

name: Benito
description_html:
Meet Benito ~ he's sure to charm you with his soft soul.

Did you know that older dogs know between 80-165 words? Benito's first language is Spanish, and English is quickly become his second language, making him bilingual too.

Benito works so nicely with staff and volunteers, enjoying his outings and every comfort and affection given, bonding so nicely with the people who are so kind to him. He's very housetrained and great on a leash. He's sharing his kennel space nicely with a dog friend. Come meet him and see how you can be his VIP. He'll repay you many times over in affections and loyalty.

name: Botanicus
description_html:
Meet Botanicus, a gentle soul with a heart of gold who is looking for a quiet place to heal. Despite dealing with a rough skin condition that makes him look a bit scruffy right now, his sweet and loving personality shines through every single day. He does not let a little itchiness get in the way of being the best boy possible.

Botanicus is dog-friendly and loves the company of other pups, which might be just the comfort he needs while he gets better. He is looking for a temporary foster home where he can receive his medication, regular meals, and a cozy spot to rest his weary head. If you have some extra love and a corner of your home to spare, Botanicus will pay you back in endless gratitude and gentle tail wags.

name: Knox
description_html:
Knox is a very happy-go-lucky boy who was found on the streets wearing a green harness and dragging a green leash. We wish we knew his story. He stayed two months with a foster finder. while awaiting an intake appointment. He didn't live with other animals during that time. He stayed home alone 9-12 hours free roaming without ever causing any troubles.

Knox has been staying in the crate room at the shelter and frankly he's pretty over that arrangement. He's not a fan lately of returning to his crate. We can't blame him. It's not comfortable to stay in 24 hrs a day. And Knox likes his precious sleep - at about 8pm he simply reserves the right to rest and not have to get up and go out.

Knox had a fresh bath on 6/13 and his coat is so gorgeous and silky black. We would love to get him back into a cool and comfy home ASAP. See his intro video here

Are you ready to help Knox? Come in person between 11-6.

Offsite questions? Reach out to his advocates at caring@classiccanines.org

name: Portia
description_html:
Portia is an easygoing, big, beautiful girl with a stunning brindle coat that is sure to turn heads wherever she goes. This gorgeous pup is the ultimate package, bringing the perfect balance of affection and playfulness to every single day. Whether you are looking for a fun-loving partner for backyard games or a sweet companion to cuddle up with on the couch, Portia fits the bill perfectly.

Not only is she incredibly charming, but she is also a smart cookie who already knows how to "shake" hands to introduce herself. Portia is ready to bring her bright spirit and endless affection to a forever home. Meet this wonderful girl today—she’s waiting to show you her favorite trick!

name: Pip Squeak
description_html:
Meet Pip Squeak! 🐾


Don't let his tiny size fool you—Pip Squeak has a big personality! As the little runt of the litter, he's learned that the best way to get attention is with his adorable, chatty meows. Whether he's asking for cuddles, reminding you it's mealtime, or simply telling you about his day, Pip always has something to say.


This sweet little guy loves to play just as much as he loves to snuggle. When the zoomies are over, you'll often find him curled up with his foster siblings, proving that life is always better with a friend nearby. He's a champion cuddler with a gentle heart and would thrive in a home with another friendly cat to be his built-in best buddy.


Pip Squeak is also a litter box superstar and is ready to bring endless purrs, playful antics, and loving companionship to his forever family. If you're looking for a tiny shadow who will happily chat with you and then curl up by your side (or with his feline friend), Pip Squeak is your guy! ❤️


Check out my foster mom’s insta: @jamiethekittenfoster_atx for more pics and vids!

name: Fusilli
description_html:
Meet Fusilli! If you’re searching for a sweet, soulful companion who shines wherever she goes, Fusilli is guaranteed to capture your heart.

While she can be a little shy at first, it only takes a few quiet minutes and a couple of yummy treats for her to warm right up.

Fusilli harnesses up easily, walks like a pro on the leash, and even loves keeping up with a fun little trot. She also happens to be deaf, but you’d hardly notice because she is so tuned into her human and handles the world like an absolute supermodel.

If you’re ready to welcome a polite, gorgeous, and loving girl into your home, ask to meet Fusilli today!

name: Kiwi
description_html:
Kiwi was an outdoor kitty in a rural area who ended up at the shelter when her caregiver passed away. She's knows the kindness of strangers and appreciates a soft approach.

She loves the company of other cats and should go to a home with cat friends to help her ease into a new space. Kiwi could especially benefit from having a confident, social cat to model brave behaviors for her.

Kiwi would do well in a low traffic home without small children; someplace she can come out of her shell at her own pace.

Kiwi is a Cactus Cat for her extreme shyness so she needs a cat savvy adopter to help her on the next leg of her journey.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Kiwi and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Oakley
description_html:
Per Oakley's former foster:

In the week that I have had Oakley, I have gotten to see more and more of his sweet and gentle personality come out as he becomes comfortable in my home. He is a very loving boy who accepts affection and once he trusts you, will start seeking you out for belly rubs and attention.

He has a moderate activity level and is just as happy lounging in the sunshine, taking a nap or he is playing with his favorite toys. He especially loves squeaky toys, balls, and soft/ padded frisbees, and he prefers to carry a toy or ball with him on walks (will often pick up a toy and drop it at the door for me to pick it up and will look at me to give it to him). He is food and toy motivated, which makes him a great candidate for continued training despite being an adult. He does good with sitting and waiting for an “okay” to eat, recommend a slow feeder as he likes to eat like there’s no tomorrow.

He walks well both on leash and off, does well in the car, and has shown that he can be left alone with no concerns. While alone, he mostly spends his time sleeping and relaxing (I keep a camera where I can see and monitor how he does when left alone). He also does well off leash and is good at staying close to me. His name recall could use some work at the moment, but he responds well to whistles and kissing noises and is very attentive when out.

Oakley is friendly and curious when meeting people while on walks/ at the park and is generally happy to approach and say hello. He does very well around other dogs and has shown that he can share toys with no issues. He occasionally tucks his tail when he feels nervous, and loud noises from large trucks, buses, semis, and moving trucks can make him uneasy both in the car and on walks. He generally doesn’t bark, but he may make low sounds in response to fear or being unsure.

Oakley is also a great communicator especially when he needs to go outside, he’ll often look toward the door or respond when asked if he wants to go potty.

He is a loving boy who seems to blossom with patience, unconditional love, consistency, and reassurance. He does take a little time to fully open up, but once he does, his sweet and affectionate personality makes it easy to see what a special companion he can be!

name: Oliver
description_html:
Oliver is the kind of dog who quietly works his way into your heart. He's been a favorite of mine since he first arrived at the shelter, and it's been so rewarding to watch his confidence grow with every outing.

If there's one way to win Oliver over, it's with a toy! Fetch is his absolute favorite game, and toys are definitely his love language. He happily brings them back without being grabby, and he loves carrying one along on walks like his own little comfort stuffie. While treats aren't a huge motivator for him, toss him a ball and you've got his full attention.

Oliver is very housetrained, walks nicely on a loose leash with only mild pulling, and enjoys taking his time to sniff and explore while checking in often with his person. He's neutral around other dogs and people, making him an easy companion for adventures. He even seems happy to coexist with other dogs rather than feeling the need to be the center of attention.

Oliver can be a little shy when meeting new people, so he appreciates a patient, go-slow introduction. Once he knows you, though, he's eager to head out for fun. He's an independent guy who doesn't demand constant affection, but he'll happily share his love through games of fetch and quiet companionship.

If you're looking for a playful, housetrained, toy-loving buddy who will happily carry his favorite toy wherever life takes him, Oliver just might be your perfect match.

name: Holly
description_html:
If you have a lot of experience with cats, then Pinecone might be perfect for you! She was living as a community cat in an unsafe environment, and she and several other kittens (including Mistletoe) were rescued and brought to AAS.

Pinecone is not comfortable with humans, so she will need time and patience to adjust to a new household and to new people. She is very scared in the shelter, so we would LOVE to see her out of the kennel, either through adoption or foster.

Pinecone is wonderful with other cats, and needs to have a cat buddy in her quiet home, someone she can play and cuddle with.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Pinecone and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Bodi
description_html:
Bodi is the perfect mix of adventure buddy and laid-back companion. He's housetrained, walks beautifully on leash once he's past the excitement of leaving his kennel, and loves taking his time to sniff and explore the world around him. He may pull a bit at first, but quickly settles into an easy, loose-leash walk with plenty of check-ins with his handler.


This handsome boy knows "sit," enjoys tasty treats, and absolutely melts for a good head scratch. While he may bark as he exits his kennel, he remains neutral to both people and other dogs on walks, making him an enjoyable companion for outings. Bodi especially loves spending time in the play yard, where his playful side shines.


If you're looking for a medium-energy dog who's affectionate without being clingy, enjoys exploring, and is ready to join you on walks or relaxing afternoons, Bodi is ready to meet you!

name: Princesa
description_html:
Meet Princesa ~ life tossed her a curve ball when she lost her longtime home due to her owner's hardship, marking the start of a major transition in life.

Princesa is affectionate, house trained, crate trained and walks nicely on a leash. She loves taking walks. She has lived with a male dog about the same size as her for part of her life and shared a kennel at the shelter with a male dog See them together in their kennel here . She's now in a foster home with another dog. She co-exists nicely and respectfully.

She's spayed, vaccinated, heart worm negative. She checks all the boxes of an easy care friend for your home, just click on her inquiry link to check in with her foster provider directly.

She's advocated for by her friends at ClassicCaninesATX who give an extra level of care and support for the mature dogs that are often the most rounded choices for so many homes.

name: Artie
description_html: Artie is one of the happiest boys you will ever meet! He loves people and other dogs and will wag his tail so hard you won't doubt it. He loves to play but will also settle down when it's time. He does great in a crate and will even go in on his own. He already knows how to sit and recently learned how to go up the stairs. Don't let the muscles fool you - he is a sensitive boy who is still learning that the world doesn't have to be such a scary place. All he really wants is someone to love and cuddle with him!

name: Bunuelo
description_html:
Meet Bunuelo! Just like the golden-brown, fried pastry he’s named after, this handsome pup is as sweet as they come. With a warm, cinnamon-colored coat that matches his sunny personality, Bunuelo is guaranteed to brighten every single day. 

He’s the total package: very playful when it’s time to romp around, but an absolute world-class cuddler when you’re ready to relax on the couch. This smart guy already knows "sit" and is always eager to show off his good manners for a tasty treat! Ready to add a little extra sweetness to your life? Bunuelo can’t wait to meet you!

name: Lalita
description_html:
Lalita is a sweet, affectionate girl who doesn't take long to make a new friend. She quickly warmed up and happily stayed close for cuddles and pets, showing off her cheerful, easygoing personality. She enjoys checking in with her handler during walks, loves exploring and sniffing, and only shows mild pulling on leash.


Lalita has a high interest in squirrels and may pull to chase them, but she redirects well with treats and gets right back to enjoying her walk. If you're looking for a happy companion who loves affection, treats, and spending time with her people, Lalita is ready to meet you!

name: Honey Bee
description_html:
Honey Bee is shy when first meeting new people, but she soon decides you are friends and that is where the fun begins!

Honey Bee is hilarious, zooming around a play yard while smacking her own face with a toy. She loves the kiddie pools especially in the Texas heat! Once she burns off a little energy she’s more than content to just come lay down by her human friends and hang out, occasionally asking for a few pets.

Honey Bee is constantly exploring and smelling for new things. Like a real little bumble bee, Honey Bee goes from tree to tree, grass patch to grass patch and sniffs all of the messages the world has to offer. This is her favorite - the walkies.

Honey Bee seems very house trained and is ready to find a forever family!

We'd love to learn more about her in foster care, or find her a forever home!

name: Jeeta
description_html: Jeeta is a cutie! She is a friendly, spunky young dog who loves to sniff and explore on her walks, watch for squirrels and run around the play yard. Jeeta is a curious, agile pup who knows tricks and gently takes treats. She gets along well with her kennel mate and is quiet and affectionate. Sweet Jetta is a fun companion ready for her forever home. 🏠

name: Tyson
description_html: Tyson is great on a leash and loves a walk! He loves to give cuddles at any time. He loves toys and knows "sit" and "stay" in Spanish. He's very friendly and affectionate! Very good boy.

name: Fuji
description_html:
Fuji is an active, curious boy who enjoys getting out to explore the world with his nose. He appears to be housetrained and loves spending his walks sniffing new scents and investigating his surroundings. He's also food motivated, making treats a great way to build a bond with him.


While he enjoys time in the play yard, he's more interested in exploring than playing and will happily let you know when he's ready to head out.


He especially loves the friends he makes! He always gets excited to see his volunteer buddies.

name: Athena
description_html:
Athena arrived at AAS with a large number of other cats from the same situation (Samantha also came from here). She is very shy and scared, and tends to run and hide when humans approach (she has not been aggressive).

Given where she was living, Athena probably didn’t receive any attention or socialization. She needs an experienced cat person to give her the necessary time and patience for her to feel comfortable in her surroundings.

Athena’s best situation will be in a quiet home with at least one cat buddy. That friend can help her adjust and feel more confident.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Athena and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Luna
description_html:
Don’t let her Resting Mad Face fool you - Luna is a sweet and playful pint-size princess! She loves to play with her spring toys, have her neck rubbed, and to watch the summer bugs at the window while you work.

She may have had a difficult start to life, and is a bit on the sensitive side when in a new place or meeting new people. But don’t worry, once she’s settled she’ll let you know she runs the place! Unsure how she might be with other cats, but she definitely doesn’t want to share her space with a dog. Will she find her forever home with you?

name: Lupe Fiasco
description_html:
Lupe has a gentle soul and a heart full of love. He already knows "sit" and "shake," and he's happy to show off his excellent manners for treats and praise. He adores people and is happiest when he's snuggled up for affections, doling out the kisses.

Lupe is happiest just being near his people, wherever that may take you and he, whether at home or on walks or outings. He's easy on a leash and a good car rider. He's also great for bathing after adventures. Your new loyal friend is suitable for apartment, condo or home living, just set up his comfy space and call him home. He's heart worm negative, vaccinated, neutered and ready to leave right away. He'll be looking to you to see if his future is reflecting back to him. See you soon?

name: Melos
description_html:
After years of a comfy home life, Melos has found himself at the shelter when his former owner wasn't allowed to have pets at their new home. While the shelter was loud and scary at first, he is finding his confidence again and has really started to come out of his shell!


Melos loves walks and is fantastic on leash, showing no prey drive or strong pulling. With humans he's not jumpy or all over you, he likes to be a coexister. He seeks affection from all his friends! He loves a kiddie pool to beat the Texas heat but will also settle for a squeaky pig dog toy to pass the time. He mainly loves to just explore all the smells and people watch when he can. Melos also loves a good treat or two. Melos is also very housetrained!


Come meet Melos today!

name: Rhiannon
description_html:
Rhiannon's foster says: "Rhiannon is an extremely affectionate girl who loves being around people! She does well with her foster brother and takes corrections well. She does have a lot of puppy energy and so benefits from structure and activities to keep her entertained. I crate her when I’m out as her curious puppy energy will find something to do :). She is crate trained and doesn’t make a peep. She hasn’t been around cats or children. She may have a prey drive and might not be best suited with cats. Due to her puppy nature, I think any children should be pre teen or older. She is happiest being snuggled up next to you."


Rhiannon is looking for a sitter to stay out of the shelter from 8/31-9/4: https://trello.com/c/GFNd4jlz

name: Butternut
description_html:
Butternut is a big goofball still learning what "home" means — and loving every second. Found as a stray in May, he's spent his first foster weeks mastering stairs (terrifying at first, now his favorite activity), circling his blanket into the perfect nest, and going full tripod when he pees. He's got the kind of soulful, can't-look-away puppy-dog eyes set in the squishiest head you'll ever cup in your hands — and if you sit on the floor near him, he'll flop over and roll straight into your lap for love. Fair warning: he's 57 lbs of pure marshmallow.


He's sweet, cuddly, and quick to learn. Good with the resident dogs in his foster home (including three large breeds), though he needs his own space at mealtime. Curious about cats but no direct interaction yet. A little wary of new people at first, walks well but is strong with some leash reactivity toward dogs and runners, and is still building confidence with alone time and crate training. House-trained, neutered, and managing some ongoing allergies.


He'd thrive with a semi-active person or couple ready to keep building his confidence — bonus points for another calm, well-mannered dog in the home to show him the ropes. He's not asking to be the easiest dog, just for someone patient enough to help him become his best one.

name: Shakira
description_html: Taking after her namesake, Shakira is a pretty girl and her tail wags don’t lie! Still young, she has puppy curiosity about the outside world and plays well in our playgroup at the animal shelter- she was even paired with a doggy roommate! If you’re looking for a pup who is ready to explore what being a loving member of the household is like, Shakira would be happy to meet you!

name: Sage
description_html:
Sage came in with several other cats from a difficult situation. She is a classic "Cactus Cat", meaning she's still learning to trust people and she may always be on the independent side. She may make a great companion to a cat in the home since she enjoys the company of other felines and may relax more with cat friends to guide her. Sage prefers to be adored from a distance and engaged with through "play" and "snacks". We think this is the best way to get to know her and bond with her. If you're looking to add a touch of sass to your life, this girl might be the one for you!

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Sage and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Stormie Rain
description_html:
Her name says it all - she's the best rainy day, cozy up, cuddle up with the blankies companion - she's long on comforts, and has a very relaxed viewpoint of life that makes having her around a breeze.


Stormie Rain is looking forward to the best of the rest of life ahead of her. She's preparing well by staying in a foster home in cozy comforts and is always perfectly appointed for parties. Reach out on her link to connect with her foster.


Have a dog family member? We'll help set up a meet and greet at the shelter.

name: Lyric
description_html:
Pretty Lyric is a sweet young dog who strolls along easily on leash and appears housetrained. She is friendly, affectionate, mellow and a wonderful companion. Lyric does keep an eye out for pesky squirrels on her walks. 🐿️

She is dog friendly, and loves to romp around the playyard tossing around toys and jumping into the doggie pool. Lyric is a sweet, affectionate girl and a pleasure to spend time with.

Come meet this special girl!

name: Tessa
description_html: Tessa was found as a stray by some kind members of the community, but they could not keep her long term. In the home, she was very affectionate and eager to stay close to her people. Tessa was a peaceful presence, completely housetrained, furniture friendly and ready to lounge with her friends and get lots of snuggles. She has shown curiosity toward dogs and calm children with slow introductions. Tessa is a playful girl and hasn't met a squeaky toy she didn't like. Ask staff to meet this girl today and prepare to fall in love!

name: Layna
description_html: Layna is an itty bitty pocket pitty mix. She is a sweet mama who loves to sit with you and get pets and kisses. She is chill and gets along with dogs. She is easy to handle and to walk on leash. She enjoys sniffs in the play yard and friendly with men and women. She's equally independent and interested in you. She'll go off and sunbathe and then sit with you for quiet cuddles. She's super easy and laid back. Her petite size is a dream for apartments and homes a like. She'd be good with any age human.

name: Cherry
description_html: Cherry & Truffle came in together and love each other very much so they must be adopted together! Cherry is very loyal and loving. She enjoys being close to her people without the need to be on top of them! Truffle will steal pets from you and soak up all your attention. They both love window watching. These girls are in need of some TLC today!

name: Kilo
description_html:
With a big smile and a heart to match, Kilo is ready to capture yours! This handsome, tan-and-white pup is the ultimate cuddle machine. If there’s an open spot next to you on the couch, expect Kilo to fill it instantly. He loves affection, especially belly rubs! 

He’s not just a professional snuggler, though—he’s got the brains to back up the beauty. Kilo is a certified smarty-pants who already knows sit, shake, and down. He loves to show off his tricks for treats! He is also great on a leash and generally pretty easygoing. Ready for a loyal, intelligent, extra-cuddly best friend? Kilo is your guy.

name: Venus
description_html:
Meet Venus! 


According to her foster, Venus is an absolute sweetheart with the gentlest personality. She is incredibly friendly, loving, and adapts to new environments with ease. She's fully potty trained and has been wonderful to have in the home.


Her foster also says that Venus is very respectful of other dogs. She gives them their space, respects mealtimes, and gets along beautifully with canine companions. She absolutely loves people, enjoys cuddling, and is always happy to make a new friend!


If you're looking for a gentle, affectionate, well-mannered dog who will fit right into your family, Venus is ready to find her forever home!

name: Chancho
description_html:
Chancho is the kind of dog who makes people slow down and enjoy the moment. He's one of the cuddliest dogs around and is happiest when he's close to his favorite people.


This handsome guy is housetrained, walks nicely on leash with only mild pulling, and enjoys leisurely sniffing adventures while checking in with his handler along the way. He's generally neutral around people and other dogs, though he may show a little curiosity when passing canine friends. More than anything, Chancho loves affection and is always ready to curl up for a cuddle.


Chancho can be a little sensitive about strangers reaching over the top of his head. If given the chance to approach at his own pace, his sweet, affectionate personality quickly shines through. Once he feels comfortable, he's an incredibly loving companion who wants nothing more than to be by your side.


If you're looking for a laid-back, medium-energy dog who enjoys peaceful walks, quiet companionship, and plenty of snuggles, Chancho could be the perfect match.

name: Azuki
description_html:
Meet this sweet young boy looking for his forever home!

He is an incredibly friendly, calm, and loving dog who truly enjoys being around people. He gets along well with other dogs, is not aggressive at all, and is very non-reactive — he rarely barks and handles new environments, noises, rain, and other dogs with confidence and ease.

He already knows some commands, such as sit, stay, wait, go, and lay down, and he is very food motivated, which makes continued training easy and rewarding. He rides beautifully in the car, sits calmly during trips, and enjoys being by your side wherever you are.

While he does not enjoy being confined to a kennel, he absolutely loves relaxing on the couch or curling up on a comfy dog bed. He is affectionate without being overwhelming — he loves cuddles and belly rubs, stays close to his people, and has a calm, comforting presence. He’s the kind of companion who simply enjoys being near you.

Healthy, vaccinated, neutered, and ready to start his next chapter, he is looking for a loving home where he can finally settle in and be part of the family.

name: Charlie
description_html:
Meet Charlie: happy-go-lucky, ridiculously handsome, and quite possibly the world’s most enthusiastic fetch partner.

There’s a reason Charlie has earned the title “Master Fetch Player.” Toss him a ball and he’ll happily chase it down, bring it straight back, and drop it at your feet, ready for another round. He loves toys, morning zoomies, and having fun—but he’s also wonderfully independent and knows how to entertain himself or settle down for a good nap.

Charlie has excellent leash manners and has been calm around other dogs on walks, including during parallel walking. He’s comfortable in a crate, rides well in the car, and can settle nicely when left alone.

He’s also a polite housemate. Charlie doesn’t need to be involved in your dinner, responds beautifully to redirection, and is happy to swap something he shouldn’t have for one of his many beloved toys. He may benefit from frequent potty breaks while settling into a new routine.

Charlie is that wonderful combination of playful and easygoing. Give him a ball, some toys, a comfy place to sleep, and someone to love, and you’ve got one very happy boy.

name: Fern
description_html:
Meet Fern! If you're looking for a clever, affectionate companion who loves to learn, Fern is ready to steal your heart.

Fern is a house-trained, eager-to-please pup who catches on to training amazingly fast. He has a super fun energy and quickly settles in once he gets moving, softening up for endless pets and affection. His brain is always working, making reward-based training a total breeze and a great way to bond with him.

He's also a dream on a leash, making stepping out for walks quick, simple, and enjoyable. Fern loves love, learns quickly, and is ready to bring plenty of joy and sweetness to his forever home.

Reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com today to set up a time to meet Fern!

name: Akira
description_html:
Akira is a loving 1 year old girl who is ready to find her forever home.

Being a little over 1 years old - she’s still figuring out a lot but she is incredibly intelligent, intuitive, and a very good listener. She would be best suited for a medium active household with access to a yard — she loves being in her foster parents yard.


She has been thriving each day out of the shelter. She’s walks nicely on lease, loves to sniff, and loves meeting new people and dogs.


She loves to play with her foster brother who has a similar play style as her but coexists well with her foster sister who doesn’t like to play as much. Girls girl. She is also very talented at disengaging with her siblings and taking breaks to re-regulate when she needs to. Her foster parents think she could be a single dog household or come to a house with siblings! She has LOVED playing and engaging with her foster siblings which helps entertain her, we think!


Akira is a big cuddle bug & will nicely come sit and paw/pet you in exchange for so love and pets.


Akira is a special girl and knows sit, settle, off, and lay down. She sits nicely as she’s being fed and loves ripping the stuffing out of all her toys & loves to thrash. A backyard with a fence would also be best suited for her; she loves to go outside and watch nature and the squirrels.


To follow along and get more insight into Akira’s day to day at her foster house - check out @leaps.n.chomps_fosterhouse !! That’s her foster parents Instagram page where they are most active and responsive!

name: Fiesta
description_html:
Fiesta is a sweet, affectionate boy who's ready to trade shelter life for a loving home. Like many dogs who have spent time in the shelter, he's developed some stress-related habits—such as jumping during the first few minutes of a walk—but these behaviors weren't present when he first arrived and are expected to improve once he's in a calmer home environment.


With a few treats and a little patience, Fiesta quickly settles into an easy, loose-leash walk. He loves sniffing and exploring, checks in often with his person, and is happiest when he's spending quality time together. In the play yard, he'll happily romp around with toys before coming back for pets, treats, and affection. In the Real Life Room, he's all about relaxing and soaking up attention.


Fiesta is housetrained, treat-motivated, and medium energy. He'd thrive with an adopter who can provide a little guidance during exciting moments and plenty of love, playtime, and companionship. If you're looking for a fun, loyal dog who truly enjoys being with his people, Fiesta is ready to celebrate life with you! Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Rhonda
description_html:
Rhonda is an easygoing sweetheart. She is loving, cheerful, and house-trained. She does great with other dogs and loves to cuddle up on the couch. She also loves treats and is easy to train.

Rhonda makes friends with everyone she meets and is a confident gal. Everywhere we go, people tell us how sweet she is and that she looks just like Scooby Doo!

name: Lil Luna
description_html:
Hi there! I’m Lil Luna — a pocket-sized bundle of love with a heart way bigger than my paws. 🌙✨

I may be little, but my personality is larger than life! I’m sweet, playful, and always ready to make you smile with my goofy antics and happy wiggles. Whether I’m zooming around the yard, snuggling up beside you, or giving you my big soulful eyes, I know how to make every moment brighter.

I can be a little shy when meeting new people, but give me a little patience and kindness, and I’ll quickly become your loyal shadow and best friend. Once I trust you, I’m all about cuddles, kisses, and soaking up every bit of love I can get.

I dream of a forever home where I can feel safe, cherished, and part of the family. In return, I promise endless affection, laughter, and unconditional love.

Could you be the happily-ever-after my little heart has been waiting for? 🐾💕

name: Zeb
description_html:
Meet Zeb!


Zeb is a handsome young pup with a big heart and an even bigger love for fun. At just over a year old, this sweet and playful boy enjoys spending time outdoors, playing fetch, going for walks, and chewing on his favorite bones. He already knows commands like sit and stay, walks nicely on leash, and is friendly with both familiar people and new faces.


Zeb has lived successfully with another dog and enjoys canine companionship, making him a great candidate for a home with a friendly dog. He is crate trained, accustomed to spending time alone in a crate, and is housetrained when given regular opportunities to go outside.


His previous family describes him as sweet and playful. Zeb loves being part of the action and can get excited during playtime. He does well with older children!


Zeb is looking for a family that will appreciate his affectionate nature, playful spirit, and loyal personality. With continued guidance and plenty of exercise, this wonderful boy has all the ingredients to become an amazing lifelong companion.


If you're searching for a fun-loving best friend who enjoys adventures, playtime, and being close to his people, Zeb may be the perfect match for you!

name: Sunshine
description_html: Sunshine is such a sweet girl! She adores playtime and can happily self-entertain with squeaky toys; the way she rolls around with her toys is adorable and will fill your home with smiles and joy. Sunshine also loves water and splashing around in the kiddie pool. She is also very easy to walk on a leash! She is dog-social and could fit into many different lifestyles; meet Sunshine and see if she is your ray of light!

name: Palomo
description_html: Palomo is a stunning husky/shepherd mix with a smile that will melt your heart! True to his name, this handsome boy is as sweet and gentle as a dove. Palomo is the perfect blend of playfulness and affection; he loves a good romp around the yard just as much as he loves leaning in for full-body cuddles. With his striking ears, expressive eyes, and a tail that never stops wagging, he radiates pure joy. If you’re looking for a loyal, fun-loving companion to brighten your days and join you on every adventure, Palomo is ready to be your forever best friend!

name: Toby
description_html:
Meet Toby🔥 An enduring service graduate, professional cuddle bug, fetch fanatic, and one seriously resilient boy.


Zuko has been through more than most dogs should ever have to experience. After being hit by a car, he has a slight limp, but that does NOT slow him down!


Let him warm up after a nap or some time in his crate, and he's ready to GO.

🎾 He LOVES toys, will play fetch with just about anything, and has the perfect goofy, playful personality. When playtime is over? Toby is a HUGE cuddle bug who loves giving hugs and kisses and being as close to his people as possible.

He's also a boy who loves to PLAY. 🎾 Toys, chews, fetch-you name it. His excitement can sometimes spill over into jumping and playful mouthing, so Zuko is looking for an adult or older-teen home that's comfortable with a big, enthusiastic dog and willing to continue working on his manners.


Andddddd this handsome boy has brains, too!

Zuko is:

🐾 Potty trained

🐾 Crate training experience

🐾 Leash-trained

🐾 Knows sit, stay, and down

🐾 Dog social

🐾 A fetch & toy enthusiast

🐾 An expert hug-and-kiss giver


Zuko has been wonderfully sweet with his foster's resident dog. He isn't a pushy playmate, and we think he would love to live with a compatible dog sibling. (Schedule a meet-and-greet with your dog.)

He can get a little mouthy when he's excited and loves to jump up for hugs.


Zuko survived being hit by a car and lived to see another day.

Now let's make sure the days ahead are spent on a comfy bed, surrounded by toys, or curled up in the arms of his new best friend. ❤️


Toby is a graduate of our Enduring Service program! He went through 3 months of training!

To learn more about this program, read about it on our website.

According to his Enduring Service program handlers :" Toby is a big goofy boy and plays well with other dogs. He is crate trained and walks well with a harness. Easy to bath and knows commands like sit, down and stay. To He loves toys and chews and can play fetch with anything."

name: Sherlock
description_html: Sherlock is an absolute sweetheart with expressive ears and a bright, joyful smile! This handsome boy is a total lovebug who thrives on affection—especially if there are belly rubs involved. Sherlock has a playful spirit and loves chasing after his favorite toys, making him as fun as he is affectionate. With his friendly nature and eager-to-please attitude, he’s completely ready to find a loving home where his wonderful personality can truly shine. If you’re searching for a loyal, fun-loving companion to complete your family, Sherlock is ready to investigate his way straight into your heart!

name: Zelda
description_html:
I'm Zelda!


My owner of 4 years brought me to the shelter due to their medical issues that made it harder for her to take care of me.


I can be a tad shy but once I warm up I love to snuggle!


Want a running or hiking buddy? You are looking at her!


I know lots of tricks! Stay, down, come, paw, roll over, back up, give kisses - you name it and I will probably know it or can figure out how to do it!


Come meet me today!

name: Hobbes
description_html: Hobbes is perfect with a capital P. He doesn’t react to dogs, birds, or squirrels on walks. He walks alongside you with a loose leash. He LOVES cuddles and pets more than anything else. Hobbes would probably live happily in an apartment; he's quiet and small-sized, and really just wants to snuggle with people. Hobbes is a social butterfly waiting for his new friends to invite him to happy hour!

name: Kash
description_html: Kash is an easy boy for walks and he loves hanging out with people! This friendly guy enjoys playing with toys and will gladly come up to you for pets and reassurance. He's more than ready to get attention daily in a foster or adoptive home today!

name: Gus
description_html:
Meet Gus — a 12/10 good boy who’s ready to bring joy, laughs, and lots of love into his forever home!

Gus is incredibly friendly with both people and other dogs. He’s playful and fun, but also thoughtful—he’s great at adjusting his energy to match his canine buddies, whether they’re ready to romp or just hang out.

He’s still a young guy at heart and gets excited to say hello, so he’s working on keeping all four paws on the ground. Because of that enthusiasm, he may do best with older kids while he continues learning his manners.

Gus loves getting out for a nice long walk (about a mile is his sweet spot), and he’s a dream on leash with his Easy Walk harness. When the day winds down, he’s just as happy curling up next to you on the couch for some quality cuddle time.

He’s a total star at home too—crate trained, no potty accidents, and not destructive. He understands “no,” settles in easily, and even handles mealtime and bedtime in his crate without a fuss. His only quirk? He sometimes likes to start the day a little early—but he makes up for it with enthusiasm and tail wags!

Bonus: Gus loves ice cubes—they’re his favorite treat.

Gus would thrive in a home with another playful dog and an active family who can give him a couple of good walks each day. If you’re looking for a sweet, fun-loving companion who’s equal parts adventure buddy and cuddle bug, Gus might just be your perfect match.

name: Spartan
description_html:
Spartan is a shy, sensitive soul who becomes something completely different once he decides you are his person. Volunteers describe him as sweet, affectionate, easy to walk, and absolutely endearing. One put it perfectly: Spartan can seem reserved at first, but once he knows you, “he melts when he sees you.”


Spartan has become a favorite walking companion for volunteers. He has repeatedly shown lovely loose-leash manners around campus and tends to move at a slow, thoughtful pace while he takes in the world. He knows sit and come, checks in with his handler, and is easily redirected with treats if nervousness gets the better of him. Volunteers have also reported that he seems house-trained and enjoys hanging out in the shelter’s Real Life Room.


He has some great dog skills, too. Spartan has participated in multiple shelter playgroups, offering soft greetings, tolerating some fairly pushy canine behavior, exploring comfortably alongside other dogs, and occasionally joining in chase play. More recently, he entered playgroup on his own, greeted his friends nicely, peacefully coexisted, and spent part of the session relaxing in the shade with his human. He lives with a doggy roommate here at the shelter and has great potential to live in a many-dog household—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet and greet with your resident dog(s)!


What Spartan needs most is a family willing to let friendship happen on his timetable. Unfamiliar people can make him nervous, particularly when they approach quickly or enter his space. Shelter volunteers have seen the other side of that story repeatedly: with a little patience, he warms up into an affectionate dog who wants to stay close to the people he trusts.


Spartan doesn’t need to be the life of the party. He needs people who appreciate a dog whose love is earned—and therefore feels extra special when you get it. Give him calm introductions, good walks, some treats, and enough time to decide you’re a friend, and you may get to watch this shy boy completely melt.

name: Linda Lou
description_html:
Meet Linda Lou 💕🐾

Well hello there, darling — I’m Linda Lou, and yes, I’m every bit as charming as my name sounds.

I’m a sweet girl with a gentle heart and a loving soul. I am very shy when it comes to meeting new people but am working on my bravery. My favorite things in life are soft beds, kind humans, tasty treats, and being told I’m pretty (which I will gladly accept at any hour of the day). I’ve got a calm, affectionate nature.

I’m the kind of dog who wants to be part of your everyday life. Morning coffee companion? That’s me. Couch cuddle supervisor? Absolutely. Loyal best friend who listens without judgment? I was born for it.

I may take a little time to settle into new situations, but once I know I’m safe and loved, my personality blossoms beautifully. Underneath it all is a dog who simply wants connection, comfort, and someone to love forever.

Here’s what you should know about me:

  • I give world-class cuddle energy
  • I have a heart as soft as my puppy-dog eyes
  • I’m happiest just being near my people
  • I will absolutely become your little shadow

I’ve been dreaming about a forever home where I can finally exhale, feel safe, and spend my days loving the humans lucky enough to choose me.

If you’re looking for a loyal companion with sweetness, grace, and just a sprinkle of sass, I think we should meet.

Love,

Linda Lou 🐶💗

name: Red
description_html: Red is very active but can also relax on the couch. She loves sniffing and exploring. Red is smart, cuddly and sweet. She would benefit from being with an owner who’s patient, experienced with dogs and can get professional training for her moments of reactivity towards some people and some dogs. She loves car rides. She is afraid of children so she needs some work with getting her to feel comfortable with children and kids.

name: Ruffles
description_html: Warning! This dog may appear shorter and cuter in person! She has a lot of spunk, may even belly flop into any amount of water outside. This retired mama acts very ladylike in home. She settles her barking quick once knowing you. She loves snuggles, diving headfirst into your chest. Once you show her love, so will she in return. Loves toys, has shown no mouthing on furniture or structures in home, except 2 socks… loves squeaky toys. Will seek being close to you in a storm. Prefers women.

name: Louie
description_html:
Meet Louie


Loves:

  • Lounging on the couch
  • Cuddling
  • Quiet companionship
  • Napping
  • Snacks


Easygoing lifestyle:

  • Enjoys slow, relaxed walks
  • Likes to stop and observe the world
  • Happy to sit and people-watch for hours


Very gentle:

  • Never pulls on the leash
  • Walks right beside you
  • Takes treats softly and carefully


Dog-friendly:

  • Does well with other dogs of all sizes!


Well-trained & low-maintenance:

  • Housetrained & leash trained
  • Great in apartments
  • Comfortable staying home alone
  • Not picky with food; takes meds easily
  • Doesn't mind taking baths


Personality at home:

  • Greets you with a wagging tail
  • Prefers cuddles over walks
  • Loves sleeping in bed with you (or nearby)


Best fit:

  • Calm, low-key home
  • Someone who loves a quiet, gentle companion


----


Conoce a Louie — ¡aplica para conocerlo!

Perro grande y guapo con una personalidad dulce, tranquila y cariñosa

Le encanta:

  • Descansar en el sofá
  • Acurrucarse
  • La compañía tranquila
  • Dormir (¡ronca suavemente!)


Estilo de vida relajado:Paseos tranquilos y sin prisa

  • Le gusta observar su entorno
  • Feliz viendo pasar gente y perros


Muy gentil:

  • Nunca tira de la correa
  • Camina a tu lado
  • Toma premios con mucho cuidado


Bueno con otros perros:

  • Se lleva bien con otros perros
  • Especialmente con perros tranquilos y calmados


Bien educado y fácil de cuidar:

  • Entrenado para hacer sus necesidades afuera
  • Sabe caminar con correa
  • Ideal para apartamentos
  • Puede quedarse solo en casa sin problema
  • No es exigente con la comida; toma medicina fácilmente


En casa:

  • Te recibe moviendo la cola
  • Prefiere abrazos antes que paseos
  • Le gusta dormir contigo o cerca


Hogar ideal:

  • Tranquilo y sin mucho movimiento
  • Con alguien que valore su carácter dulce y calmado


Feel free to reach out to me directly for any other details ~ instagram: atxaotd

name: Kitty
description_html:
Kitty is the kind of dog who turns heads the moment you meet her. Her tall, perky ears stand straight up like little exclamation points, always ready to catch the sound of a friendly voice or the rustle of something interesting. She has a gentle, sweet demeanor that makes you feel instantly at ease, and you can tell there’s so much personality just waiting to blossom once she finds her person.

She carries a large scar along her back, a quiet reminder that her start in life wasn’t easy. Kitty can’t tell us what she’s been through, but what’s remarkable is how she refuses to let her past dim her view of people. She greets the world with hope, softness, and a willingness to trust again.

On walks, Kitty begins with enthusiasm, then settles into a slower pace where she can take in the world—sniffing the breeze, watching the scenery, and enjoying the simple pleasure of being outside with someone she likes. Her favorite spot on campus is the Real Life Room, where she melts into snuggles and shows us exactly what she’s dreaming of: a home of her own.

Kitty is a world-class cuddler. She loves chin scratches, gives the sweetest hugs, and has mastered the art of climbing onto a chair just to be closer to you for more affection. She’s tender, observant, and endlessly loving.

Kitty is ready for someone who sees her not for the scar on her back, but for the bright, beautiful future she’s eager to share. If you’re looking for a loyal companion with a gentle soul and a heart full of love, Kitty is waiting to meet you.

name: Rosie
description_html:
Rosie is a very sweet girl. She’s great with other dogs, calm mannered and a couch potato! She was found with her (presumed) sister, Daisy, and we would prefer they be adopted together as they are quite attached.


She is house and crate trained. She can be a bit anxious on a leash at first but once she trusts you it’s easy for her to just walk next to you. Overall just a great, sweet dog. Please give her a chance to show you!

name: Creed
description_html:
Meet Creed!


Creed is a smart, affectionate, and energetic dog who has been a deeply loved member of his family for the past five years. Described by his owner as “one of the best dogs I have ever owned,” Creed is a loyal companion who thrives on human connection and enjoys being part of family life.


This handsome boy loves people of all ages, including children, and is always happy to make new friends. He’s friendly with unfamiliar people both on walks and at home, and his sweet, loving personality shines through once he’s around his people. Creed enjoys walks, runs, games of fetch, squeaky toys, and chewing on bones. He also knows basic commands like “sit” and “stay,” and his intelligence makes him eager to engage and interact.


Creed would do great in a house and has also done well in an apartment setting!


At home, Creed is house-trained, comfortable relaxing on his dog bed, and does well being left alone for moderate periods of time. He is crate trained. He allows handling for baths and general care, and overall is a very loving, family-oriented dog.


Creed is looking for a stable, loving forever home where he can be an adored companion, exercise buddy, and best friend. If you’re looking for a sweet, intelligent dog with a big heart and lots of personality, Creed may be your perfect match.


Creed is neutered, heart worm negative, and ready to go home today!

name: Miss Pretty
description_html:
Happy is as happy does and Miss Pretty is a happy girl. who can be a little shy at first. She's worth the meet. You'll soon be on her friend's list. Ask staff to get her out, or if offsite, arrange a meet up with her advocates at caring@classiccanines.org. Need a meet up with a dog? No problem.

Miss Pretty has so much to offer:

--She'll never turn down a treat

--She loves comforts and is non-destructive

--She's very house trained , she's also crate trained

--She walks nicely on a leash, not bothered by other dogs

--Her favorite activities: window watching & extraordinary sniff walk skills

--Also a pro at riding in the car

--Perfect companionship

name: Gatito
description_html:
Gatito is pure enthusiasm in dog form — and he's looking for someone who's ready to grow with him. Full of energy, affection, and a whole lot of heart, this puppy is at his happiest when he's soaking up

attention and love from the people around him. He thrives on connection and will repay every pet and scratch with total devotion.


Gatito already knows "sit" — a great foundation for a pup with his drive to please. He's highly motivated, which makes training sessions fun and productive. On the leash he's a work in progress: some moments he's striding alongside you nicely, others he's off to the races with

a classic case of the zoomies. With consistent practice and patience, he's going to be a stellar walking companion.


At home, Gatito is cuddly and warm — all that big energy melts right into snuggle mode when it counts. He'd do best in an active household ready to invest in his training and channel his spark in the right direction. The effort will pay off tenfold.


Come by, he's ready to go home today! If you have any questions, please reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com

name: Mojito
description_html: Look at that face! Meet Mojito, a splash of pure joy looking for his forever home. This striking boy instantly grabs your attention with his unique, captivating eyes—one beautiful blue, one warm brown.
