But it’s his massive, goofy smile and floppy ears that will truly steal your heart. Mojito is the ultimate enthusiast; he loves exploring the outdoors, leaning in close for affection, and flashing his signature grin for the camera. He’s a happy, active companion who brings bright, sunny energy wherever he goes. Ready to add a little extra flavor and endless love to your life? Mojito is your boy!

name: Nicholas
description_html:
Nicholas is a handsome pup whose striking black-and-white tuxedo markings—complete with the cutest freckles—are perfectly matched by his dapper and polite personality. As you can see from his bright, happy gaze and ready-for-action grin, he is a cheerful bundle of playfulness and affection. Nicholas is the ultimate social butterfly; he is incredibly loving and forms instant bonds with every human he meets. 

True to his lively nature, Nicholas’s favorite time is playtime. He's an expert-level toy enthusiast and has never met a squeaky toy or ball he didn't adore. While he has plenty of playful energy, he’s also a gentleman on outdoor adventures, handling nicely on a leash. 

If you are looking for a playful, loving, and well-mannered companion to bring endless joy to your home, this tuxedo-clad charm is waiting for you!

name: Bobby
description_html:
Big Boy Bobby - Bobby for short - has never met a ball or person he doesn't like. Bobby is dog-social, sweet, and so very handsome. He'd love to play fetch with his new people, and wouldn't mind a well-matched dog sibling. At the very least, please bring him a home with a lot of balls - his very, very favorite - he will love to prance by you showing off his ball, wiggling his entire body, and then drop his ball and roll on top of it he's just that excited!


Come meet this big-headed, bigger-hearted guy asap - he's waiting for you!

name: Bolt
description_html:
Meet Bolt: a happy, silly, and playful boy who’s discovering just how wonderful the world can be.

Bolt loves spending time with his people and finds comfort simply being by your side. He’s always up for a great game of fetch and would make an amazing adventure buddy.

After a day of fun, Bolt is just as happy to settle in and show his affectionate side. He has so much love to give and enjoys being close to the people he trusts. He’s also very house-trained, making him an easy addition to a home.

With his unique personality and joyful spirit, Bolt truly is a special dog. All he needs now is a forever family to share life’s adventures with.

Could that be you?

--

name: Billie
description_html:
Billie is a sweet, loyal girl who has blossomed beautifully in foster care. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, all she really needs is a little patience, a few treats, and some time to realize you’re a friend. Once she trusts you, Billie becomes the ultimate companion—following you from room to room, curling up beside you at bedtime, and filling your days with unconditional love.


At a svelte 37 pounds, she’s the perfect size for a home or an apartment. 


Billie has been living with another dog in her foster home and has been an excellent canine companion. She loves to play, wrestle, chase, and be chased, and she’s happy to share toys and engage in friendly games of tug-of-war. She would likely thrive in a home with another playful dog, but she would also be perfectly happy as your one-and-only best friend.


An active girl, Billie enjoys daily walks and outdoor adventures. She’s wonderful on leash, enjoys exploring the neighborhood, and rides beautifully in the car. One of her favorite car ride habits is resting her head on her person’s arm while watching the world go by—a guaranteed heart-melter.


Billie is house-trained, non-destructive, and has proven she can be trusted at home while her people are away. She’s eager to please, highly treat-motivated, and continues to gain confidence every day. While she may bark briefly when visitors arrive, she settles quickly and warms up even faster when treats are involved. Especially CHEESE!


Billie loves activity and engagement, but is content to curl up under the desk and snooze as her person works. She’d do best with a family that can provide regular exercise, playtime, and companionship. She has lots of energy for fun but an equally impressive capacity for snuggles once the day is done.


The best thing about Billie is her heart. Beneath her initially cautious exterior is an incredibly loving, devoted dog who forms deep bonds with her people. If you’re willing to give her a little time to settle in, she’ll reward you with a lifetime of loyalty, affection, and companionship.


Billie is ready to find the forever home she deserves. Could that be with you?

name: Butters
description_html:
Butters arrived with an active much smaller sized dog friend who since found a new home. Butters is waiting for his next adventure in life while sharing his kennel space with another large dog. He loves being part of all the activity going on inside and out, and seems perfectly suited for an active lifestyle. He's not ready to slow down any time soon. He'll charm you to the moon and back, along with all your friends too as a great house and walk companion.


Butters and his original doggie accomplice had a mishap with chickens before arriving to the shelter. Expect that Butters may treat small mammals as prey or sport and his home should have a well secured fence.


Check out his Instagram account HERE!

name: Chili
description_html: Chili is one of many cats who were found abandoned in a residence. She is a bit scared of hands which is completely natural given all that she's been through. Chili may need some reassurance in a new place and some time to get used to new people. She looking for a loving home where she can relax and show her true personality. She may do well in a space with other cats.

name: Kya
description_html:
Kya is a sweet, playful companion. Her loves include being around people and being outdoors for walks and hikes.


Kya has all the home skills people expect of a mature dog - she's housetrained, knows how to use a doggie door, she stays home alone well for a normal work day, she lived with older children and 2 other dogs with her finder. Unfortunately the female dog didn't tolerate her well, so Kya made her way into the shelter where she was play group tested and matched with a dog friend to share kennel space with. In her foster home she's polished up her leash skills, and enjoys being out for walks, playing fetch and hanging out with her foster family at home.


Kya is spayed, vaccinated, and heart worm negative and ready to be connected to her forever family. Is that you? Use the "Get Started" button on her profile to start the ball rolling to the rest of Kya's life.

name: Memphis
description_html:
Meet Memphis! If you're looking for an easygoing, sweet companion who is completely ready for everyday life, he’s your guy. Memphis is a playful young pup who enjoys the company of dogs.


Memphis is a star on outings. He hops right into the car, sits quietly to take in the views, and loves leaning in for front-seat chin scratches. Out in the world, nothing rattles him. He handles crowds, strollers, bikes, skateboards, and bustling parks with calm, polite curiosity. His leash manners are fantastic. He walks so well that he can comfortably handle a 15-foot long line, and he watches other dogs with a clear "are you my new friend?" tail wag.


Memphis is house-trained, eats like a gentleman, and gets better every single day. He is ready to move into his forever home and join you on all of life's outings.


Reach out to meet Memphis today and see if he's the perfect match for your home!

name: Gatsby
description_html:
Gatsby carries a distinguished name and the heart of a comedian. We’re not sure if he knows how funny he is or if it’s just a happy coincidence, but either way he keeps his volunteer buddies entertained with his quirky antics!


Gatsby explores the world around him with curious sniffing and checks in with his handler for reassuring words and pats. He is playful and silly, sometimes enjoys toys but not at all interested in the water yet, thank you! Maybe another Texas summer will change his mind. 


This handsome spotted boy has demonstrated the ability to play gently with other dogs and could live with a well matched doggie sibling. Gatsby comes with the love and full support of the Orange Dot Crew volunteer team who is ready to help him leave shelter life in the past. 


Gatsby is an amazing dog!! He is so hilarious and just gives you a look like “hey friend let’s play!” He is pretty easy to walk and loves to play in the play yard. He loves people and is super friendly. He’s one of my favorite dogs to walk and whoever adopts him is super lucky.


Interested in Gatsby? Reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Pistachio
description_html:
Meet Pistachio! If you have a soft spot for gentle, sensitive souls, this sweet pup is sure to melt your heart.

Pistachio can be a little shy at first when meeting new friends, but underneath his quiet initial hello is a dog who is so ready to love. He leashes up easily and without any fuss, and the moment he steps outside his room he is ready to explore the world around him and take in all the new scents.

With a little patience and a gentle touch, Pistachio warms up into the sweetest companion. He is looking for a loving home where he can shine, build his confidence, and be your loyal best friend.

Ask about meeting Pistachio today!

name: Darnell
description_html:
Darnel is as big-hearted as he is big-eared! 

 This playful, silly boy has lots of energy and loves toys, treats, and a good game of fetch. Once Darnell feels comfortable, his affectionate side really shines. He's gentle taking treats, and knows some tricks like "sit." He has also lived with another dog at the shelter and could do well with a dog-sibling after a meet and greet.

 Darnell can be a little shy at first and would do great with a patient person who will let him warm up at his own pace. Give him that chance, and you'll gain a loyal companion. 

 Think Darnell might be your guy? Come meet this big-eared goofball!

name: Lucius
description_html:
Meet Lucius! 🐾

Lucius is a sweet, smiley boy with a tender heart and gentle nature. He’s housetrained, walks beautifully on leash, and is very treat-motivated—making him an easy companion to spend time with.

A little shy at first, Lucius can be timid in new situations and may pull when he feels unsure, but he warms up with patience and kindness. Once comfortable, his soft personality and quiet sweetness really shine.

If you’re looking for a gentle, sensitive pup who just needs a little confidence and a lot of love, Lucius could be your special guy.

name: Noelia
description_html:
Hi, I’m Noelia 💕


I’m sweet, cuddly, and my biggest dream is to be the perfect best friend to my forever family.


I’m a very affectionate girl currently living with my foster brother, Ollie, and we’ve truly become best friends. I’m dog-social and love having a buddy around!


Inside the home, I’m a total sweetheart. I’m gentle, loving, and happiest when I’m close to my people getting all the affection I can.


My foster mom knows there is someone out there who will feel so lucky to have me, and I know I’ll feel just as lucky to have them.


If you’re ready to give me a loving home and spoil me like the princess I am, I’d love to meet you ✨

name: Courage
description_html:
Courage is a sweet, sensitive boy with a heart full of love—he’s just waiting for the right person to help him feel safe enough to share it. Shelter life is overwhelming for him, and he’s understandably scared in this noisy, unfamiliar environment. What he needs most is someone patient, kind, and willing to give him a little space to come out of his shell at his own pace.

When you let Courage approach you on his terms, he shows you who he truly is: a gentle treat‑taker, a soft hand‑kisser, and a dog who wants so badly to trust. He moves carefully through the world, taking time to understand his surroundings, but every small step he takes is full of bravery.

He walks politely on a leash and stays close, though sudden noises and quick movements can startle him. With time, consistency, and a calm home, he’s sure to blossom into the cuddle bug he’s meant to be.

Courage has the most soulful eyes—eyes that quietly ask for kindness, patience, and love. You can see how much he wants to bond, to feel safe, and to finally relax into a family of his own.

If you’re looking for a gentle companion who will reward your patience with deep, loyal love, Courage is waiting for you.

name: Rosco
description_html:
Rosco is the kind of dog who reminds you to enjoy the simple things in life. This friendly, easygoing guy loves getting outside for walks, adventures, and quality time with his people.

Rosco quickly warms up to new people and shows his affectionate, playful personality. Once he trusts you, he’s all smiles, tail wags, and ready for whatever the day brings. Whether you’re looking for a walking partner, jogging buddy, or just a laid-back companion to relax with after a long day, Rosco is happy to be by your side.

Rosco is already house trained, knows sit and shake, walks well on a leash, and enjoys learning new things. He’s the perfect mix of playful and calm—equally excited for an outdoor adventure or a cozy evening at home.

After spending time waiting for his forever family, Rosco is more than ready to trade shelter life for a loving home. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend with a gentle heart and an adventurous spirit, Rosco just might be your perfect match. 

Friendly, sweet, calm and easy. Loves to play with toys and loves pets. He is a flexible dog that is happy to play and equally happy to chill.

name: Nebula
description_html: Nebula is a total sweetheart who is so easy to love! On a recent outing, she was affectionate, cuddly, and loved snuggling on the couch in the Real Life Room. She was an easy, loose-leash walker and enjoyed exploring and sniffing along the way. Nebula also seems to be housetrained and is treat motivated. She’s a lovely girl who would make a wonderful companion for a lucky adopter!

name: Toby
description_html:
Meet Toby, a gentle soul residing at the local shelter. Initially shy, Toby warms up to reveal a curious and sweet nature. Once comfortable, he unveils a playful side that endears him to all who spend time with him. Toby's tender approach makes him a perfect companion for quiet evenings and leisurely walks, where he can explore and learn at his own pace. If you're looking for a loyal friend who will slowly but surely steal your heart, Toby is your ideal match. His gentle spirit is just waiting for a place to call home.


Toby is:

  • Housetrained
  • Cuddly with friends
  • Playful and loves a game of fetch, though he may not bring it back
  • Great on leash
  • Extremely smart - will blow through any treat puzzle we give him!
  • Best coworker - will keep your feet warm while you laptop
  • An old soul type with some pep in his step

name: Mama Blythe
description_html:
I’m a 3-year-old girl who realized early on that life is better when you slow down and smell the roses. I’m a 60 lb girl who is convinced I’m a lap dog—and because I'm so gentle, I'd likely be a good match for a home with children to join my fan club!

I’m a very good girl who is house-trained and walks like a dream on my leash. I also just learned how to use the stairs! I’m very treat-motivated, so if you have a snack in your hand, you’ll have my full, undivided attention.

I love my squeaky toys, but my true passion is being near my humans. I might be okay with a dog brother or sister if we’re a good match, but I’d like a home without any feline friends. Ready to fill your home with squeaks and tail wags?

name: Persephone
description_html: This is a feral momma kitty who I have been working on taming in foster with her babies. She's still likely to hiss if approached too quickly and be tightened up as hard as a rock when you touch her, but with some dedication I have gotten her to start relaxing during pets and even put her chin up and press into some neck and chin scritches. Definitely can't pick her up with your hands, but placing a blanket or towel over her makes her limp enough to handle and transport her. I believe she can be domesticated and put into a good home, but it will take continued work. Named Persephone because I got two kittens from her the year before these four kittens, so she was like Persephone coming back from the underworld every year bringing me new pretty babies. She has now been spayed to end that cycle!

name: Princess
description_html:
🐾 Meet Princess!

Princess is a petite little lovebug with a big heart and an even bigger personality. She’s the perfect in-between size — not too big, not too small — just right for cuddles on the couch and adventures around the neighborhood.

This sweet girl is very house-trained and would make an easy addition to a home. Princess is also a wonderful doggie friend who absolutely loves being around her buddies. She gets so excited to see them and is always ready to share tail wags and good vibes.

On walks, Princess enjoys exploring but is also great about checking in often, making her a fun and connected walking companion. And when she’s got a little extra joy to share, she’ll treat you to her favorite activity: happy zoomies in the yard!

Princess has so much love to give and is patiently waiting for a family of her very own. She would be thrilled to trade shelter life for a cozy home, a comfy bed, and someone to call her best friend.

Come meet Princess — she’s ready to be your little ray of sunshine! 🐶💛

name: Teepee
description_html:
TeePee is a sweet, sensitive guy with a goofy streak and a whole lot of love to give. While he can be a little shy or nervous in new situations at first, he warms up beautifully with patience, treats, and gentle reassurance. Once he feels safe, TeePee’s affectionate and playful personality starts to shine through.


This handsome boy loves toys, enjoys walks, and is very treat motivated, which makes him both fun to spend time with and eager to learn. Volunteers describe him as a total sweetheart who loves giving kisses and can settle into a nice groove on walks once he gets his wiggles out. He’s also been enjoying enrichment activities like puzzle toys and has shown himself to be a smart, thoughtful pup who gains confidence over time.


TeePee has shown potential to live with another dog. He’s done well in playgroup with other soft, social dogs and may enjoy having a compatible canine friend in his future home. If you already have a resident dog, the shelter’s behavior team can help arrange a meet and greet to see if it’s a good fit!


TeePee would likely do best with adopters who understand that shy dogs sometimes need a little extra patience at first — but the reward is a deeply loving, loyal companion who will absolutely steal your heart.


Interested in meeting TeePee? Please reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com to learn more.

name: Muppet Baby
description_html:
Muppet will want to spend all in a yard. He loves being outside and chasing squirrels or lizards. Enjoys babypool on hot days. He will go in a crate but will need continued positive re-enforcement around it. Would not recommend for young kids due to energy level/mouthy playful behavior.


Muppet is a sweet baby who is learning all about the world. He is playful and hilarious. It’s impossible not to smile watching him play. He’s a young guy still learning so much and growing up at the shelter. Muppet will come with support from Orange dot crew to transition into a home! Email his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Oracle
description_html:
You can tell that Oracle is missing his person. :( 


Oracle lost his home after his owner’s house burned down, and now he is hoping for a fresh start with someone who will love him as much as his person did. He is a super house-trained boy who keeps his circle a little on the smaller side, but once you are in, you are in.


Oracle is sweet, silly, playful, and so much fun to spend time with. He loves his friends, loves treats, and already knows some cute tricks like sit, come, and shake. He has an playful side, but he is also the kind of dog who bonds deeply and loves being with his person.


He would do best with people who appreciate that he likes to keep his circle small and facilitates proper intros with new people. For the people he knows and trusts, Oracle is incredibly loving, fun, and rewarding. He is ready for a home where he can feel secure again and get back to doing what he does best- being a loyal, goofy, sweet companion.

name: Caleb
description_html:
Caleb is a sweet, happy guy with a great smile and a big love for fetch. He walks nicely on leash, is easy to take out, and once he’s handled his business he’s all about playtime—especially if there’s a ball involved!

He loves playing in the yard and enjoying toys in the Real Life Room, even showing off an adorable full sploot on the couch. Caleb loves fetch so much he prefers to keep the ball unless he spots another one ready to go—then the game is on again.

A volunteer took him home for a sleepover and he was wonderful. He likes going in the car and stays fairly calm on the ride. He’s housetrained, knows sit and stay. He slept through the night with no noise or issues, and he did great with kids, always gentle and didn’t jump on them. He even met some cats on a leash and he showed potential.

Playful, friendly, and easy to spend time with, Caleb is a wonderful buddy ready for a home that will keep the games coming.

name: Onyx
description_html:
✨ Meet Onyx ✨

Onyx is proof that amazing, trained dogs end up in shelters all the time.


She's already crate trained, potty trained, great in the car, CAT FRIENDLY, dog friendly, and has never met a stranger. She loves toys, cuddling up for movie nights, zoomies, and running through the sprinkler! She can shy at first then opens up to be so playful, silly and eager to please.


She's currently thriving in a foster home with a cat and it's obvious she's lived in a home before. She's the kind of dog who settles right into your life and immediately makes it better - she just needs someone willing to give her that chance.

If you're looking for your new best friend, Onyx is more than ready. ❤️

name: Mama Eden
description_html:
Mama is an affectionate, high energy girl who wants to soak up all life has to offer. Her favorite things are walks, hikes, playing with her foster brother, and snuggling up for long naps. She has the cutest, most expressive eyes that will truly convey all the love she has for her people. 



Extra info: She would do best in a home with an active lifestyle. She requires A LOT of walks and/or play. She’s a big love bug that is still learning her size, so I don’t think a home with small children would be a good fit.

name: Ginger
description_html:
Ginger is a smart, curious pup. She is super focused on you or cheese or that sound coming from over there. She's housetrained and treat-motivated, making her training a joy, knowing basic commands like "sit." She's a great passenger in the car, and easy around the house, happy to gaze out the window or just be close to her humans.

Ginger enjoys exploring, hiking, a good sniff, and puzzle games with treats involved. She'll also do zoomies and is soooo happy to run around the yard and stretch her legs. She loves her humans and gives the most gentle, sweet little kisses.

She's really fun and full of energy. Come meet her today!

name: S'Mores
description_html:
S’Mores may start out a little cautious, but once he feels safe, he becomes an incredibly loving dog. Volunteers say he’s a “huge love bug” in a calm setting — leaning in for affection, relaxing beside his person, and showing a softness that’s easy to fall for. He’s also house-trained (he pees as soon as he reaches the grass!) and walks calmly on leash once he settles into his routine. Because S’Mores is touch-sensitive, he needs a slow, gentle approach when meeting new people. With patience, he opens up beautifully.


S’Mores’ best qualities:

  • Affectionate and snuggly with familiar human friends
  • Walks nicely on leash
  • House-trained
  • Responds well to routine and gentle handling


Best fit:

  • Patient adopter willing to go slow
  • Someone who understands sensitive, thoughtful dogs


S’Mores is a tender-hearted guy who just needs the right person to help him feel safe. Ready to take things slow? Come meet him today!

name: Marcelle
description_html:
Marcelle is an active, independent guy who will happily entertain himself with his favorite toys. He loves to run and play and is always ready for a dip in the pool to cool off. Marcelle also enjoys playing with a well matched dog friend!


When it comes to human friends, Marcelle is a sensitive soul and might be a bit shy at first; he just needs a little time to become confident that you’re a friend. But once he does, you’ll have a really special bond with this guy. Marcelle’s ultimate person would be someone who enjoys an active lifestyle, appreciates an independent guy, and is willing to go at his pace as they build their forever bond. 


Interested in Marcelle? Reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Candy Corn
description_html:
Candy Corn is not your average dog! This handsome boy stands out with his incredibly unique eyes and coat—a striking brindle pattern set against an orange hue, earning him his sweet and tasty name.

He is a delightful companion who brings joy wherever he goes with his infectious smile. Candy Corn is very housetrained and leash-trained, making him a breeze to live with. As a Shepherd-Lab, he adores food and treats (which makes further training fun!).

He also loves playtime, with his favorite activity being fetch, which he’ll happily drop the ball right at your feet. Candy Corn is a playful, loving, and unique pup ready to shower his forever family with affection!


Interested in Candy Corn? Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Apple Fritter
description_html:
Apple Fritter is the perfect mix of sweetness and smarts! This loving, cuddly boy adores being close to his people - whether it’s snuggling on the couch or leaning in for a hug. He’s a great listener and eager to please, making him a joy to have around.


Apple Fritter is both crate trained and house trained, so he’s already mastered his manners. He loves attention but also knows how to relax quietly when it’s time to wind down. He would do best in a home where his owners are home the majority of the time, as he truly thrives on companionship and close connection.


If you’re looking for a loyal companion who will shower you with affection and make every day brighter, Apple Fritter is your guy!

name: Chewy
description_html:
Between his beautiful merle coat, pointy ears, and soft brown eyes Chewy quickly became a staff/volunteer favorite! Chewy likes to meet new humans gently but is cuddly and so so wiggly with his friends. The quickest way to Chewy’s heart is toys, hotdogs, more toys, and more hotdogs!


Chewy’s great leash manners make him a perfect walking buddy and his adorable zoomies in the yard are always full of charm. Chewy’s staff friends describe him as “so dang precious” and “so sweet.”


Have a dog at home? Chewy goes to playgroup at the shelter and is labeled as a solid coexister aka a real chill guy.


Ready to add some love to your life? Chewy is certain to put a smile on your face. Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Loki
description_html:
Loki is a very cute fun puppy. He has some energy and isn't burning it at the shelter, but is delightful in the play yard. He loves chasing toys and getting his zoomies out. He can be a little more excited on leash, but it's nothing crazy. Just toss a toy in front to keep him moving as he learns leash life. He does better after he can burn off his puppiness and will do great in a home that can help him decompress.


Interested in Loki? Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Tiger
description_html: Tiger is a sweet and loving boy! He is wonderful with all people, including kids. He lived in a foster home with a 5-year-old and he was patient and calm with her. Even though he has 3 legs, he gets around flawlessly! He’s happy wherever his people are. If you need a dog to make you smile, he is your guy.

name: Rocko
description_html:
Meet Rocko: The Star of Your Very Own Modern Life! 🐶📺


Looking for a best friend who can navigate the chaos of everyday life with charm, humor, and a wagging tail? Meet Rocko!


Named after the stoic, reasonable wallaby from Rocko’s Modern Life, Rocko is a laid-back gentleman, giant cuddle bug, and certified shadow. He loves treats, fetch, car rides, and being next to his fave people.


Like his cartoon namesake, Rocko is doing his best to navigate the weird and wonderful world around him. He approaches life with curiosity—whether he’s investigating suspicious squirrels, mastering the vacuum cleaner, or trying to understand why humans insist on folding laundry.


When out and about, Rocko is a total pro—happy to hang at an al fresco restaurant or even a busy bar patio. At home, he’s house-trained, leash-trained, crate-trained, and perfectly comfortable relaxing on his own during the workday. Click here for some pics of his adventures with his foster family!


Rocko is shy at first, so he needs slow introductions and would do best in a calm, low-traffic home where he can settle in at his own pace. Once he knows you, he’s incredibly loyal and affectionate. He’s good with cats and could enjoy a furry sibling, but he’d also be happy as your one-and-only.


Because he’s a big guy who sometimes forgets just how big he is, Rocko would do best in a home without small children.


If your modern life needs a little more cuddling, fetch, and ’90s nostalgia, Rocko is ready to take center stage.


Turn the page, wash your hands, and then submit your adoption application.


Adopt Rocko and make your life a little more modern—and a lot more fun!

name: Shamu
description_html: Shamu has been through some tough times and he was not the happiest camper at the shelter, so this lucky boy landed in foster care. He currently resides in a home with other cats and would also do fine as an only child. Shamu can be a hidey cat when he's not feeling brave. He may prefer a calmer home with a cat savvy person to set him up for success. He's not a great fit for small children or dogs. This boy could use a place to decompress and get his kitty life back on track!

name: Mae
description_html:
Meet Mae Mae! This friendly little lab mix loves a game of fetch and even better - a game of fetch IN the pool. Mae can fit into a variety of homes, but her dream would be with someone who will take her swimming or get her a little kiddie pool. Mae is very smart and one of the volunteers' favorite things about her is that she self-entertains. She'd prefer you play fetch with her, but if you're unavailable, Mae will throw the ball to herself! If she sees you on your phone though...she may throw the ball in your general direction so you get the hint. ;) After she gets her playful energy out with a lot of fetch, Mae Mae will climb into your lap for cuddles and pets. 50 pounds isn't too big to be a lap dog, right? We don't think so! She goes potty like a champ outside and is always up for an adventure. Mae walks great on a leash and rides in the car so nicely. She has co-habitated with other dogs at the shelter and could likely live in a home with another respectful "coexister" type dog.


Interested in Mae? Come on in to meet her or reach out to blueplusbusters@gmail.com for more info!

name: Dennis
description_html:
Meet Dennis 🧡

Dennis is a sweet, easygoing guy who really shines once he gets a moment to settle in. He may need a few minutes to warm up when coming out of his kennel, but after that, his gentle and affectionate personality takes over.

In our living room set up at the shelter, Dennis has been a total pro—very housetrained, non-destructive, and happy to relax with a toy while soaking up attention and pets. He’s the kind of dog who’s just as content hanging out with you as he is entertaining himself nearby.

On leash, Dennis generally walks nicely and doesn’t need a harness. He settles into a comfortable, mostly loose-leash walk.

He’s also a smart and eager learner! Dennis is treat-motivated, knows “sit,” and will sometimes offer a paw—an extra cute bonus.

With a little patience at the beginning, Dennis shows you just how loving and laid-back he really is. He’s ready to be someone’s loyal, chill companion.

name: Barry
description_html:
Barry is a lively, curious explorer who treats every day like a brand-new adventure. He loves his walks and will lead the way, sniffing out every new scent, making him the perfect partner for active hikes or morning strolls.

Barry has shown us just how inquisitive he is: loving enrichment puzzles, spelunking under couch covers for treasures, and even helping himself to a few milk bones. He’s a bundle of energy who loves exploring every nook and cranny.

But don’t let his playful antics fool you—Barry has a sweet, affectionate side. Once he’s had his fun, he’s more than happy to settle in next to you for pets and cuddles. He thrives on attention and companionship, making him a wonderful match for someone who enjoys both adventure and downtime.

Barry is ready to bring joy, laughter, and love into his forever home. Could that be with you?

name: Paxton
description_html:
Meet Paxton

As a fun, mature guy, he knows his true loves, being around his people, quiet time with his stuffies and chews, easy relaxing & leisure napping, having a roll in the grass, taking a sploot in the sunshine and if walks are your thing, he's all in for that!


Paxton's very housetrained (never marking!), stays home alone well, and is respectfully QUIET for the sake of your work at home schedule, and your neighbors. He also shares a relaxed pace with a calm dog friend, a 15 yr old Aussie.


Does this handsome man seem to set your heart a flutter? Connect on his link to chat with his foster or write his advocates at caring@classiccanines.org

name: Bear
description_html:
Baron is a volunteer favorite. He's been going on lots of adventures lately and we've learned a bit more about this boy.


He loves car rides and knows "want to go for a car ride". He also knows "want to go to the park". He's great on leash and isn't reactive to any pedestrian traffic (strollers, bikes, dogs, etc).


He's house trained and knows basic commands like sit and shake. Baron loves all things food which makes learning new commands a breeze.


He's one of the more confident dogs when out and about (he's not startled by loud sounds or neighborhood construction). He loves all bodies of water though is still getting used to pools.


At first Baron isn't a cuddly dog that wants pets and prefers to keep touch to a minimum. Once a relationship has been established though he isn't shy to ask for some love!


He's previously lived with a cat but can have a rowdy play style with them. Slow introductions and initial separation would be needed.


Baron can live in a home or an apartment. If you like being active, going on adventures, going for car rides, and the water - he is your boy!

name: Clifford
description_html:
It's Clifford the Big Red Dog, the comic version of John Candy - he started out BIG and dropped to a healthy weight. He's a one-man comedy show. This low riding, floppy eared dog is a real hoot to be with, greeting new friends with a waddle, and a seal-like bark.


Clifford loves nice long walks and snacks, in moderation of course. He's a big fan of lounging and will be your best TV date. He loves a romp in a yard, a splash in a pool, short and long walks, and play with toys. And no matter what kind of day you're having, he's going to make it bigger and brighter for you. He's has all his good indoor manners. And he's healthy. What are you waiting for?


Reach out on his link to learn more about making Clifford your own.

name: Ribeye
description_html:
Come meet a good ole' boy and let him tour you around. Ribeye is family friendly, easy to be with and easy to walk. Let him show you what he knows, an impressive list of commands. Stand by while he's strolls through the pool for a moment. He knows all about relaxing. He knows all about good home living while you're home, and while you're away. He likes trips to parks and has been friendly around other dogs although he didn't live with any.

Ribeye had a lifetime membership in a family and lost it when households merged. He's pushing through this and we're looking for his new family. He's neutered and vaccinated and ready to leave right away. In the meantime he's hanging out with a dog friend.

Would you like to be a bridge to the future for Ribeye?

name: Buddy
description_html:
Hello👋

My name is Buddy! Here are some fun facts about me🐾

  • I was named after the childhood stuffed animal of the person who rescued me from an apartment complex parking lot because she thought I was a big, sweet teddy bear🧸
  • I am a handsome boy with beautiful yellow eyes and brown/tan fur🦮
  • I have a lot of fur, so I shed a lot🐩
  • Currently I weigh about 70 pounds, but now that I have consistent access to food I am finally able to gain weight and will hopefully reach my goal weight of about 85 pounds in the next few months🥓
  • I am perfectly healthy, up-to-date on all of my vaccines and preventatives, and neutered✅
  • I am fully house-trained and will behave perfectly when humans aren’t home, but I don’t ever want to be left in a crate because they make me scared and sad 🏡
  • I am super sweet and loving with all other animals and humans (no matter if they are bigger or smaller than me)❤️
  • I love to give hugs and cuddles, but also give others more personal space if needed🤗
  • I am very gentle and smart🧠
  • I rarely bark🐶
  • I get sad if I am left at home without any other animals or humans for more than 10 hours🥺
  • Throughout the day I switch between having lots of energy and being really sleepy, but at night I am always a deep sleeper💤
  • I love to go on walk/runs and prefer to roam frequently between an indoor space and a yard/porch☀️
  • My favorite activity is socializing with other animals/people and exploring new places! I love to join errand runs and am really well behaved in crowded public spaces😀

name: Fido
description_html: Fido is an absolute doll! This young, silly, floppy puppy already knows sit and seems to be housetrained. He is incredibly friendly and loves people, and he’s playful, affectionate, and so much fun. Fido is also wonderful on leash and gives lots of check-ins while enjoying his walk. He’s an angel of a puppy who would make an amazing companion for a lucky adopter!

name: Lucy
description_html: Lucy is a sweetie with the softest brown eyes and an even bigger heart. This gentle, easygoing girl is the ultimate companion whether you are strolling through the neighborhood or curling up on the couch. Lucy is a dream to walk on a leash, making outdoor time smooth and peaceful. She already knows "sit" and is always eager to show off her polite manners for a cozy cuddle. If you are looking for a loyal, affectionate friend who loves snuggle time just as much as a fresh-air stroll, Lucy is ready to steal your heart!

name: Holmes
description_html: Holmes is a gentle Great Pyrenees with a big heart and the sweetest smile! This laid-back boy warms up quickly once he knows he’s safe. Holmes absolutely adores affection and will happily soak up all the pets and chin scratches you have to offer. He’s low-key by nature, though he does enjoy a playful game of chasing toys when the mood strikes. Overall, Holmes is a calm, kind soul who would love a new home home to blossom. Could this sweet pup be your new best friend?

name: Foxy
description_html: She is sweet, affectionate, and playful. She has been spayed. She is definitely a herding breed. She loves water. Playing and jumping in it. She is good with other dogs. She doesn't react to my 3 dogs when introduced. She is more excited about seeing bigger dogs, than little dogs. (We have two 11 lb chiweenies and a 125lb Corso) She seemed calm also when close to a foster kitten we had for a few weeks so assuming she would learn to be fine with a cat with slow introductions. She has a prey drive though, wants to chase rabbits and birds and frogs and crickets. Loves to grab sticks, leaves but also trash. Gotta watch her, she may chew on things while still in puppy phase. Only use metal bowls with her, when not supervised. She is crate trained and potty trained. She knowingly can hold it for 8-10 hrs. She's learning to sit and lay down. She's learning fetch. She loves to go out on walks, but she still pulls some with her high energy. Always better at the end of the walks, after she's more worn out. Would most likely be a great jogging partner or walking partner or good in multi-dog family. Needs a yard or regular exercise. A handglove hair brush will be your best friend. She loves getting rubbed down and petted all over. It helps so much with the shedding and keeps her looking great. Sooooooo fluffy and soft. She is pretty good about nail trimmings. Keeping it slow and playful with pets, in between clipping nails, helps her be a willing participant. She was food aggressive at first, but not anymore. She is a super sweet girl. She is calm and will wait to be told to eat. Will let me take the bowl away, stick my hand in the bowl while eating, or pet her while eating. She may stop eating but doesn't react. She is very gentle about taking treats from the hand too.

name: Jojo
description_html: JoJo is a sweet, treat-loving boy who is potty trained and ready to find his forever home! He was a loose-leash walker with only mild pulling and enjoyed exploring on his walk. JoJo was comfortable meeting new people and showed a curious, friendly side. He had no kennel stress observed and did well living in a crate. JoJo would make a wonderful companion for an active family looking for a loving, medium-energy pup who is already housetrained and leash trained.

name: Buster
description_html:
☀️ Buster is ready to trade the streets for a loving home. 🧡


A kindhearted citizen brought Buster to us after noticing that the extreme heat was taking a toll on him. Life on the streets is tough for any cat, and this handsome boy deserves so much more than having to fend for himself.


Thankfully, shelter life has shown us that Buster is sweet, affectionate, and loves attention. 🥰 He can sometimes become overstimulated, so he’s looking for someone who understands that cats have their own love languages—and is willing to learn his. Give him the right kind of attention and respect his boundaries, and Buster will show you just how special he is.


And can we talk about that face? 📸 Buster clearly knows how to strike a pose! This photogenic boy is ready for his close-up—and, more importantly, his forever home.


He’s been through the challenges of life outside. Now Buster deserves a soft bed, a cool place to relax, and a person who will love him for exactly who he is.

name: Sour Patch Kid
description_html:
Sour Patch Kid is a shy guy who came in with his friend Lemon Bar. They were cared for in their neighborhood until the area become unsafe for them. These boys may be shy, but they hold lots of promise for being able to trust new people.

Sour Patch Kid loves other cats and enjoys their company. He would do well with his friend, Lemon Bar, or other feline friends in a home. He will do best in a cat savvy home willing to help him build his social skills.

Sour Patch Kid has joined our Cactus Cat program to get extra attention and companionship with other shy cats.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Sour Patch Kid and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Gunther
description_html:
Sweet Gunther is a beautiful dog. He is gentle, affectionate, housetrained, and cuddly. Gunther strolls along easily on a leash, calmly passing other dogs. He loves to roll around in the play yard and will pause for belly rubs. He will make a wonderfully calm companion!

Gunther is waiting for his loving forever home. Come meet him- he will capture your heart ❤️.

name: Munchkin
description_html:
💚 Meet Munchkin!


Munchkin arrived at the shelter after being brought in by law enforcement after his prior owner lost their housing. We can only imagine how confusing and frightening that must have been for her.


She’s shy and cautious, but there’s a very sweet girl underneath that uncertainty. Once she feels safe, Munchkin will lean right into your pets and purr—little by little showing you just how much affection she has to give. And those gorgeous bright green eyes? Absolutely impossible to resist. 💚


Munchkin needs someone patient who will give her the time and security she needs to feel comfortable. In return, you’ll get to watch a shy kitty blossom into a loving companion.

name: Dorian
description_html:
Meet Dorian 💛


Dorian may have arrived as a stray, but one thing is already clear: this girl loves people. 🐾


The person who found her said Dorian was surprisingly easy to trap because she was so friendly. At intake, she happily accepted pets and was easy for staff to handle and transfer.


Shelter life has her feeling a little shy in her kennel, but when she gets some one-on-one attention, her affectionate side comes out. She clearly wants interaction and connection—even if she sometimes lets out a little growl during it. We’re still figuring out what she’s trying to communicate, and she deserves someone patient enough to give her the time and space to show us.


Could you be the patient person who helps Dorian feel safe enough to let her personality shine?

name: Grace
description_html:
Meet Grace! 🐾


Grace arrived at our shelter as a stray, like so many cats who have had to fend for themselves outdoors. She was a little unthrifty—not quite thriving in the outdoor life.


Thankfully, Grace is now safe indoors, and she’s showing us what a difference a little kindness can make. She’s friendly, enjoys being petted, and is ready for the next chapter of her life. Will someone give Grace a little grace? ❤️


She deserves a safe, loving indoor home where she can relax, be cherished, and finally thrive. Could that home be yours?

name: Pepper Jack
description_html:
He may be a tripod, but that hasn’t slowed him down one bit! After losing a leg, he healed beautifully and was back to moving and grooving just days later. Now, he’s ready to freely play, explore, and frolic his way through life.

He’s curious, affectionate, and happiest when he’s right by your side. His heart is just as big as his spirit, and his resilience is impossible not to admire. This sweet boy has a heart of gold and he’s ready for someone who will love him for the incredible dog he is. ❤️

name: Perlay
description_html:
Perlay is an absolutely beautiful, gentle girl who is as easygoing as they come. She walks beautifully on a loose leash, is easy to handle, and enjoys taking her time to sniff and explore. She was neutral toward both people and dogs, and even when startled by an unexpected bark, she recovered quickly.


Perlay is brand new to the shelter and can be a little shy, so she’ll do best with a patient family willing to give her time to settle in and feel comfortable. She also appears strongly bonded to her buddy, Papucho, and we would love to see these two sweet souls find a home together. Give them a little time to adjust, and they’ll repay you with plenty of love. Perlay may just become your favorite chill girl!


Adoption traits: Independent, leash trained, medium energy, gentle, shy, and affectionate.

name: Peppers
description_html: Meet Peppers, an active and clever companion looking for an adult-only home ready for outdoor adventures. While he can be a bit shy when first settling into new environments, he quickly blossoms into a fiercely loyal, velcro shadow who loves staying right by his person's side. Peppers is a smart explorer with a zest for life and an adventurous spirit who thrives with a secure, open setup rather than a traditional crate. With his great leash manners and enthusiasm for the outdoors, he is a fantastic match for an adopter with an energetic lifestyle who wants a dedicated best friend.

name: Mina
description_html: Super sweet, playful girl! She loves people and other cats, matches your energy and is super friendly and cuddly!

name: Royce
description_html:
Discover the gentleman behind the sugar frosted face ~

Royce is friendly to all people and children he's met, and friendly toward friendly dogs and prefers lady dog friends. He's house trained. He knows some cues like sit, down and shake/paw and likes squeaky toys.

He's loyal and distinguished without being "old" and he's bravely started a journey to the rest of his life by being here-do you envision finishing his shelter story? Put this sugar frosted friend on your "must meet" list.

A common question - why is this dog here? Royce's last home was not well suited for the needs of a dog. He lived with 1 person who regularly left him alone for up to 12 hours without breaks, making him cry for help, and sometimes he couldn't wait any longer for a potty break.

name: Barbara
description_html:
Barbara’s life changed suddenly when her beloved owner passed away, and she came to the shelter with no family able to take her in.

If you want a cat with a funny face and a big heart, Barbara’s your girl. She may take a bit to get settled in, but once she does, she’ll win you over right away. She wants to feel connected to you- she loves to eat with you, work with you, play with you, etc.

Barbara doesn’t care what’s happening as long as she can be by your side. She’s very talkative; she’ll run up to the door when you come home and tell you all about her day. Her hobbies include biscuit-making, bird watching, sitting in laps, biiiiig stretches, and (somewhat relentlessly) asking for pets.

If you ever do something Barbara doesn’t like (such as picking her up without permission), she’ll redirect you with gentle kisses.

If you’ve got a mellow household and are looking for the perfect little companion, come meet Barbara today!

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Barbara and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Beau
description_html:
Beau is the kind of dog who makes it easy to fall in love. This sweet boy is a loose-leash walker who enjoys taking his time to sniff and explore the world around him. He seems housetrained and has a gentle, affectionate nature—he's happiest when he's getting pets and soaking up all the love you have to give.


While Beau can be barrier reactive in his kennel when other dogs pass by, he showed a completely different side once outside, calmly ignoring other dogs on his walk. Shelter life can be stressful, but out in the open he's an easygoing companion who just wants to enjoy a nice stroll and spend time with his people.


If you're looking for a cuddly, loving best friend who enjoys leisurely walks and plenty of affection, Beau may be the perfect match!

name: George
description_html:
George is an easy dog to fall for. Even when he was staying in the crate room, he kept his space neat and tidy, often relaxing with his paws crossed like a perfect gentleman. He was great about letting volunteers know when he needed to go outside, which suggests he may be housetrained.


He is currently living in a foster family with kids aged 8- and 12 - years old plus a German Shepherd mix female dog. He gets on well with all humans and dogs that he has met.


On walks, George is a loose leash walker with only mild pulling when something catches his attention. He enjoys sniffing and exploring, checks in often with his handler, and is curious but friendly around both people and other dogs. He's playful, happy, and always seems ready to have fun.


George has quickly become a volunteer favorite thanks to his sweet personality, easy leash manners, and joyful spirit. If you're looking for a playful companion who's just as happy exploring the world as he is spending time with his people, George is ready to meet you.

name: Trisha
description_html:
🐾 Meet Trinket, Turkey, and Trisha


Trinket, Turkey, and Trisha came to us together and very scared. They were never aggressive; they were simply fearful and unsure of this big, unfamiliar world.


Then, to make things even harder, all three came down with upper respiratory infections. They received the care and treatment they needed, and thankfully, they’re now back to their silly, playful selves! ❤️They’re still learning that people can be trusted, but they’re making progress every day. And that’s where we’re hoping their future adopters come in.


We see it far too often: shy brown tabbies (and, in this case, one beautiful torbie) can be overlooked while the more outgoing kittens get all the attention. Before long, those overlooked kittens grow up at the shelter simply because they needed a little more time to feel comfortable. We really, really hope that doesn’t happen to Trinket, Turkey, and Trisha. 🥺


These three deserve the chance to grow up in loving homes where they can continue to learn, play, blossom, and discover just how wonderful life can be. They can be adopted with one of their siblings or separately, although we think each would benefit from another feline friend at home.

name: Trinket
description_html:
🐾 Meet Trinket, Turkey, and Trisha

name: Snuffie
description_html:
Snuffie is a quiet, friendly girl with an impressive amount of home experience. In a home setting, she is housetrained and can remain loose in the house alone for hours and remain on her best behavior! She routinely slept in a crate overnight and already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'come'.


Snuffie has also lived with another dog and is playful with dogs both big and small. She has also participated in shelter playgroup and been paired with a doggy roommate. She was initially timid when entering the play yard for her first play group, but she tolerated enthusiastic greetings from other dogs and began exploring once she felt more comfortable. She may be a lovely match for a canine companion given a little time to settle in!


Her former owner also described her as playful around cats. As always, slow introductions and supervision will help everyone adjust successfully in a new home. Snuffie is currently being fostered in a home with 2 small dogs and three cats.


Snuffie walks well on a leash and harness, enjoys chase, wrestling, squeaky toys, and chew bones. She even reportedly enjoys baths (current foster says not so much), being picked up (she needs a little assistance getting in taller vehicles), and having her nails trimmed! She may start out a little shy, but her quiet nature, excellent home skills, and friendly personality give her all the ingredients of a wonderful companion.


*She has rather short little legs, so it is not easy for her to "jump" in or out of a vehicle. She weighs just over 40 llbs, so it's not too difficult to assist her in loading up. She's an adorable little short stack!

name: Tintin
description_html: Tintin, with his handsome dark brindle coat, is a pup with a smile that lights up every room! With his perfectly balanced medium energy, Tintin is always up for a fun game of happily chasing down his favorite toys with classic, tail-wagging enthusiasm. Once playtime wraps up, this sweet boy instantly transitions into world-class cuddle mode, eager to lean right in and soak up all the affection you have to offer. Whether you’re heading out for a stroll or cozying up on the couch, Tintin is ready to be your ultimate best friend!

name: Eria
description_html:
Eria is a shortcake lovebug. Although she's just under a year old, she has the spirit of a sweet, older soul who just wants love and belly scratches. She plays independently, enjoying plushies and rope toys, and is bravely navigating new sounds in her foster's home (and climbing into bed, which is a challenge at her pocket pittie height).


Eria knows "sit," is working on her recall, and is potty and crate trained. She is a gentle treat taker and likes to follow her people around, plus enjoys taking equal turns at napping and puppy-rowdy fun times. She also walks well on leash and is nonreactive to dogs; she was kenneled with a dog at the shelter.


Her ideal home may be low traffic, no small kids, until she gains a little more confidence with your help. Meet Eria today!

name: Bea
description_html:
Meet Bea – A Gentle Girl Waiting for Her Chance


Bea was brought to the shelter by a kind person who described her as very friendly. She was the perfect lady for our veterinary team during intake.


The shelter can be overwhelming, so Bea is a little shy here. But give this sweet girl a chance, and you'll see her gentle, loving personality shine through.


Bea just needs a quiet, caring home where she can feel safe and be herself. In return, she'll be a wonderful companion with a kind heart. Come meet Bea and see how special she is!

name: Louie
description_html:
🐾 Siblings Still Waiting for Their Chance 🐾


Meet Louie and Gertie! These siblings arrived with three other kittens, and all five came down with upper respiratory infections. Thankfully, they’ve recovered—and their three siblings have already been adopted. ❤️


Now it’s their turn.


Louie is very playful. He's also an escape artist---he has busted out of his kennel, twice! Gertie is the shyest. We finally were able to get a better photo of her than her intake picture where she looks terrified. She just needs a little extra patience to feel safe and confident.


These two have been through a lot and are ready for someone to give them a chance to blossom. Could you be the person they’ve been waiting for? They can be adopted separately or together! 🏡🐱

name: Oreo
description_html:
Double stuffed with affection and charm! Oreo’s perfect day includes window watching, chasing his fishing wand, enjoying treats, and lounging near his favorite people. This curious gentleman loves to know what’s happening around him and even though he may be a little shy initially, he is always ready to investigate something or someone new.

When he’s not exploring, Oreo is happily soaking up pets, and he’s just as eager to give affection right back.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Oreo and ALL Desperate Housecats!


Check out my Instagram!

name: Darcy
description_html:
Darcy arrived as a stray, but it was clear right away she’s a friendly, affectionate girl who likely once had a family. While at the shelter, she developed an upper respiratory infection and handled treatment like a champ. She’s now fully recovered and ready for a fresh start.


Darcy is incredibly affectionate and absolutely loves being around people. She’s playful, energetic, and full of personality, always ready for fun or a cuddle. She’s also very food-motivated—canned food is the way to her heart! 🍽️


Darcy would thrive in a home where she’ll get plenty of love, attention, and interaction. She has so much affection to give and would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a sweet, adorable cat to share life with.


Darcy deserves a soft bed, a full bowl, and a loving home where she’ll never have to fend for herself again. Could Darcy be your new best friend? ❤️🐾

name: Junie
description_html:
🐾 Meet Junie: 2yrs old, 10/10 personality. 💕


Yes, you saw that right... this girl is missing a paw! But please don’t tell Junie she’s supposed to be slowed down by it, because she clearly did not get that memo. 😂

Junie was born without one of her paws, and while she may prefer a nice grassy stroll over pounding the pavement, three paws are plenty for sniffing adventures, couch climbing, snack acquisition, and stealing hearts.


This calm, gentle house hippo is an absolute sweetheart. She’s a lovely loose-leash walker who likes to take her time, smell the smells, and enjoy the journey. And if treats happen to be involved? Even better. Junie is VERY snack motivated and would like everyone to know that compensation for being adorable is expected.


After spending more than two weeks in a crate at the shelter, Junie has settled beautifully into her kennel routine. She’s housetrained, leash-trained, cuddly, and perfectly happy to trade adventures for some quality couch time with her people.

She’s also interested in other dogs and has a playful side when the mood strikes. But overall? Junie’s vibe is less marathon athlete and more “Where are we going, and will there be snacks and a couch when we get there?”


She is thriving with her foster in an apartment with an elevator and would do great in a home with a backyard! She is so sweet to the resident dog, her 7-year-old foster auntie, Arya.


Junie, isn’t looking for sympathy. She’s looking for a home. Preferably a comfortable one, with a human attached who appreciates a laid-back, affectionate, slightly wonky house hippo. 🥹


✨ 3 paws

✨ 5-star snuggler

✨ Housetrained

✨ Leash-trained

✨ Crate comfortable

✨ Dog Social

✨ Professional couch potato

✨ Certified snack enthusiast


Junie may be missing a paw, but she isn’t missing a thing that matters. 💗

Now she just needs her person.

name: Tamara
description_html:
Tamara is proof that love can endure. Despite being treated with cruelty in the past, she still greets people with trust, kindness, and an endless supply of affection. She's an easygoing, medium-energy girl who walks beautifully on a loose leash, appears housetrained, and loves to check in with her person while exploring. Whether she's sniffing around the yard or simply following you from place to place, Tamara's happiest when she's by your side.


She is very gentle, treat-motivated, and absolutely adores attention. Volunteers describe her as a "100% darling dog"—the kind of companion who makes every outing easy and enjoyable.

name: Daisy
description_html:
Meet Daisy 🌼

Daisy is ready for a fresh start after coming from a home with far too many cats—we’ve taken in over 50 from that location alone. Now she finally has the chance to relax and enjoy having her own space.

While she originally arrived with other cats she knew, Daisy has shown she prefers not to share her space with so many feline roommates. After a lifetime of competition, she’s ready to be the center of attention in a calmer home.

Since moving into her own kennel, Daisy has been settling in and enjoying the peace and quiet. She’s looking for a home where she can feel safe, loved, and appreciated...

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Daisy and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Asher
description_html:
Asher is a smart, affectionate dog with an impressive trick repertoire and a wonderfully cuddly side. During a recent shelter outing, he spent ten minutes cuddling with his handler, gave kisses, accepted pets all over, and was easy to return to his kennel.


Asher knows 'sit', 'down', 'stay', 'come', 'spin', and 'drop it'. He responds beautifully when given a cue and rewarded for his good work, making training a fun way to build a relationship with him. His former family described him as athletic and playful but also content to relax for much of the day. His favorite activities include fetch, tug, chase, walks, squeaky toys, and chew bones.


Asher previously lived successfully with a female dog and has potential to live with another canine companion. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident pets!

name: Winslow
description_html: Hi my name is Winslow and I’m looking for my forever home and owner. I really love being outside- especially sniffing everything and playing with other dogs. I have lots of energy so I like being very active. I get stir crazy if I’m cooped up inside too long. I’m potty trained and when I want- I am really good at fetch. I like treats a lot too. I haven’t met any cats yet but I’m pretty sure I’ll like them. I currently live on a property with a donkey and goat and we all get along great.

name: Athena
description_html: Athena is a snuggly, playful, inquisitive little girl. She enjoys playing with Q-tips, hair ties, and little balls. In her downtime she loves to curl up next to you (or on top of you) and purr you to sleep. She is friendly with dogs, cats, and other kittens. If you’re looking for a playful but cuddly companion, Athena is your girl.

name: Ray
description_html:
Some dogs wear their hearts on their sleeves, while others just need a little time. This sweet boy is still settling into shelter life and can be a bit shy, especially around the noise of barking dogs. When he's feeling unsure, he'll happily walk close behind his person, looking to them for reassurance.


Once he's away from the kennel environment, his personality starts to shine. He enjoys leisurely walks, taking time to sniff and explore, and checks in with his handler often. He's housetrained, walks nicely on a loose leash, and politely ignores both people and other dogs while out and about.


Toys aren't usually his thing—but hand him a shark stuffie and you'll see the cutest side of him! Watching him toss it into the air and catch it himself is guaranteed to make you smile. It's clear he's beginning to relax and come out of his shell a little more every day.


This gentle, medium-energy boy would thrive with a patient adopter who will let him settle in at his own pace. Give him a little time, a quiet place to decompress, and maybe a shark toy of his own, and you'll get to watch his confidence grow into something truly special.

name: Gumbo
description_html:
Meet Gumbo 🥘 a big-hearted, affectionate guy ready to trade shelter life for a comfy couch. His previous family described him as "the most loving and affectionate" dog. He was surrendered due to housing issues. He's house trained, crate trained, and stayed home alone for 4-8 hours a day. He knows Spanish and English, making him bilingual.

Gumbo enjoys his time at the shelter with sniff walks, pool time, treats, cuddles and being a special invitee to volunteer meetings where he greets everyone politely and then takes a much needed sleep break. Here's your loving and loyal human companion who enjoys the simple things in life, and is happiest close to his people. Gumbo may be your perfect recipe. ❤️

name: Niomi (petco)
description_html:
Niomi is a retired momma cat! 😽


She decided to have her kittens on a nice person's patio and they cared for her while she nursed her babies. Now her kittens are off living their dreams while Niomi is still searching for her home.


This is a recurring theme in the life of many young female cats. Niomi is very outgoing, confident, affectionate and loves pets. She can be playful and enjoys space to romp around. Niomi may do best in a home where she can be the #1 diva and get your full attention. Adopt this special lady today! 🏡💖

name: Taz
description_html:
Meet Taz!


Taz is a lovable, happy-go-lucky young pup who is ready to find his forever family! At just over a year old, this handsome boy is full of energy, affection, and enthusiasm for life. His favorite things include long walks, chewing on his favorite bones, and soaking up attention from the people he loves.


Taz is a friendly, social dog who enjoys meeting new people and has done well with both men and women. He’s lived with a young infant and is described as loving and sweet. One of his favorite ways to show affection is by giving hugs, and he’s always excited to be close to his people.


This smart boy already knows several commands, including sit, stay, and shake. He also has excellent mealtime manners—he can patiently wait for permission before eating until he hears his release cue. Taz is house-trained and crate-trained.


Taz enjoys playing with other dogs. He’s friendly when approached by strangers on walks and generally loves being part of the action.


Thunderstorms and fireworks can make Taz nervous, and car rides aren’t his favorite activity, but with patience and reassurance he settles back in. Because he’s still a young, energetic dog, he’ll thrive with a family that can provide regular exercise and plenty of love.


Taz’s family is making the difficult decision to rehome him due to military housing breed restrictions, not because of any fault of his own. They describe him as very loving, playful, happy, sweet, and devoted.


If you’re looking for a loyal companion who loves hugs, adventures, and being part of the family, Taz may be the perfect match for you!

name: Cassia
description_html:
Cassia is a beautiful, sweet, and shy girl. She arrived at AAS after being rescued from a community environment. Upon arrival, the DVM noticed that she has chronic but stable eye conditions, which are likely the result of previous URI and ulcerated corneas. Her right eye remains dilated and her left eye has collapsed a bit. No treatment is required at this time, and her eyes are not painful. They should be monitored for any sudden changes as there is the potential for glaucoma to develop.

As a member of our Cactus Cats program, Cassia is becoming more comfortable with people. She tends to hide, but likes to be petted. She is not aggressive, she’s just learning to appreciate everything that humans are good for.

Cassia will do best in a home with a cat buddy. She was friends with Bee in their foster home.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Cassia and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Piggy
description_html:
Piggy is the total package—sweet, silly, playful, and guaranteed to keep you smiling. With his giant expressive ears and happy personality, it's hard not to fall in love with him!

This happy boy is a dream to take out and about. He's a loose leash walker, rides politely in the car, and stays calm around just about everything. On his day out, he happily ignored other dogs, adults, children, squirrels, and even ducks, preferring to spend his time sniffing and exploring.

Piggy loved meeting new people and greeted everyone with a wagging tail and playful bows, soaking up all the pets. Once back at the house, he spent hours happily playing with toys—his absolute favorite! Whether you want to play tug or toss a toy, or let him entertain himself, Piggy is always ready for fun. He's also very treat-motivated, making him eager to learn.

He appears to be housetrained, had no accidents, and didn't try to get into anything he shouldn't. If you're looking for a goofy, easygoing companion who loves adventures, toys, and making people laugh, Piggy is ready to be your new best friend.

Outing:

I took him to spend the day with me at my house. We went for a walk in the neighborhood in the morning and then the rest of the day I scattered all of the dog toys around the house and he got to play with all of them. He was so happy and wagging his tail while he got to play with all of the toys. He also enjoyed some frozen dog, friendly enrichment. I learned that he does not resource guard, food or toys at all, even though he get super excited about both. He is definitely an active dog, but I don’t think he needs someone that’s going to go on tons of hikes and super long walk, rather he just really likes to play with toys, play fetch, etc. He does enjoy walks and is very good on leash - no reactivity at all. He also seems so much more confident with handling then he did when he first arrived to the shelter and I think would make a fantastic dog for doggy day out. He’s incredibly sweet and sat in the backseat of my car very politely. When I brought him back to his kennel at the end of the day, he greeted his sweet mate with a kiss, and it was super cute.

name: Diamond
description_html:
Meet Diamond!

Diamond is a sweet, gentle girl with a heart as precious as her name. After spending more than two years in a loving home, she is looking for a new family through no fault of her own after her owner had to move and was unable to take her along.


This friendly pup has lived successfully in an apartment and is both house-trained and paper-trained, with no history of accidents in the home. She has wonderful indoor manners, making her an easy companion to have around the house.

When left alone, Diamond can be trusted to relax freely in the home and has not shown any destructive behaviors.


Diamond's favorite activities include playing fetch, chasing toys, chewing on bones, and carrying around her beloved squeaky toys. She also knows several commands, including sit, stay, come, and shake, and enjoys spending quality time with her people.


Those who know Diamond describe her as incredibly sweet and friendly. She has done well with children and has a calm, gentle nature. While she can be shy around men and may take some time to warm up to unfamiliar people, patience and kindness help her build confidence. She may bark when someone new enters the home and can be a little nervous when approached by strangers on walks, but she has never shown any aggression.


Diamond is also cooperative with handling, allowing baths, nail trims, and being picked up, although she can be a little nervous during bath time. Loud noises and vacuums can be scary for her, so she appreciates a family that understands her sensitive side and can help her feel safe and secure.


She would thrive in a patient, loving home that can give her the time and companionship she deserves. If you're looking for a loyal, gentle companion who enjoys playtime, quiet evenings, and being close to her family, Diamond may be the perfect match for you.


Come meet Diamond and discover what a gem she truly is!

name: Zayda
description_html:
Zayda is a sweet, playful puppy with some excellent real-life skills already under her belt. Shelter staff describe her as house-trained and a loose-leash walker, making her a great candidate for someone looking for a dog who already has a head start on home manners.


Zayda can be a little shy when she first enters a new situation, but once she feels comfortable, her playful side comes out. During her initial shelter playgroup evaluation, she greeted the other dogs appropriately, relaxed into loose, happy zoomies, and began actively inviting them to play. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs to make sure everyone is a good fit!

name: Contexto
description_html:
Contexto is a total dreamboat - a smiley, handsome guy who will sweep you off your feet if you let him.

He’s a little shy at first, but warms up really quickly. He’s a calm and easy leash-walker, checking in with his person often. He’s an ace at commands like “sit” and “shake”, but he also has a silly, playful side. He loves belly rubs, snuggling, and most of all just being near his people.

name: Haisai
description_html:
Haisai is a smart, polished companion with an outstanding training foundation and a playful side waiting just beneath the surface. A shelter volunteer described him as a perfect loose-leash walker who naturally heels beside his person and regularly checks in without being asked. He is polite and attentive—qualities that make spending time with him a genuine pleasure.


Haisai has an impressive repertoire of skills. He knows 'sit', 'down', 'stay', 'come', 'shake', and 'high five', and loves to show off on the shelter’s agility course. He is highly motivated by treats and eager to work with his person, making training a wonderful way to bond with him.


Haisai is housetrained and familiar with a crate routine. His former caregiver reported that he had no accidents, stayed in a crate while home alone, and slept there overnight. He even understands 'go home' as a cue to enter his kennel. His favorite things include walks, squeaky toys, chewing on bones, exploring a yard, and receiving plenty of scratches and pets.


Haisai also has experience playing and socializing with other dogs. During shelter playgroup, he began somewhat stiff and nervous but soon relaxed enough to enjoy zoomies and was successfully paired with a doggy roommate. He can become vocal or over-excited when he sees dogs through kennel gates or other barriers, so introductions should take place thoughtfully outside that environment. Haisai has potential to live with a well-matched canine companion—ask shelter staff about arranging a meet-and-greet with your resident dog!


Haisai loves his people and may cry or bark when left alone for extended periods. A family that can provide companionship, enrichment, and gradual practice with being alone will help him settle successfully. He is also frightened by loud noises and would appreciate a quiet retreat when the world gets noisy.


For someone seeking an exceptionally well-trained dog who can join them for walks, agility, playtime, and plenty of affection, Haisai has so much to offer! Come meet him today.

name: Finch
description_html:
All of Finch's volunteer friends can't tell you enough how sweet natured, gentle, and a complete dream boat he is!


Not only is Finch handsome, but he is one of our easiest dogs at the shelter. He is a complete loose leash walker, taking time to sniff around and people watch. He seems to be pretty house trained, which is incredible for a dog that only gets out 20 minutes a day if that. In a yard Finch loves to lay around in the kiddie pool during this Texas heat or casually enjoy a game of fetch. He is a handsome young dog who walks like a dream on leash. Finch warms up pretty quickly to people and loves affection! He is also a sucker for treats.


If you are looking for a shepherd on the easier side, this guy should be #1 on your list!

name: Bruce
description_html:
Bruce shows us how much he loves and adores the people who care for him. He's very gentle. He asks only that you be sensitive with his heart and he'll reward you many times over.


He's smooth as silk on a leash.

He's crate trained, ideal for transitions and traveling to other's homes

Bruce will be neutered for adoption or while in foster care.

Are you ready to show a sweet dog all that life is supposed to be?

He's waiting to meet you..

name: Mollie
description_html:
This stinkin' adorable gal is super friendly with both people and other cats!

Mollie was living in a church yard (she was so friendly she would rub against church attendees), and was brought to AAS because she had a tail injury. Her tail was amputated and she moved into foster care to complete her recovery.

Mollie is playful, and wants nothing more than to be petted or to cuddle. Don't miss your opportunity to take this wonderful feline home!

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Mollie and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Beauty
description_html: Beauty takes a moment to warm up, but she's sooo sweet! She is very playful and affectionate once she gets to know you. She loves to romp around the play yard and chase toys, then she's happy to settle in with some pets. Beauty has lived with dogs in the past so may do well with a canine companion in the home with proper introductions. This special lady is ready for her next adventure in a home today!

name: Kanga
