description_html: Kangaskhan is a good natured, affectionate lady who had to be surrendered due to housing restrictions. She is crate trained and walks very well on leash! She knows several commands in Spanish: sit, stay, down, come and paw. Besides snuggles with people, she also loves squeaky toys and chew bones. This laid back lady is ready to be your special new family member today!

name: Truffle
description_html: Cherry & Truffle came in together and love each other very much so they must be adopted together! Cherry is very loyal and loving. She enjoys being close to her people without the need to be on top of them! Truffle will steal pets from you and soak up all your attention. They both love window watching. These girls are in need of some TLC today!

name: Charlie
description_html:
Charlie is a darling handsome grand boy. Big at heart, with an easy going manner who brings a sense of calm to his foster home.

Charlie arrived to the shelter as an unknown dog, with a large knot on his front left leg that deserved a closer look. It was steadily growing followed a progression typically seen in bone cancer. In his foster home he's been paired with medical support by Classic Canines and after further assessment, all DVM's agreed that leg should be removed. Charlie is healthy and quite fit and will thrive as a tripod and not be in pain and with the threat of an untimely bone break averted.


See his before short video here.

Check back soon for an after video. His surgery is 7/6/2026.


He's very housetrained, nice to walk on a leash but whether he's on 3 legs or 4 legs, lizard and squirrel chases are going to always be fun for him. He'll be ready to play fetch again soon. He prefers to not have to eat alone and loves having a view to the outside world and loves companionship. He was mascot to a volunteer enrichment exercise and was said to be like a therapy dog for all. He's very social and loves everyone equally.


Charlie is advocated for by his friends at ClassicCaninesATX which means his adopters get extra support for supplies and care with his adoption and of course, all medical records..

name: Howard E Butts
description_html:
Meet Howard E Butts.  Howard was found roaming around the local Dollar Tree.  Unfortunately, Howard's bank account was empty, but he found a nice lady that lured him to the car with cold sausages. As his name implies, he is a true Texan, and a true lover of ALL groceries. 


Howard has been enjoying time with his foster brothers Jonah (a human) and George Bailey (a dog that thinks he’s human.)  He loves walks in the hood, and a couch cuddle right after.  He knows what “go potty,” “sit,” “bedtime,” “dinner,” and “treat,” all mean… and he doesn’t miss a meal. 


Howard loves people, and dogs.  He loves sharing water and toys, but prefers dinner alone.  He is fast, but is easily recalled. Howard loves getting a little alone time, sleeping in his crate at night. His foster mom and dad love snuggling him, and would love to see him go to a home where he gets outdoor time, snuggles, and maybe has a sibling or two, though he also would be cool with alone time.

name: Cookyz N Cream
description_html:
Cookyz N Cream is the sweetest big guy! Just like his name suggests, he is the perfect blend of charming good looks (the cutest freckles!) and an ultra-smooth, chill personality. This handsome fella has a striking face and soulful eyes that will instantly melt your heart.

He excels at loose-leash walking, making outdoor strolls a breeze. When he is not enjoying a relaxed walk, he loves nothing more than turning into a giant, cuddly, affectionate dog. He knows some commands like “sit” and is ready to learn more! This scrumptious pup is ready for his forever!

name: Layla
description_html:
Layla was in foster care where we learned so much about her! She's extremely affectionate and loves to cuddle, putting her head on your chest or thigh whenever she can. If allowed, she'll also give kisses. While she may be shy around new people, it only takes her 30 minutes or so to come out of her shell. Layla enjoys exploring her surroundings with her companions and stays close by your side. She would thrive in a home that offers her the attention she craves and deserves!


"She is such a dream to walk. You have to look out for the occasional squirrel, which she will try to chase if you get too close, otherwise she is a loose leash walker who checks in often. I started teaching her "sit" and she is eager to learn it and has gotten it on her own already a couple of times. She was a dream in the car. She was not fearful of the car ride and just laid down in the backseat. I did introduce her to my cat through a fenced off area and she seemed to lunge at the cat similarly to how she was lunging to chase a squirrel on her walk."

name: Milo
description_html:
Howdy folks!

I'm Milo and I have a lot of people friends here who adore me. They say I smile a lot and I'm loads of fun and they love my puppyish looks and how I like just hanging out while everyone is chatting. I love making new friends and can't wait to meet you too. Will ya hurry up please?


Let's get business behind us so we can get back to some fun play time

  • I'm very house trained
  • I love free play time, good chews, squeakers, stuffies, hikes and other fun stuff
  • I've been crated at the shelter - this is a good stay-home-alone plan for me
  • I'll be happy to keep your spaces clear of squirrels and critters, yup
  • I'm an expert fisherman - check out my short video


See you soon, Your Best New Friend Milo

name: Robin
description_html:
Robin spent just three weeks in foster—and it changed everything 💕

Away from the shelter, this gentle, soulful boy began to relax, trust, and let his personality shine. His foster watched him transform into an affectionate, goofy companion who loves sunshine, morning walks, bird and butterfly watching, a good chew, and simply being close to his people. Robin doesn’t need constant entertainment—he just wants to be part of your day.

Robin is crate trained, potty trained, and settled beautifully into home life. He thrives with consistency, patience, and positive reinforcement. Like many sensitive dogs, he may take a little time to feel comfortable in new places or with new people, but every day in foster he grew more confident, playful, and relaxed. Watching Robin blossom is one of the most rewarding parts of knowing him.

Robin would do best as the only pet in a calm home where he can continue building confidence. If you’re looking for an instant party animal, Robin probably isn’t your guy. But if your heart melts watching a dog slowly realize he’s safe—if you believe the best friendships are earned—you’ll find an incredibly loyal companion in Robin.

name: Angel
description_html:
Brawn AND brains? Yes, please. 💙

This sweet girl is the total package—affectionate, smart, and full of personality. She lives for love and will happily trade treats for cuddles any day. Expect lots of kisses, snuggles, and her signature wiggle butt when she’s showing off her skills!

✔️ Knows: sit, down, stop, come, paw

✔️ Fully potty trained

✔️ Crate trained (just prefers not to be left too long)

✔️ Super people-focused and eager to please

She gets the cutest little wrinkles when she’s waiting for praise—because attention is her favorite reward.

On leash, she’s a strong girl and can pull, so she’ll benefit from some continued training—but she’s smart and motivated, so she’s a great candidate to learn quickly.

If you’re looking for a loyal, loving, and fun companion who wants to be your shadow and your snuggle buddy, she’s your girl.

Come meet her—you’ll fall in love fast. 🐾💙

name: Felicia
description_html:
Felicia has been welcomed to a foster home that she shares with her caregivers, a dog and a cat. She's very polite to cats, both indoors and outdoors, and her current dog friend is a very cute, small older dog friend. She would probably enjoy a friendly, polite dog she can snuggle and play with.


Where people are, you'll find Felicia quietly nearby, just in case there's a call out for a snuggle, she'll be right there. Felicia also seems child friendly.


Her personality is gentle, sweet and easy.

She walks nicely on a leash and rides well in a car.

She's shown herself to be well rounded.


Felicia is healthy and comes with a clean bill of health from the shelter and her advocates at ClassicCaninesATX.


A common question - why is this dog in a shelter system?

Felicia was part of a larger dog crew that lost a longtime home and came to the shelter for safety. Life was not easy for their dog crew. Offering a bridge home by adopting a mature dog from the shelter system is a rewarding experience, for both you and the dog. One that you'll always remember.

name: Lila
description_html: Lila is a bouncy lady who loves snuggles. She enjoys treats and will sit calmly by your side after she has gotten her wiggles out. Lila loves playing fetch and would do well having a yard for exercise or a plan for walks on leash. She's an excellent walking companion, too! Lila is housetrained and knows to "sit" for treats. This smart girl is just beginning her journey and is looking for a loving adopter to join her! Reach out to her friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Cricket
description_html: Cricket is a confident, independent dog looking for someone to take him on adventures! He's easygoing, walks really nicely on his leash, and knows sit and will do it very patiently for a treat. He's a really smart guy that likes the company of other dogs, enjoys pets, and while he may try to sit in your lap, he's not going to be glued to you. Nope - this boy isn't a stage five clinger at all. He's easy peasy, playful, and curious (but watch out, squirrels!). Cricket really is the whole package and anyone would be lucky to scoop up this uniquely handsome dude.

name: Daisy
description_html:
Daisy is a super sweet. She does well with other dogs and loves to spend her day relaxing while every once in a while playing with the occasional toy. She was found with her (presumed) sister, Rosie, and we would prefer they be adopted together as they are quite attached.


She is house and crate trained. She can be a little anxious on a leash at first, but once she trusts you she will follow you anywhere. Overall just a great, sweet dog. Please give her a chance to show you!

name: Gypsy
description_html:
Gypsy is a polite little lady with lovely manners and a steady, easygoing nature. She is a great cuddle buddy in the most relaxing and sweet way. She’s wonderfully house trained, knows when it’s potty time, and enjoys following her nose through the grass like a tiny explorer on a mission. She loves to collect toys and will join in on a dance when the music comes on. After a long day of fun adventure, she likes to sit back down, kick her feet up, and relax, making her a great friend to decompress with.

Gypsy can be a bit particular about her doggy friends, but she handles those moments with grace and tolerance.

Looking for a sweet soul with a whole lot of heart? Come meet Gypsy and let her charm her way right into your life!

Gypsy's short-term foster shared: "Gypsy is the sweetest girl! She will calmly cuddle and watch tv but also loves to play fetch. She is great on walks and is housebroken. She's not a big barker unless she sees a squirrel or a stranger enters the house. She is quick to become a friend to anyone she meets – she loves humans. She will be a great addition to your home!"

name: Opie
description_html:
Meet Opie 💚

Opie is a happy, social boy who’s been making lots of friends lately—and winning hearts wherever he goes! He’s shown himself to be comfortable with new people, with no signs of shyness or sensitivity to touch. He’s just an easygoing, friendly pup who enjoys being around others.

Opie really lights up when he’s out of his kennel. Whether he’s heading out for a walk (where he does great on leash) or enjoying playtime in the yard with his favorite toys, he’s all about having fun and soaking up the moment.

In our short times in a mock living room, Opie has been a wonderful guest—non-destructive, curious, and eager to explore his surroundings. He especially loved lounging on the couch and trying to take in the view from the window, showing off his relaxed and cozy side.

With his combination of playful energy and laid-back charm, Opie is ready to fit right into a home where he can keep making friends, enjoying toys, and sharing plenty of happy moments.

name: Velveteen
description_html:
Meet Velveteen ~

Here is the sweetest, gentlest, quietest lady in the room. She has distinctive features like a bunny hop in her trot, and no tail, earning her a sweet rabbit tale name. She loves to quietly watch life unfold, from a window view, or a patio.

Velveteen is a very smart and food motivated pup, eager to follow instructions for a tasty treat. She knows “sit”, “paw”, “other paw” , and “lie down”. There’s nothing Velveteen loves more than snuggling up to her person, and as the ultimate cuddle bug she would do best in a home where she can always be around her human companion. She loves to go for car rides, is house trained, crate trained, very well behaved in the bath, and butter smooth on a leash. Though her little hippity hop limits the distance she can walk, it doesn’t stop her from enjoying her time outside! She's a great compact size, and combined with her good manners, she makes an easy fit in many home environments. She shares her space nicely with a large lady senior dog friend and though she has not been around many cats, she seems comfortable around them and also shows interest in meeting new pups. With proper introductions and consistent interactions she’ll have the confidence to make new canine and feline friends.

She's spayed, vaccinated, heart worm negative and has had recent bloodwork completed.

Velveteen has an advocacy group of volunteers - if you have questions, write us at caring@classiccanines.org

name: Princess
description_html: This sweet, one-year-old girl is smart, loyal, energetic, affectionate, and goofy. She LOVES food and toys and enjoys playing with other dogs. She responds well to training and redirection. She is a very happy dog, and zoomies will occur once she feels safe with her family and in her environment. She is housebroken and sleeps well in her crate. She is a velcro dog who will curl up beside you and snuggle. By the way, she is almost 45 lbs now (not 36 lbs as the shelter indicates).

name: Bruce
description_html:
Meet Bruce!


Bruce is a 4-year-old sweetheart with a playful spirit and a lot of love to give. This handsome boy enjoys tug-of-war, wrestling, and going on walks, and he absolutely thrives on human attention and affection. Once he trusts you, Bruce is incredibly loving, loyal, and eager to be close to his people.

Bruce has had a difficult and unstable start in life, but despite that, he remains a sweet and gentle dog at heart.


He is house-trained, enjoys spending time outdoors, and has been described as loving, playful, and “a sweetie deep down.” Bruce also understands some Spanish along with English!


Bruce would do best in a stable home with patient adopters and plenty of opportunities for exercise and companionship. He has spent much of his time outside and alone, so he deserves a family who can help him feel safe, included, and cared for.


Bruce is ready for a fresh start and a forever home where he can finally relax, learn, and be loved the way every dog deserves.


Bruce is neutered, heart worm negative, and ready to leave the shelter today!

name: Simba
description_html: Simba is a graduate of our Enduring Service program! To learn more about this program, read about it on our website. According to his Enduring Service program handlers, Simba is a smart and beautiful puppy. Can be a little shy at first but once he gains your trust he loves to play and get all the attention. Has great leash skills and listens very well. Is treat motivated and a fast learner. He is well behaved when it's bath time, loves getting in the water. His favorite game to play is tug-of-war. Listens very well when being told to drop things he should not have. Gets along well with other dogs so could go home with a well-matched companion. He knows commands such as sit, stay, down, off, drop it, paw and roll over. Simba would make a great addition to any family

name: Leo
description_html:
Meet Leo — the dog who woke up looking like he already nailed his eyeliner.

Seriously, we don’t know how he does it. No smudges, no effort, just natural, bold, “I’m-ready-for-my-close-up” eyes that turn heads everywhere he goes. But Leo isn’t just a pretty face (though… wow, yeah, he really is).

Leo is young, happy, very house trained, and completely tuned in to people. He loves being around you, whether that means heading out for a walk, hopping in the car like a seasoned road trip buddy, or just leaning into you for pets like it’s his full-time job. Treats? Obviously yes. Attention? Even better.

Leo is just a genuinely good dog who seems ready to slide right into someone’s life and make it better.

If you’ve been waiting for a sign… this is Leo, blinking at you with perfect eyeliner and a handsome face.

Email his volunteer advocates at orangedotcrew@gmail.com to meet him. He’s ready when you are.

name: Saul
description_html:
Better call Saul! If you're in a jam, he's your man. He will save you from loneliness, boredom and won't charge you extra fees for his superior doggie services. Saul loves outings and walks, and really appreciates play time! He gets excited at the prospect of leaving his boring kennel and gets wiggly when it's outdoor break time.

Saul is so fun! He is very playful and may do best in a home that can provide some enrichment on regular basis (bonus if there’s a pool!). He also enjoys cuddle and couch time and I imagine would be more balanced once decompressed from the shelter. Older kids likely preferred due to his playful antics.

Meet this active and affectionate guy today!

name: Mocha
description_html:
Mocha is a sweet, affectionate young mom who is discovering just how nice indoor life can be.


Mocha was originally a community cat before coming to AAC in early February. Since then she has quickly learned that life indoors means cozy window naps, kind humans, and lots of love. She is incredibly affectionate, enjoys being held, and loves to cuddle. Instead of loud meows, Mocha communicates with the cutest little chirps.


Mocha is still figuring out toys since she didn’t grow up playing with them, but she’s curious and learning more every day. She is fully litter box trained and has quickly adapted to being an indoor house cat.


She’s friendly with visitors and has done well with a laid-back resident cat in her foster home. She may enjoy a calm cat companion rather than a very high-energy one. She has not been around dogs.


Mocha recently finished raising her adorable kitten, Bean. She has been a great mom, but now that Bean is growing up she’s ready to find a home of her own where she can soak up all the love she deserves.

name: Ilya
description_html: Ilya is an affectionate, cuddly pup who thrives on connection, physical touch, and love from his people. He's a quick learner who is eager to please and treat motivated (and very gentle when he takes treats). He will sit for a treat and to be leashed up at the door. He is active and playful and loves to take fast laps around the yard with some adorable bunny hop/deer prances in between. He has quick bursts of energy but after 10-15 minutes, he's ready to go lounge around with you. As long as he gets a walk and a few outside breaks during the day, he is more than happy to curl up and quietly nap at your feet or a nearby window for several hour stretches. He walks well on a leash and is non-reactive, but seems interested in other people walking, dogs, and especially squirrels. His previous owner said Ilya hasn't barked at mail or food delivery people and doesn't rush at the door. He is house trained, crate trained, and car ride friendly!

name: Oreo
description_html:
Oreo is a 5½-year-old sweetheart who's looking for his forever home! He has the perfect moderate energy level—he's happy to spend most of the day napping, but he also looks forward to his daily walks to stretch his legs and explore.


One of Oreo's favorite pastimes is soaking up the sunshine while sitting on the balcony. After a little fresh air, he's always ready to curl up for some cuddles. He's a very affectionate boy who absolutely loves being pet and getting attention from everyone he meets. he gets along with everyone!


While he doesn't currently have a kennel, Oreo is great at finding his own cozy little hideaway whenever he wants some quiet time to relax and recharge. He enjoys sitting in the bathroom or sitting under our desk, and sometimes joins in on our work calls.


Oreo is a smart pup who already knows commands like sit, stay, and shake & and he's always happy to show off his manners.


If you're looking for a loving, easygoing companion who enjoys sunshine, snuggles, leisurely walks, and being by your side, Oreo could be the perfect match. He's ready to bring lots of love, loyalty, and tail wags to his new family!

name: Puma
description_html:
Puma will melt your heart with his crystal blue eye! He is a sweet pup whose bouncy gait will keep you smiling the entire walk. Very house trained and fabulous on a leash, he takes his cues from his guiding human and is definitely down for a cuddle session between activities.

A volunteer recently took Puma on an outing and he did wonderfully! Hopped up and sat quietly in the backseat, politely greeted new friends at their destination, and got a cute case of wiggle butt when he ran into one of his best friends… check out the photo montage above!

Come meet Puma today at the shelter or email his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com with any questions!

name: Legacy
description_html:
She’s all wrinkles and personality!✨


Introducing Legacy, a charismatic volunteer favorite looking for her forever.💕 One of her volunteer friends described her as “pure serotonin” in dog form.


Legacy has a joy that shines through even on the cloudiest days. Her playful spirit, adorable face wrinkles, and appreciation for the simple things (like romping through the tall grass) makes her a stand out.


She goes to doggy play group and has lived with a dog sibling before. 🐶She enjoys splashing in the pool and playing fetch. She’s also a smarty pants; She knows “sit” and is working on perfecting her “down.”


Legacy has a love for life that lights up for a room. She’s such a happy girl and seems so grateful for everything: hikes, car rides, treats, toys, swimming. She loves everything! She was such a joy to have over. Whoever adopts this sweet girl will be so lucky.


Interested in Legacy? Reach out to her friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Boski
description_html:
HEART THROB ALERT!! Athletic and handsome as the day is long -- Boski is a recent graduate of our Enduring Service program! To learn more about this program, read about it on our website.


Boski is a perfect mix of rockstar cool and snugglebug sweetness! He is young and still has some puppy exuberance. He thinks he's little and wants to be in his person's lap if possible. He loves fetch and tug of war with any toy. His favorite game of all though is "keep away". He loves being chased. He will often bring toys to his ppl and ask them to play with him. He is fairly high energy and would do best in a home where he has a yard, or access to a dog park where he can run. He is quite athletic and would be a great running buddy or agility candidate! He walks well on the leash with his two foster brothers and gets along well with other dogs.


Boski came to the shelter October 2025 as a stray. But he seems to have been someone's family member previously as he has good house manners. He loves to chill out and cuddle when playtime is over. He knows many basic commands like sit, pay, down, stay, and "with me" (heel). Boski isn't one to pass up a good nap. He loves to just be near his person and do whatever his pack is doing. Boski is house trained, rides well in the car and has learned to live in a house without touching things that don't belong to him. He's smart and easy to train. He has not lived with cats or kids but likely could adapt to both. Boski is very dog friendly, but we recommend scheduling a meet and greet before adopting if you have another dog at home.

name: Ink
description_html: Ink is a happy-go-lucky guy who’s always up for whatever adventure you have in mind - especially if it involves toys! Ink LOVES a toy and will get so excited he will jog around with it happily, plop in your lap to show you, and then jog around with it again. Despite his enthusiasm, Ink is surprisingly easy to handle — volunteers found him simple to harness and eager to head out for fun. Once in the play yard, Ink is in his element: zooming around, chasing toys, and soaking up every moment. Outside the play yard, Ink is also a great jogging buddy in the making and happily kept pace on a short jog with one of his volunteer friends. He knows sit, likes treats, and is a smart boy who will be easy to train and be up for any adventure with his new people!

name: Ash
description_html:
Hi there! I’m Ash, a bundle of joy packed with curiosity and energy.


Every day is a new adventure for me, and I love exploring every nook and cranny of my surroundings. I’m also quite the brainy pup, always eager to learn new tricks and solve puzzles. My friends here say

I’m sweet and always sporting a smile, which makes every day brighter. I dream of a home where I can share all this love and excitement. I'm also house trained!


He is such a loving, gentle boy. He is great with other dogs, house-trained, and sweet. He is medium-energy. Does well with walks or having a yard to play in. He loves stuffy toys and taking a dip in the kiddie pool.


If you’re looking for a loyal friend to add zest to your life, I’m your guy!


Interested in Ash? Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Meatball
description_html:
His name may be Meatball, but this guy is actually a total ham! This sweet, snuggly boy is famous for his full-body cuddles and big goofy grin.

Don’t let his laid-back charm fool you. Meatball isn’t just lazy! He’s playful, loves zooming around the yard, and then happily settles in for some serious snuggle time. He’s a mostly loose-leash walker and an extremely house-trained gentleman who knows how to keep things neat and tidy.

True heeler intelligence. He got all the treats out of a puzzle gently within 3 seconds flat of setting it down. Very good about placing right in front of you when you call him, impressive. He could probably be someone's champ agility dog! A cuddly heeler is a true rarity, what a gem! Loves to give kisses and lean, and rub against you. Such a sweetheart.

With his mix of sweetness, silliness, and perfectly portioned energy, Meatball is the ultimate comfort companion. Come meet him and see why everyone falls in love with this lovable ham!

name: Cornelia
description_html:
Meet Cornelia: one year old, extremely smart, unfairly pretty, and still very much a baby.

Having spent much of her puppyhood in the shelter, Cornelia is currently discovering the finer things in life: cozy beds, long walks, squeaky toys, and unrestricted access to human faces.

The faces are for licking. This is non-negotiable.

Cornelia takes toys equally seriously. She’ll happily entertain herself with a ball, often rolling around on the bed clutching it between her paws like a tiny dragon guarding its treasure.

She also learned sit, paw, and down in a matter of minutes. We’re not saying she’s a genius, but we’re also not prepared to rule it out.

She’s wonderful on walks, settles into a lovely loose leash, and can happily snooze in her crate while her people are away.

Cornelia likes to take her time with new people. Give her a little space and let her make the first move. Once she decides you’re safe, though, she loves with her whole heart—and your personal space privileges are officially revoked.

She’s goofy, affectionate, ridiculously clever, and has spent far too much of her puppyhood growing up in a shelter.

Cornelia is ready for the next part: a home, an unreasonable toy budget, someone to show her the world, and a face she can lick for the rest of her life.

name: Sandler
description_html:
If Sandler had a dating profile, we're pretty sure it would look something like this: 

About me: Hi there, I'm Sandler! Hoping to find a handsome, playful and cuddly young man you can introduce to your friends and family? Here I am. Seeking someone who shares your passion for an active lifestyle and highly trainable? Ding ding - you found him. Looking for someone who is incredibly good looking with a heart of gold? Look no further. My personality is even better than my handsome looks.

Looking for: I'm in it to win it. I want a lifelong companion. Someone who I can plant roots with (don't worry, I won't dig them up), go on adventures with and grow old with. Already started a family and have kids, the human or furry kind? That won't scare me away. I love other dogs, both male and female and love to play. 

Ideal Date: A long walk or play session in the yard with my toys, taking a quick dip in any body of water, a puddle will do, and then getting loved on by my human. Who of course gives me snacks. To wrap up the date, we'd go back inside and Netflix and Nuzzle. I'll even let you pick the show as long as I can snuggle up, get some scratches and take a cozy snooze.

Think this could be it, the true love you've been looking for? Swipe right, aka come meet me at the shelter today!

name: Hank
description_html:
Introducing Hank and his heart of gold! 


When I first met this sweet boy he was very shutdown and scared in the shelter environment. He would cower in the back of his kennel and it took a lot of encouragement from his friends to even go for a walk. 

Since bringing him home to foster, Hank has beautifully opened up and shown the goofy, loving boy that he’s had inside all along. He’ll get so excited when you get home from work and then cuddle up next to you on the couch. All he wants is your love :)


Hank is a pup that will require patience, a gentle touch and an equally tender heart. He’s still learning to be brave in the world and it will take time, especially in a new home, but trust me seeing him blossom is a real gift. And the love he gives his people is fierce and unconditional!


Hank facts:

  • House-trained
  • Can free roam 
  • Quiet boy, very rare to hear him bark
  • Low to medium energy 
  • Expert snuggler!
  • Dog friendly - in fact he would love a calm yet confident dog friend to show him the ropes 
  • Loves a bully stick & cheese
  • Would love a back yard to play fetch (just a bonus!)
  • 100% angel 


Hank is a very special dog and he can’t wait to find his forever home! Is that you?

name: Parker
description_html:
Parker is the kind of dog who leaves a lasting impression. At just 3 years old, he's affectionate, playful, and happiest when he's close to his favorite people—whether that's going for a walk, relaxing on the couch, or showing off just how handsome he looks in his pajamas. He has a charming goofy streak, a talent for making people smile, and firmly believes that no petting session should end before he's ready.

After spending more than a year in the shelter, Parker has become a favorite among volunteers. They've seen firsthand what a loving, loyal companion is, and they're eager to help him find the home he's been waiting for.

Parker recently spent a night on a sleepover with a volunteer and was an outstanding houseguest. He's completely house trained, slept through the night, had no accidents, walked nicely on leash, and left everything exactly as he found it. He showed wonderful house manners. 

Like many dogs who have spent a long time in a shelter, Parker may need a little time to adjust to a new environment. He's looking for someone who understands that trust and confidence don't always happen overnight. Parker has true “soul dog” potential and will just need a little empathy from his adopter or foster to help him transition into his new environment. 

Parker would be happiest in a quieter, lower-traffic home where he can settle into a predictable routine. 

If you're looking for a sweet, loyal dog with a playful personality, impeccable house manners, and a heart that's ready to belong to someone, Parker may be the perfect match. Bonus points if you appreciate a dog who looks especially distinguished in pajamas! 

Email orangedotcrew@gmail.com to learn more about Parker.

This sweet boy has been with us for almost a week. He is all up to date on preventative health and has now been neutered. He loves my 11 year old daughter, who gave him the name, Indigo, for while we have him. I truly wish we could adopt him, but already have 4 pets. He is well behaved, friendly with people and other dogs. I took him for a run and he loved that, would be perfect for someone who likes to hike, run, or explore. His personality is young, I thought 1 or 2 years old, with all of his excitement and kisses, but the vet thinks he’s closer to 4-5 years old. Please reach out it you’d like to apply to be his forever person. :)

name: Zeus
description_html: Zeus is a very handsome, fluffy boy who will make his future adopter so happy! This pup walks well on a leash and loves to go on nice strolls. He is also cuddly and loves pets. He stands nicely to be brushed. He is great for Pyrenees or Husky lovers!

name: Mermaid
description_html: Mermaid is spayed and ready for her home. She is sweet and playful and in love with our dog. Apply to meet her!

name: Agate
description_html:
Agate came in from an area where residents were doing their best to care for the community cats, however the location became unsafe for them. She's shy at first, but warms up quickly and enjoys pets. She will even lift her rear to get more out of that pet!

Agate has joined her shy cat friends in our Cactus Cats program to help her feel more relaxed in the shelter. She may prefer a quiet space to unwind and appreciate a patient adopter willing to let her take her time getting adjusted to new places.

Agate has a lot of love to give to some lucky person who gives her a chance!

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Agate and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Dante
description_html:
Dante, is a very sweet, fluffy purr-boy, who loves attention, but he’s still my shyest of the trio and doesn’t ask for pets yet like his sisters. He plays with his 2 sisters, with ~low to sometimes medium energy, maybe a little more as he grows. Use the email below to reach out to his foster directly for more information or to set up a meet/greet.

 

- Email: adaywithfosters@gmail.com

- Pictures & Info: https://www.instagram.com/adaywithfosters

 

 

Dante is social at a distance as he’s re-learning to be a playful kitten. He loves attention but it takes him a little bit to come forward, after his sister comes up for attention and comes forward fast and more every day. He’s a playful kitten throughout the day, first is play with his two sisters and I pet him often as I walk by. Once he’s got a pet or two in him, he purrs like boat… and sometimes, when walking up to him on the cat tree, I can get him to purr by just talking to him… then he’s totally on board for pets and big purr.  

 

He and his two sisters were strays and pretty darn scared at the world when I took them on… and he’s becoming a kitten again. During the day, he plays- zoom, wrestles and chases all the toys with his sister interchangeably… whoever is closest. He loves all toys- string, ping-pong balls, pieces of cardboard, springs and flat crinkle toys… or he often snoozes inside the cat tube as a nice cubby. He’s learning and will come close when he hears a rattle mouse as I used them to get a head count or just play… and he’ll chase it when thrown. He’s learning it’s ~OK to be picked up and it’s still a work on progress… as he’ll let me carry him around a little longer each day… belly rubs too. After some time, a few pets, he’ll eventually stay on his back while we play belly tickle and he makes big air biscuits. He’s very gentle when you play and hand wrestle. He’s a nosey kitten and can’t always tell who’s climbing higher on shelves, him or his sisters. After playing and runs out of gas, he’ll nap most often on the cat tree in the sun, by the bird feeder, or lately on a table by the bed and his sisters.

 

So far, he doesn’t talk much at all and has a very soft voice when it’s meal time. He’s learning to be confident and so his voice might get bigger as he grows and opens up in a loving, patient home. He climbs a tall sisal cat tree very well through the day. He’ll make small air biscuits when you talk to him, often purring. At night, he’s still all play chasing toys and will eventually cuddle up on a little table by the bed with a little cat cubby shelf on it with his sisters, while I read. Once they get on the bed he stays there and so far hasn’t gotten onto the bed. I think he would do OK as a solo kitten for someone who works from home to give him plenty of love, in a home he can trust, continue to open up and grow into. He would do very well with either of her sisters- Celo 30951 or Layla 30952 for someone who wants a sibling pair. I also think he would also do well with a family who has a cat or kitten who wants a playmate.

 

He is perfect with the litter box and it’s hard to tell if he covers or not with three kittens. He’s pretty good with getting his nails trimmed when he’s sleepy and can easily get the front ones done… so we trim frequently to make it routine. He’s only met my friends and will come into the room just to see what’s happening and sniff around the edges. So, he will likely be a little shy around new folks… and hoping he warms up quickly with toys. I think he would do fine with children, once he gets used to their energy. Dante is fine w/ my older cat and sometimes wants to cuddle with her and still working up the courage to try. I have no idea if he’s met a dog, but think she would do OK with a one once he gets used to them, after slow introductions.

name: Palomino
description_html:
Meet Palomino, the house horse you have been looking to add to your family!


She:

  • is super sweet and gentle
  • is very well behaved
  • knows how to sit and shake for a treat, lay down, and stay
  • comfortable on car rides
  • loves to take a long nap
  • comes running when she hears the ice maker so you have to pay the ice cube tax to her :)


In her foster home, she's shown her ability to communicate when she needs to go outside and she loves to sleep through the night.


She is still a little wary of people walking up behind her or coming from around a corner but that's understandable for a pup having a new experience. She showed some resource guarding in the shelter but in her foster home, she is not displaying this but is something being watched out for.


If you are looking to add a gentle giant to your family, Palomino is the girl you want!

name: Reese
description_html:
Reese is such a sweet, shy boy who's ready for a home where he can blossom and come out of his shell! He is so inquisitive and truly loves people. When he hears you walk into the room, he starts purring and, even though you can tell he's a bit scared, will start making biscuits in place.


He's got such a big heart and will be such a loving little housecat!

name: Hammer Time
description_html:
Hammer Time is a chill, happy boy who is all about pets, love, and treats! He’s very easy to handle on leash, enjoying mild pulling while he sniffs and explores. He politely ignores both people and dogs around him and stays focused on enjoying his walk.


In the Real Life Room, Hammer Time is especially sweet and affectionate. He loves getting pets and treats and would make a wonderful companion and couch buddy. He’s treat motivated, laid-back, cuddly, and ready to give his person plenty of love. 🐾

name: Comet
description_html: Comet loves to play but also loves to cuddle. He is not afraid of meeting new cat friends to play with .

name: Tiger
description_html: Tiger is a good boy with a troubled past. He was moved into a new home and found it hard to adapt, then he ended up at the shelter. Tiger is affectionate and loves pets, though he appreciates if you go slowly with first meetings. He's pretty scared in the shelter so we'd love to get him into a home ASAP where he can relax and be allowed to adjust at his own pace. He's lived with dogs in the past so may do well in a home with a canine friend. Help a Tiger out today!

name: Haven
description_html:
Haven is a friendly young dog who is learning that the world can be a pretty fun place. She started out shy in shelter playgroup, but with a little time she blossomed into soft play with the other dogs and even began seeking affection from her handlers.


Haven may be a lovely match for a patient family—and potentially a well-matched canine friend—who can help her continue building confidence. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!

name: Prissy
description_html:
A lovely & loving lady, so easy & gentle to be with. She adores people-they make her heart sing!


Prissy is RTG - READY TO GO -she's spayed, vaccinated, heart worm negative and knows a whole lot about good home living. She lived with a family for the last 4 years practicing all her good girl skills, with a child and male dog friend. She stayed home alone well, she's house and crate trained, for 4-8 hrs. She's not as sure about having cat friends but reserves the right to change her mind after studying them from a safe distance for awhile.


She's staying in a foster home and is a nice companion for the resident pupper. She loves adventures and trips outdoors, so much that we have her wear sun shirts to protect her delicate skin. Prissy is ready for a loving home of her own to suit her for years to come. And her foster is very motivated to help her cross to the rest of best ahead. Connect to her foster using the 'Get started here' button.


Prissy's wellness services while in foster is provided by Classic Canines.

name: Bandido
description_html:
Bandido is a fun-loving, affectionate guy with plenty of personality! He’s got lots of energy when he first gets out of his kennel and may be jumpy or a little mouthy, but he gets his “ya-yas” out quickly and settles down beautifully. Once he’s had some exercise and playtime, Bandido is happy to slow down and ask for kisses and belly rubs.


Bandido is playful, curious, and very interested in people. He enjoys sniffing and exploring and gives his handler lots of check-ins. He can be easily distracted and is reactive to other dogs, with some barking and lunging, but he’s been easy to redirect. He’s also a strong leash puller and would do best with a harness rather than a slip leash or collar.


Although his previous family reported that he wasn’t housetrained, Bandido has consistently kept his kennel dry and urgently goes potty outdoors as soon as he gets outside, suggesting he may have good outdoor potty habits. He’s an active, playful companion who will thrive with regular exercise, enrichment, and someone who appreciates a silly, affectionate dog with a big personality.

name: Xiao Mao
description_html: Itty bitty tuxedo cat with moon shoes. She followed me home in the neighborhood and now I am trying to find her a home~

name: Simon
description_html:
Simon is a gentle, sweet soul who's ready to leave shelter life behind and find a loving home. While he may be a little shy at first, it doesn't take long for his affectionate side to shine through. He loves spending quiet time with his person and happily soaks up cuddles and attention.


Simon is easy to leash, walks beautifully on a loose leash, and enjoys peaceful strolls. He also likes relaxing in the play yard and has been friendly with dogs in neighboring yards. He appears to be housetrained and has a calm, laid-back personality that makes him a wonderful companion.


Right now, Simon is very underweight and would benefit from a home where he can enjoy good meals, plenty of love, and the chance to grow into his happiest, healthiest self. If you're looking for a kind, cuddly best friend with a gentle heart, Simon may be the perfect match.

name: Spike
description_html:
🐾 Meet Spike! 🐾


Despite her name, Spike isn’t spicy — she’s just scared. This little girl has been through a lot and is still learning that people can be safe and kind. She may be nervous at first, but with patience, gentle interactions, and a little TLC, we’re hopeful her sweet personality will start to shine.


Spike recently battled an upper respiratory infection, but she’s been treated, is fully recovered, and is ready to find her forever home. 


She will need an adopter who understands that trust takes time and is willing to let Spike come out of her shell at her own pace. Behind those cautious eyes is a kitten who deserves the chance to feel safe, loved, and finally at home.

name: Intrigue
description_html:
Intrigue is looking for her forever home! True to her name, Intrigue finds everything intriguing and loves to explore. She is affectionate, playful, and has been good with the other cats in her foster home.


One of her foster parents says:

  • She’s a chatty queen!
  • She purrs basically as soon as she sees you
  • She’ll give you a bath (see video) and loves to sleep on your lap
  • She has gently pointy ears. 
  • She was nervous around my toddler but very gentle with him so I do think she’d do well in a family. 
  • Overall I found her to be super sweet, gentle, and playful.

name: Hinata
description_html: Meet Hinata! This gorgeous fluffy German Shepherd is ready to steal hearts and find her forever home. She is a dream on the leash, walking calmly and politely by your side. She already knows "sit" and loves praise. Give her a toy and watch her light up, she would love a family who'll keep the toy basket stocked. Smart, sweet, and eager to please, Hinata is looking for a home where she can keep learning new tricks and shower her people with loyalty. Could that home be yours? Come meet Hinata today and see her beautiful fluffy face in person!

name: Kayda
description_html: Kayda is a sweet young dog with a beautiful shiny coat. She is housetrained, strolls along easily on leash, and is dog friendly. Kayda loves to explore the playyard, run along the fence line with other friendly dogs, and entertain herself rolling in the grass. She is affectionate, curious and well behaved and a wonderful companion. Come meet this special girl!

name: Fritter
description_html:
Fritter is a shy, nervous kitten who was brought to AAS with his siblings from a community area. His right eye had some mild symblepharon after a URI, and the fused tissues were covering half of his right pupil. During his neuter surgery, the surgeon was able to trim the tissue back so that he has better vision in that eye.

Fritter moved into a foster home, and after several weeks of eye medications, all eye tissues have stabilized. He could have a flare up during times of stress, so he needs to be monitored. He is not on any medication at this time.

Fritter is still shy with humans, but he absolutely loves other cats/kittens. He would do best in a quiet home with at least one cat buddy. He can be petted, although he is nervous when he sees a hand coming towards him. Once you start petting him, he relaxes and even purrs.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Fritter and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Pepper
description_html:
Meet Pepper: the sassy house potato ready to steal your heart ❤️ Pepper isn't spicy at all! She's a soft natured, affectionate lady of wisdom who misses the comforts of home. She loves when people talk to her and give her pets and cuddles.

This sweet, dog friendly, barely-senior girl is the ultimate hybrid companion: a professional couch potato who transforms into an enthusiastic explorer the second you grab her leash or your car keys. Don't let her extra insulation fool you—she conquers stairs like a champ and is always ready for her next big adventure, provided it ends with an epic snooze. She’s been in foster for several weeks and has done great in not one, but two different foster homes!

Her skills: 

- Beautiful House Manners: Fully house trained and reliable with zero indoor accidents, no destruction, chewing, or taking things that aren’t toys.

- Crate Trained: if she’s close by or can see you she doesn’t stress! 

- Good on a Leash: picks up directions quickly (provided she gets to check out the smells along the way of course) 😂

- The Ultimate Co-Pilot: Absolutely loves car rides and sits happily in the back seat.

- Pure Social Butterfly: Loves every human she meets, and has shown to be dog friendly with several well matched dogs at the shelter and in foster (no kitties or small dogs please) 

- Included in Everything: A certified "FOMO" specialist who just wants to be part of the group. 

- Master-Level Napping: Takes sleeping on the couch to an absolute art form.

- Grass Wriggling: Highly skilled at joyful, upside-down rolling in lush lawns.

- Brain Games: Flawlessly knows "sit" and "go to your bed," and is currently studying hard to master "shake."

Kid friendly - has shown calm gentle skills around children wanting to interact with and pet her.

Pepper is a versatile and accommodating dog who fits effortlessly into a home, you can check her nails, ears, teeth, fur, tail, she doesn’t mind it and loves the attention! She brings instant joy, low-maintenance behavior, and top-tier entertainment to anyone lucky enough to be her buddy (she wants you as her buddy).

name: Amor
description_html:
Amor means "love" and that's how she's been described since the moment she was found alone and brought to safety. She's mannered and calm, affectionate and mellow. And she loves walks, is always nice on a leash, and passes other dogs well. She loves a good roll in the grass, showing off cues here and there, and especially taking part in perimeter and squirrel yard patrols.


Amor spent some time in a volunteer sleep over and did well sharing space with a cat for a limited few days. We always recommend slow introductions.


Amor is RTG - "ready to go" - she's vaccinated, spayed and heart worm negative and all you need to do is decide if she is "the one" you've been waiting for. Visit her onsite.

name: Hazel
description_html:
Hi everyone! I'm Hazel. My people had a misfortune and I was alone so I was brought to this new place. The people here are very nice to me, they treat me like the grand lady I am, making me feel really special with the prettiest collar and nice bedding for my woman's size frame. People tell me I have the prettiest eyes, hazel of course. I love to meet people and 'specially like to go for short walks and lounge in the pool. I'm also really good at keeping those dang lizards away from the place too! My friends here said I'm on track to graduate from the senior class but I must find a suitable life mission--I said "I know, I'm trying really hard". So will you please consider me for an indoors job? I'm spayed, heart worm negative and ready to leave as fast as your vehicle travels and I'll keep the little critters away from your place too. Hope to see you soon - with much love waiting, Hazel.

See my short IG video here.

name: Murphy
description_html:
Like a dog with large presence but soft on the inside? Murphy likes the simple things in life; comfy beds, cozy couches, sniff walks, and spending time with his people. He's calm and easy going to have around home and he's ready to show off a playful side when you're ready.


Murphy is house trained and can stay home alone for a few hours. He also has experience riding in elevators and living an apartment lifestyle. Outside he walks nicely on a leash and rides great in the car. He loves to have a space to run in, to feel the breeze on his face, and take in a little sunbathing. He would love to have his own yard space.


Murphy shared his kennel space with another dog while at the shelter. He makes a nice, accommodating dog friend. A doggie meet up can be scheduled at the shelter as needed with one or more resident dogs.


Murphy has many characteristics that make him a great fit for a family including how gently he takes treats. Murphy is vaccinated, neutered and heart worm negative and as a distinguished gentleman of 7 or older his fees are waived.


Here is your loyal, easy companion who fits in nearly everywhere. If you have a vision of life with Murphy, use the 'START HERE' button on his profile to get connected to his foster provider.

name: Hugo
description_html: Hugo is a friendly, playful guy who loves to go on long walks with his favorite people. He's an absolute cuddler, too! This smart boy knows basic commands like "sit" & "stay". Hugo's favorite activities are splashing in water and going for car rides. He appreciates a calmer home environment and may do best in a home without small children.

name: Tyson
description_html:
Where spirit meets affection, you'll find Tyson waiting with his excellent home manners. Give him a spot by the window where he can dream of his next outdoor adventure. He can entertain himself and he's gentle with his toys. Outdoors he has a curious spirit for walks, hikes, and for his backyard squirrel patrols.

Don’t let the hint of grey on his snout fool you; he’s full of enthusiasm and ready for all of your activities. Above all, Tyson adores being with people and he’s easy to please. Pass the cheese board please..his favorite.

Tyson has shared his space with other dogs during times of his life.

If you have a resident dog, a meet and greet can be set up.

See his short video here. He'll be keeping an ear up waiting for you to come by to meet him.

Till then, much love!

name: Ava
description_html:
She's the cutest, always ready to strike a pose. She doesn't mind a little dress up.

Sweet Ava is calm, polite and a nice lady who remembers everyone she meets.

When you get to her level she'll be dishing out the kisses.

She's super house trained, quiet and with great manners at home.

See her adorable self here

Fun things we've noticed - Ava is the queen of comfort ~ Ava picks her wildlife - she watches birds without intruding upon them but squirrels may get a little chase. And her fav toy choice is a good stuffy or a yummy chew..

Ava has shared space with a couple of dog friends while at the shelter. She's had a low vision, low hearing BFF and prefers to have respectful co-existing friends like herself, who are nice and calm.

She can't wait to meet you!

name: Cinnamon
description_html: Cinnamon was abandoned at a rescue and then brought to us for care. She was shy at first, but now she's showing us her active, playful side and telling us she's done with kennel life! This girl is ready to do zoomies around a home. Cinnamon loves Churu, so that may be the best way to make introductions. She enjoys pets and once she's in a calm home setting, we think that's when she will truly blossom! So add some spice to your life and adopt Cinnamon today!

name: Rascal
description_html:
Meet Rascal—your future 60-pound lap dog!


Rascal is ready to leave his past behind and start the next chapter of his life with a loving forever family. This handsome boy is as easy going as they come and has quickly become a volunteer favorite.


Rascal walks beautifully on leash and enjoys relaxed strolls where he can take in the world by your side. He’s a loose-leash walker who makes walks a breeze. While he enjoys getting out and about, what Rascal really loves most is simply being near his people.


With his calm, even-keeled personality and affectionate nature, Rascal is the kind of dog who fits right in and makes every day a little brighter. And did we mention how handsome he is?


Rascal can’t wait to meet his forever family - maybe that’s you!

name: Baby Acorn
description_html: She would do best in a home with one or more dogs as she seems to thrive with other dogs. She’s a tad nervous of the world, so having other confident dogs around her helps her not feel like the world is too scary! She’s loves to swim, snuggle and play with her foster brother. She does well in the crate, no issues! She takes a bit of time to trust and warm up to her humans, but once she does, she’s very affectionate and sweet. She doesn’t have a mean bone in her body! She also loves to fetch 💕

name: Lucy
description_html:
Lucy is the kind of dog who makes you earn her trust—and then rewards you tenfold. ❤️


This gorgeous heeler mix can be a little shy when meeting new people and may take some time to warm up. But with a little patience, you'll discover a loving, loyal girl who thinks her favorite humans are the greatest people on earth.


Once you're in Lucy's circle, she's a total velcro dog. She loves snuggles, showering you with kisses, gently pawing for attention, and tagging along wherever you go. She's happiest enjoying a good sniffy walk, soaking up life's simple pleasures, and spending time with her people.


And when she's feeling extra happy? Lucy breaks out into the cutest zippy zoomies around the yard that are guaranteed to make you smile. She's also a fantastic size—not too big, not too small—making her an easy companion for all kinds of adventures.


If you're willing to give her a chance to come out of her shell, Lucy will be the kind of companion who loves you with her whole heart. She's absolutely worth the wait.

name: Bee
description_html:
Bee is very sweet, but she’s also very shy with people. She was brought to AAS from the community, and during her spay surgery, the DVM found mucosa of bladder to be protruding cranially, so the tissue was resected. She moved into foster care to recover and to be monitored. The results of several ultrasounds indicate that her bladder has healed completely. Her urinary habits are normal at this time.

As a member of our Cactus Cats program, Bee is becoming more comfortable with humans. She tends to hide, but likes to be petted. She is not aggressive, she’s just learning to appreciate all the things that people are good for.

Bee will do best in a home with a cat buddy. She was friends with Cassia in their foster home.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Bee and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Milo
description_html:
Milo was once lost but now has found a temporary home through the shelter in the comforts of a foster home. He's calm and friendly, sweet and affectionate, has nice leash manners and allows the nearby deer to be undisturbed. He's at peace with nature's creatures.


This easy relaxing boy has not a care in the world. He enjoys simple companionship and having a cozy blanket to curl up on. His motto.... "Life is good". He loves people and welcomes in all the friends and family and he's so silky soft and cuddly! He travels great for road trips, has stayed in tents while camping, and in hotel rooms, and he's as quiet as a church mouse. He often even puts himself to bed when he's tired. Enjoy his beach photos. The point is, Milo is happy wherever you want to be, whether on land, near the water, or excursions in between. And when you have to be away a few hours, he'll take care of himself, and welcome you upon your return.

Connect with his foster at his link to meet up with this very special gentleman.

name: Mr. Wendell
description_html:
Meet Mr. Wendell! This handsome guy has a grin that could light up a room and a mouth so big, it seems it was made for holding ALL the tennis balls in the world!

Mr. Wendell is a splash-loving, fetch-obsessed goofball who can turn even a dull day into a comedy show with his playful antics.

He’s a well-trained gentleman, knows his commands, and is motivated by treats, but don’t be fooled, this big boy has a heart as soft as his cuddly belly, ready to melt into your lap after a fun-filled swim or a zooming game of fetch.

If you’re ready for laughter and endless tennis ball chaos, Mr. Wendell is waiting to become your new four-legged best friend!


Interested in Mr. Wendell? Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Helios
description_html:
This sweet boy is the perfect mix of playful and affectionate! He has medium energy and would thrive in an active home where he can enjoy walks, playtime, and plenty of love.

He walks nicely on leash with a harness and enjoys getting out for strolls, spending time in the play yard, or exploring during outings. One of his favorite things in the world is a tennis ball—he loves a good game of fetch and will happily bring the ball back, either dropping it at your feet or gently letting you take it from him.

When playtime is over, he’s all about the cuddles. He’s a total snuggler who loves belly rubs and being close to his people. He’s also very gentle, enjoys treats, and already knows the sit command—making training fun and rewarding.

Helios took his appearance on Fox7 in stride: met other guests, walked around the scary station and studio, rode in my car, etc. Perfect gentleman the entire few hours. Helios enjoys car rides but prefers walks and yard time.

He appears to be housetrained, is leash trained, and seems calm when passing other dogs or people on walks. With his playful spirit, loving personality, and fondness for treats, he’s ready to bring lots of joy to his future family!

name: Aiden
description_html:
First time dog owner? This perfect fella is for you!


Aiden may be one of the easiest dogs at the shelter. On leash, fantastic! A living room setting, would love a nap or to lay quietly on the couch and munch on a toy. In a play yard, can play independently with toys but will come up for some cuddles as well!


Aiden recently went on an outing to McKinney Falls State Park. On the way there he sat in one spot in the back set holding a toy while looking out the window. He did fantastic on the 3 mile hike - was easy on leash and non-reactive. On the way back to the shelter this kid laid down and slept so hard that the volunteer drove around for a while then parked for about 30 minutes just to he could get a quiet nap for the first time in over 100 days.


Aiden was also used as a dog to train new volunteers recently. He showed off his "sit" and listening skills while occasionally asking for breaks by cuddling up to our new volunteers for some love.


As a 40-ish pound dog who is extremely house trained, he would be perfect in an apartment or a home!


Aiden is also heartworm negative.

name: Kugel
description_html:
Kugel is all heart. He’s affectionate, loves to curl up close, and never misses a chance to give gentle kisses. If you’re looking for a dog who makes you feel loved every single day, he’s your guy.


Kugel has great leash manners and enjoys getting out for walks, exploring, and spending time with his people. He’s eager to please and responds well to guidance.


He’s also done well with other dogs and could go home with a well‑matched playmate who appreciates his friendly, playful energy.


Kugel loves to be close to his human and takes every opportunity to lean up against you for affection. He's the cutest, sweet baby! He is going to make his future family feel so loved and cherished. I would adopt him in a heartbeat if my current pup was dog-friendly. Kugel is a little jumpy and while I think he would make a good family pet, just something to keep in mind around tiny humans.


If you’re ready for a loyal companion with a big heart and an even bigger cuddle quota, Kugel can’t wait to meet you.


If you have any questions, please reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com

name: Casius
description_html:
If you’re looking for a new source of joy in your life, meet Casius! This sleek, velvet-coated young pup is the definition of fun-loving and happy-go-lucky. With his big, floppy ears and an infectious, wide-mouthed smile, Casius brings an upbeat energy to every day.

He completely loves playtime—whether he’s showing off his favorite toys or proudly pacing on his leash. Casius is always ready for his next great adventure, outdoor stroll, or game of fetch. Ready to add a loyal, playful best friend to your life? Casius is your guy! Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Yerba
description_html:
Yerba and Tea came in as silly little stray scaredy kittens. They are on a journey of self-reflection. Their goal is to be braver with people! Yerba and Tea enjoy play time with wand toys, and though they may take some time to warm up to new people, we think they will reach their goal sooner than later. They may do best in a calm home with a cat friend to learn from and a patient adopter to help them on their journey. Yerba and Tea are now a part of our Cactus Cat program for shy cats who need a little help from volunteers. They don't have to go home together, but do enjoy each other's company.


I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!


The adoption fee is waived for Yerba and all Cactus Cats/Desperate Housecats!

name: Mariah
description_html:
Good girl Mariah is back and ever-more-ready for some lucky adopters to scoop her up and make her part of their home! Mariah was one of the lucky dogs who participated in our new Enduring Service program! This program pairs a shelter dog with inmates at the Travis State Jail to complete a 12-week basic training course, and she was a rockstar there!


Mariah is a sweet, intelligent pup with a big heart and an even bigger love for people. She's friendly with everyone she meets and, after a little time to adjust, does well with most other dogs too. Mariah isn't shy about saying hello, she'll happily walk right up for pets and attention! She already knows several commands, including sit, down, stay, paw (both hands!), and touch, and she even has a cute "bang bang" trick. Like many smart dogs, she's especially motivated when treats are involved. She's potty trained and mostly kennel trained, making her a great fit for a home ready to continue reinforcing her good habits. Mariah truly shines when she's outside. She loves having space to run and play, and she does especially well off-leash in a secure area. A home with a big yard would be ideal for her active, playful nature. She tends to stay close and doesn't wander off, making her a wonderful companion for outdoor time. During playtime, Mariah can get a little excited with her toys, so gentle guidance or a quick distraction can help keep things calm and fun for everyone. With her loving personality and joyful spirit, Mariah is sure to bring happiness and companionship to any home lucky enough to have her.

name: Theodora
description_html: Theodora came to the shelter when her living situation was no longer a good fit for her. Like so many pets, kennel life is also not suitable for Theodora's independent spirit. She does not enjoy being confined. What she does enjoy is being able to just be herself, which under normal circumstances is an affectionate and loyal companion cat. We can see that she wants to trust us, but it's hard to do that in a kennel. We can see her true spirit hidden behind every soft blink and meow that she gives us. Theodora would love to be able to relax in a foster home where she can show the best side of her personality. Ask staff how you can help this special girl today!

name: Hugs
description_html:
Meet Hugs ~ his owner suffered a setback which made caring for him impossible. He lived in a condo and would go out for 4 short walks daily. Besides his VIP, his very best friend was a siamese/ragdoll cat. They shared 4 years together. He's said to stay home alone well for a few hours. He likes children and he's not yappy except to alert to large dogs he sees while on walks, and he'll be happy to alert you when a visitor comes by the house.


Hugs is ready to meet his future, will you be his bridge? Come meet him in person between 11-6 by joining the customer service queue. Hugs is vaccinated, neutered and ready to pack his bags right away.

name: Vlad
description_html:
At first glance, you will likely notice Vlad’s gorgeous all-black coat, but his purr-sonality is even more priceless!


He may be perceived as shy when first meeting him, but he desperately wants to be around you. Vlad’s favorite way to show affection toward his human companions is by sitting on their lap or laying on their chest, purring loudly, making biscuits on their face, and licking their nose. Vlad LOVES noses so much that he sometimes cannot help but give them a little nibble. We are working to deter this by making a “tss!” sound when the teeth come out and keeping him lower on our chests. Thankfully, he is starting to understand!


Despite his affinity for lounging in your lap and on your chest, Vlad is still learning to be held. At times, he can be picked up like a baby and given pets, but sometimes he will struggle a bit. Interestingly, he will push against you while attempting to escape your grasp, but he does not use his claws. Once back on solid ground, he occasionally gives a single hiss, but then immediately continues seeking full-body pets (yes - belly too!) and play. 


Even quirkier than his obsession with noses, Vlad is an extraordinarily chatty man who likes the sound of his own voice, even when he doesn’t need anything. We joke that he is exploring his space through echolocation. 


When his humans aren’t around, Vlad usually lounges on the bed, showing off the rich brown color his coat becomes when illuminated by sunlight. 


Vlad has been offered both wet and dry food; however, he seems to have little to no interest in dry food, opting for an almost entirely wet-food-based diet. He is hoping that his new home would be open to catering to these preferences too.


Vlad has excellent bathroom manners, takes diligent care of his coat, and does not have any observed health concerns. He was neutered on Wednesday 08/05 and has healed well.


Vlad would greatly benefit from having a feline friend and seems much more relaxed with some company! Additionally, because he’s so loving, we do think Vlad may be good with older children, but likely only those that can understand a little nibble. 


Please reach out if you are interested in Vlad!

name: Julius
description_html:
Julius is so handsome, silly, and very sweet! When he arrived at AAS, he had a right femoral fracture, which was repaired with a pin, plate and screws. He then moved into a foster home for supportive care. He has made a complete recovery and has resumed normal activity without any issues.

Julius is playful, and gets along wonderfully with other cats. He loves the cats at his current foster home. He may be a little shy at first, but he warms up quickly and becomes a part of the home. He will do best in a quiet home with another cat buddy. He loves being petted, and is a huge purr machine.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Julius and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Goody
description_html: Super sweet boy. Loves baby talk and being called a handsome man. He is easy to walk and harness, might not even need a harness. Slightly dog reactive but not in a way he can't have his focus redirected. He is also very vocal! He is a screamer but mostly whenever his neighbors are getting taken out for walks - so he might just be barrier reactive out of jealousy.

name: Ferrell
description_html:
This is Ferrell, he's only about 1 year old so he's still a puppy, yet at such a young age such a smart boy eager and able to go potty outdoors ! He's very affectionate and absolutely loves to cuddle, always energetic as well and not afraid to jump into some water!
This little guy is very smart and loving, gets along with other dogs in the house and isn't a picky eater at all! Also worth noting he does good in car rides! 
If you're looking for a companion that will always have the energy to play with you at the park, accompany you on a small hike, or cuddle with you all night long then Ferrell is the perfect dog for you!

name: Mercy
description_html:
Mercy is a sweet, affectionate young dog with a huge zest for life. She loves people, loves being petted, and has been described by shelter staff as friendly with everyone she meets. She also walks beautifully on leash, making her a great candidate for an active family who wants a companion for daily adventures. 

Mercy is also very social with other dogs. When she first entered shelter playgroup, she greeted with happy tail wags and play bows and jumped right into fun, puppyish play. She’ll likely do great in a home with a well-matched canine companion—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dog(s)!

At heart, Mercy is a friendly, playful, people-loving girl who is ready for a chance to decompress outside the shelter and show off her best self. If you’re looking for an affectionate, joyful companion with plenty of personality, come meet Mercy.

name: Chico
description_html:
Chico brings an impressive résumé of home experience! He has lived with dogs both big and small as well as a cat. He has been described as friendly with adults, children, visitors, and other animals.


Chico is house-trained and comfortable in a crate—he routinely stayed there while his family was away and slept there overnight. He knows 'sit' and has a long list of favorite activities, including fetch, tug-of-war, chase, walks, and chewing on bones. After the fun is over, he is happiest getting plenty of attention from his people.


Chico has also enjoyed playing with other dogs in shelter playgroup and may be a great candidate for a multi-pet home. Ask shelter staff about arranging a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs to make sure everyone’s play styles are a good match!


Chico can pull when he is excited and is frightened by thunderstorms, fireworks, gunshots, and other loud noises. A cozy retreat during storms—and a family ready for plenty of play and attention—would make him very happy.

name: Opal
description_html:
Hi, I'm Opal!


I arrived to the shelter needing a helping hand and a place to stay for a fresh start in life. I'm in a great foster home now where I found other fur friends, small and big, and we like to kick up together, and lay down together. I love having friends.


Don't let anyone tell you my age is a barrier - I'm here to prove my spirit and will, I have a lot of life left to give. I'm a joyful lady. You know what else? I'm a healthy lady too. My people say I qualify for a little nip and tuck of my girly parts and then I'll be ready for 'doption. That means I could be coming your way soon.


See my short introduction video here in the shelter before my big makeover. Now I feel so liberated. I'm nice and cool for the summer weather.


See you soon?

name: Lana
description_html:
Lana is a sweet and calm companion with a big heart for her people. She loves pets and is happy to lay nearby as you go about your routine. But get her in a playful mood, and she has a goofy side too! She never looks happier than when she’s chasing squirrels around the yard, and her soft ears perk up watching them in the trees - those pesky critters!


Lana is a smart girl who picks up commands quickly. She already knows sit and shake (paw), and is learning stay and come. She is house trained, respects the home, and does well with long periods alone - especially with a frozen Kong! She walks beautifully on the leash without tugging, but can get excited when she sees other dogs. 


While incredibly sweet and loyal with her known humans, Lana is still learning how to trust new people. She is curious about some house guests but mostly wants to observe from a safe distance. She has built a lot of confidence in a short time since coming into her foster home. A patient and loving adopter could help her blossom even more!

name: Princess
description_html:
Princess is a sweet girl ready to rule your heart! She deserves the royal treatment (but is actually pretty low-maintenance), which to her means plenty of cuddles and affection. She has the most radiant, happy smile and a beautiful coat.

Princess strikes the perfect balance of being easygoing around the house while still showing off a charming, playful side. She is highly treat-motivated and already knows how to "sit" perfectly. This smart pup is eager to learn even more tricks in exchange for her favorite snacks. Ready to add some charm to your life? Princess is the one!

name: Moose
description_html: Meet Moose, a two-year-old gray brindle pitbull with a zest for life that's contagious! Moose is the kind of dog who finds joy in everything—especially his toys, which he absolutely adores. Moose is sweet to his core and already knows "sit," showing he's eager to learn and please the people he loves. An active family or individual who enjoys playtime, training, and maybe a game of fetch will find in Moose not just an energetic sidekick, but a loyal, affectionate friend ready to make every day a little more fun.

name: Ivy
description_html:
Meet Ivy: A Sweet, Loving Companion 🌿

Ivy is a gentle, affectionate girl who thrives on companionship. She walks nicely on a loose leash, is impressively responsive to her name when called, and loves napping while cuddled up with you on the couch.

She enjoys walks in nature and taking in all the sights and smells. Ivy is curious about squirrels (she’ll happily pause to watch them in a tree) but with a little encouragement or a treat, she’s easy to redirect and continue on her walk.

Ivy gets along well with other dogs, greeting them politely and enjoying relaxed, friendly interactions. She’s also courteous and calm indoors, making her easy to live with in almost any setting.

Ivy can be a bit sensitive to loud or new noises, but reassurance from her person quickly settles her. She's housetrained, well-behaved indoors, and respects boundaries unless invited onto furniture. Smart and intuitive, it seems that she would learn a routine quickly.

Ivy’s previous family was heartbroken to have to surrender her due to breed restrictions at their new apartment—through no fault of her own. Now she’s looking for a forever home that will appreciate her love, intelligence, and cuddly personality.


Ideal Home: Ivy would thrive in a household with adults, teens, and/or another compatible dog. She’s ready for adventures, walks, treats, and most importantly, endless cuddles.

name: Lando
description_html:
Lando has a soft face and an even softer personality. This gentle boy has a gentle charm that makes you want to hug him right away. 

 Lando is a cuddly sweetheart who loves being close to his people. He enjoys squeaky toys and playtime in the yard, though fetch isn't really his thing. On walks he’s usually a loose-leash walker, with the occasional excitement to hurry and sniff something interesting. 

 Lando can be a little timid with loud noises and appreciates slow, gentle introductions. Once he’s comfortable, his loving and playful side shines. 

 If you're looking for a cuddly best friend with a playful streak, Lando is your guy!

name: Latke
description_html:
