Latke has a heart full of love and a smile that will light up any room. He loves his friends deeply and is always ready to cuddle up close or get a good belly rub. Latke runs with joy in a yard and enjoys hopping in a pool to cool off in the summer heat. He is also an A+ car passenger! Latke has shown us at the shelter that he can romp and play with a well matched dog buddy.

While Latke has a lot of love and joy deep inside, the stress of living in the shelter environment is taking its toll on both his body and his sensitive soul. Latke needs a lifeline - a soft place to land with someone who will show him what love and stability look like. Latke comes with the full support of the volunteer team Orange Dot Crew who are ready to help him succeed in his forever home. To learn more about Latke or schedule a time to meet this big lovable boy, reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com.

name: Ramon
description_html:
Ramon is a golden-hearted pup who’s ready to be your new best friend! With his radiant cream-colored coat and a smile that lights up, Ramon is the perfect blend of athletic energy and gentle companionship.

Ramon has a playful spirit; he’s always up for toy time or a backyard romp. He is also a total gentleman when it’s time to hit the pavement; Ramon walks great on a leash, making every morning stroll a joy.

Above all, Ramon is defined by his sweet, affectionate nature. Whether he’s giving soft nudges for head scratches or wagging his tail in greeting, his goal is simple: to love and be loved. If you’re looking for a loyal, well-mannered partner for life’s adventures, Ramon is your guy!

name: Abner
description_html:
Abner is a handsome and sweet dog who is ready to steal your heart! This stunning boy has a truly unforgettable look, thanks to his striking eyes—one bright blue and one warm brown. His unique gaze perfectly matches his wonderful personality. 

On a walk, Abner is a dream, demonstrating excellent manners and staying easy on the leash. When it's time to play, he's energetic and engaging, but he settles down just as quickly for some quality snuggle time. Above all, Abner is affectionate and believes there is no problem a good, long belly rub can't solve. If you're looking for a playful, loving companion with an undeniably captivating look, Abner is the perfect match!


Interested in Abner? Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Sweet Pea
description_html:
Meet Sweet Pea

This cuddler and a charmer is home tested and has all the important skills expected of a mature lady, She's loving, attentive, very housetrained, mannered, rides well in the car. At less than 60 lbs she's smaller statured. She's spayed and ready to go home right away. .


Sweet Pea prefers not to cohabitate with other pets. Sweet Pea has had some past traumas and being in close proximity to other dogs at the shelter has been very unnerving for her. An ideal setting will be with a loving family in a home setting where she can find her zen. She's so ready for that. Are you ready to meet this pretty lady? Sweet Pea is advocated for by the orangedotcrew@gmail.com - reach out with questions or come by to meet her.

name: Tonka
description_html:
Tonka: The Noise‑Proof Pool Champion With a Best Friend Named Beef

Tonka is a pure bundle of joy who loves everything life has to offer — toys, walks and especially splashing in the pool . If you’re looking for a dog who will happily dive into summer with you, Tonka is ready for you.


One thing that makes Tonka truly special is his superpower: he’s deaf . Being deaf helps him stay calm and happy in loud environments. Because he doesn’t get overwhelmed by sound, Tonka is the ultimate companion for noisy fun — outdoor concerts, farmer’s markets, bustling patios, and even sporting events. He’s already known to rock a football jersey, so imagine him as your adorable, unbothered sideline buddy.

Tonka has excellent patio manners and farmer’s market manners — he never steals food, only hearts . He’s housetrained, leash‑trained, loves car rides, loves toys, and absolutely loves the water .

He’s also a social sweetheart: curious about dogs but never pushy, happy to befriend any pup who’s willing, and he’d truly benefit from having a furry sibling at home . And he already has a favorite friend at the shelter — Beef, Pet ID 11791 — a playful, housetrained, fetch‑loving goofball who enjoys the company of other dogs and does great in playgroups . Tonka and Beef would make an incredible duo if someone wanted to adopt a pair of joyful, social pups. During his overnight stay volunteers noted he “did so so good,” adapting quickly to a new home and enjoying outings without any stress from the noise around him .


Tonka communicates through hand signals and visual cues, just like other deaf dogs, and lives life exactly the same — just with bonus charm and focus . He’s smart, attentive, and even recognizes his name in writing, making him a proud ambassador for Tonka truck toys.


If you’re looking for a dog who’s equal parts fun, clever, adaptable, water‑obsessed, noise‑proof, and heart‑melting, Tonka is ready to be your new best friend.


For more info, reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com.

name: Whitley
description_html:
Whitley is a sweet and adorable girl who is full of love and energy! She's friendly with everyone she meets and adores being close to her humans, cuddling up whenever she can.

She loves playing fetch, chasing toys, and showing off her incredible zoomies. A yard or an active adopter would be a dream for her. She also has the potential to share her forever home with a dog sibling.

Whitley was being cared for by our medical team for the beginning of her stay with us, so we think this petite lady was just overlooked! But now she's happy, healthy, and ready to start her life and leave her kennel behind.

If you have any questions, please reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com to kickstart this heartwarming journey. For more delightful updates, follow Orange Dot Crew on Facebook and Instagram.

name: Walter
description_html: Meet Walter! Looking for the ultimate cuddle buddy? Walter is your guy! This sweet, gentle boy is the biggest lap dog you'll ever meet-he'll happily trade playtime for snuggles any day. Walter is a dream on the leash, making walks calm and easy, and he absolutely adores spending time with his volunteer friends. With his loving nature and gentle heart, Walter is ready to bring joy and comfort to a forever home. He's the kind of dog who will always be by your side, whether you're out for a stroll or curled up on the couch. Whoever gets to love Walter is going to be one very lucky person!

name: Shelley
description_html: If you want your next pup to teach you calculus, coach you for your next marathon, and provide customized emotional support, look no further than Shelley! She has the personality, charm, good looks, and effervescent energy of ten dogs, and she can't wait to show you all her antics and share her cuddles with you. She'll greet you each day with a winning smile and teach you all the fun games she invents with her toys. She is an energetic bundle of joy wrapped in the cutest multicolored freckles you have ever seen! Don't sleep on Shelley; she is a dream of a dog!

name: Oscar
description_html:
Oscar, with his handsome brindle coat, is a sweet boy with a love for adventure! This pup thrives on exploration, whether he's hitting the trails, engaging in puzzle toys, or sniffing out new scents and romping around on walks. Oscar also loves kongs, squeaky toys, and squirrel watching through the window!

Oscar is a playful and loyal dog, ready for his forever home and someone or a family who can help him build his confidence through fun new experiences. He may be a little shy with unfamiliar things, but that quickly melts away with a few delicious treats and a dose of love. He'll soon be cuddling up with you, ready to be your devoted best friend!  


Interested in Oscar? Reach out to blueplusbusters@gmail.com for more info!

name: Dandelion
description_html:
Dandelion is a playful, affectionate, and downright joyful companion. At two years old, this cuddlebug and zoomie enthusiast is soaking up every bit of life on the outside—and he’s ready to share it all with his forever family.

Dandy is a social pup who loves chasing balls, splashing in a kiddie pool, going for walks, and tagging along on whatever adventure the day brings. When it’s time to relax, he’s all about the snuggles—curling up beside you and soaking in the love like it’s his favorite treat.

He gets along well with other dogs and is doing wonderfully with potty training, going up to 8 hours accident-free during the day and even longer overnight. He sleeps soundly on a couch, dog bed, or right next to you if invited.

Dandelion walks beautifully on a harness and shorter leash, exploring the world at your side with curiosity and calm. He’s smart, eager to engage, and channels his energy into all the right things—like enrichment toys, frozen carrots, stuffed Kongs, Chuck-It balls, and durable chews. He redirects easily and is always up for learning.

Because of an old vocal cord injury, Dandy doesn’t bark loudly—but he makes up for it with happy wiggles, soulful eyes, and gentle energy that speaks volumes. He’ll thrive with continued consistency, love, and either leashed adventures or a secure yard to safely enjoy the outdoors.

Dandelion is that rare blend of fun-loving and affectionate, making him the perfect hiking buddy, poolside pal, and loyal snuggle partner. He’s bloomed beautifully—now all he needs is a home where he can keep growing, loved and safe.


If you have any questions, please reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com to kickstart this heartwarming journey. For more delightful updates, follow Orange Dot Crew on Facebook and Instagram.

name: Francis
description_html: Francis is a sweet, quiet boy who is still warming up to people but — once he gets comfortable with you — has the sweetest purr. He's currently being treated for an eye infection but should be ready for adoption in September! 🐾

name: Jefferson
description_html:
Jefferson is a laid-back, silly guy who enjoys taking life at a leisurely pace. He’s a fantastic walking companion if you prefer a slow stroll over a cardio workout! Jefferson is an excellent loose-leash walker and happily clips in and goes, with no pulling or reactivity toward people or other dogs.


He loves taking his time to sniff and explore, and he seems perfectly content entertaining himself in the yard. At the same time, he’s interested in interacting with his people and has a playful, comedic personality that is sure to make you smile. He’s calm and relaxed in his kennel and appears to be housetrained, too.


Jefferson could be a great fit for a variety of homes, including an apartment or condo, as long as he gets regular leisurely strolls and opportunities to explore. If you’re looking for an independent, easygoing companion with a goofy side, Jefferson might be your guy!

name: B.B.
description_html:
Meet BB — the curious, confident little explorer of the litter.


BB was born to Salem, our beloved backyard community cat, and we have cared for him since the very day he was born. From the start, BB has had a spark about him. He is adventurous, observant, and always the first to investigate something new. He looks at you with these knowing little eyes, like he fully understands what is going on and has a few opinions about it.


BB is sweet, gentle, litter box trained, and very comfortable with people. He has a playful, leader-of-the-pack personality and loves trying new things, exploring his surroundings, and being part of whatever is happening. He is also a little talkative and will happily “talk back” when you speak to him, which makes him feel more like a tiny roommate than just a cat.


He is one of those kittens who is impossible not to get attached to. BB King has been one of our favorites in the litter because he has so much personality, confidence, and charm. He is fixed, vaccinated, and ready for his forever home.


BB deserves a wonderful home where he can be loved, spoiled, explored with, and appreciated for the special little cat he is.

name: Kai
description_html:
Kai is a sweet, sensitive girl who just needs a little time, patience, and kindness to show you her true self. When she first arrived in foster care, she was shy and unsure, but watching her blossom into a loving companion has been incredibly rewarding. 💕

Once Kai feels comfortable, she becomes your quiet little shadow - happily following her person around, relaxing nearby on the couch, and soaking up gentle pets and affection. She has a calm, peaceful presence and a soft personality that makes her a wonderful companion.

Kai is looking for a special adopter who understands that the best friendships aren't rushed - they're built one small moment of trust at a time. In return, she will reward your patience with loyalty, affection, and a whole lot of love.

If you're searching for a gentle companion who will remind you that the sweetest bonds are the ones we earn, Kai may be the perfect match for you. 🐾❤️

name: Baby Girl
description_html:
Meet Baby Girl — a sweet, goofy girl with a playful spirit and a heart full of love. She’s dog-friendly, crate trained, and house trained, making her a wonderful companion for a variety of homes. Baby Girl loves to play, cuddle, and soak up affection — she truly loves love.

She may take a minute to warm up to new people, but once she does, she’ll be your biggest fan, showering you with loyalty and affection. In her previous home, she lived with a smaller dog and absolutely loved having a buddy to play with.

Baby Girl’s past wasn’t always kind — she was left outside alone for long periods until a caring neighbor stepped in to help her. Despite that, she’s remained gentle, loving, and full of joy. Now, she’s ready for a forever home where she can feel safe, cherished, and included.

If you’re looking for a cuddly, playful companion who will blossom into a devoted best friend, Baby Girl might just be your perfect match.

name: Maxine
description_html:
Maxine = Perfection!


Hi! I am Maxine. I thought I would take the time to write my bio, since I am looking for my forever home - even though I love my current house with my big Boxer sister. I want to start off by saying I love the company of other dogs! I don’t know if I have been around cats before, so I cannot tell you if I get along with them or not. I am super friendly and have very good manners when I am playing. You’d think since I am so young that I would have endless energy, but I actually like lounging around – preferably sitting in your lap, chewing on my bones, or sunbathing outside. That is not to say I don’t play – check me out on my profile videos - but I am mostly very laid back. That is…until you mention “walk”. I cannot contain myself! I run around, grab my toys, run into my fur sister, grab my mom’s shoe, and spin around. Now, I do calm down once we actually get to the door, but until then, I am just so excited! If you like easy walkers, then I am your girl. I am a very loose leash walker and not reactive to other dogs. But, those little lizards….that’s another story! If I do see one, all you have to do is say my name and I refocus and leave them alone - just be sure to hold tight to my leash!

I love my squeaky toys, treats, and water! I am a total water baby. My foster mom bought me a pool and I love it – if you don’t believe me – check out the video of me in my pool! I am extremely house trained and to this day have not torn anything up – including my toys! I am a very quick learner and very polite! I am not a frequent barker, don’t seem to show any signs of separation anxiety, and loud noises don’t seem to bother me. Really, no red flags at all, which means that I am the perfect pup for you!

I do take a little bit of time to warm up to people, especially if it is more than one person at a time. So any introduction needs to be slow and I need to be given enough space to feel everything out. But, once I am all warmed up, be prepared for me to sit perched in your lap! Treats are a pretty good motivator to warm me up as well!

Let me know if you would like to meet up! 


When she was in the shelter, she was a volunteer favorite, and her friends try to get all the other volunteers to meet her because "everyone should get to experience the absolute sweet, gentle, and kind love that will melt your heart from this girl".


Maxine is spayed, heartworm negative, and ready for adoption today!

name: Vittorio
description_html:
Vittorio is a compact model of love and charm that comes equipped with extra peripheral vision. He knows a thing or two about keeping a tidy house, as he keeps his kennel clean and seems house trained. While he may look worried, that's just him waiting to see if his attempts at telepathy are working--he wants to read your mind, share his own ideas with you, and make you happy! He can't wait to show you he's the goodest boy who loves back scratches, playing fetch, and walks with you on the other end of his leash!


Interested in Vittorio? Reach out to his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Daisy
description_html:
Thelma was found running in the busy road right outside of the shelter. Thankfully she was caught before anything happened to her, and she is now at Austin Animal Services!


Thelma may give a few barks when you walk by her kennel but once that gate is open she can’t get into your lap fast enough! If you are looking for a cuddle bug then this is your girl!


💛 Sweetheart

💛 Cuddly

💛 Playful

💛 Great on Leash

💛 Treat Motivated

💛 Volunteer Favorite

name: Cheddar
description_html:
Cheddar is a sweet and playful girl whose gentle demeanor will fill your heart with joy. Cheddar is also incredibly playful and affectionate, loving to snuggle up next to her humans for pets and belly rubs!

She is great in the car and will sit calmly for the whole ride, leaning her head on you for reassuring pets.

She has happily shared her kennel with other dog friends, but after meeting a cat at a volunteer’s house, she did not seem comfortable around them. Come meet this sweet pup at the shelter—you won’t regret making her part of your family.

name: Chiquis
description_html:
If you’re looking for a dog who can make you laugh every single day, meet Chiquis — a tiny powerhouse with a HUGE zest for life. Volunteers describe her as a “busy lady” who would rather zoom, hop, and play than sit still for a photo. She loves toys, loves movement, and loves turning the play yard into her personal racetrack.


Chiquis has classic puppy-style enthusiasm: she can be a little jumpy when excited, but she responds well to redirection and absolutely thrives when given something fun to do. She’s sweet, playful, and people-oriented, and once she burns off a little energy, her softer side starts peeking through.


Because she’s new to the shelter, we’re still learning all her quirks — but what we know so far is that she’s spirited, silly, and ready for an adopter who appreciates a high-energy, toy-driven companion.


Chiquis would love a home with:

✔ Playtime, toys, and activities

✔ Positive training to help channel her enthusiasm

✔ Someone who appreciates an energetic, goofy pup


If you’re searching for a pocket-sized adventure buddy who brings joy everywhere she goes, come meet Chiquis — she’s ready to run right into her new life.

Interested in Chiquis? Reach out to blueplusbusters@gmail.com for more info!

name: Fritz
description_html:
Fritz is a marvel. He is an amazingly sweet, charismatic guy who brings good vibes everywhere he goes. Easygoing and well-adjusted, he rolls with whatever the day brings—walks, throwing a ball, being a patio dog, hanging with 10 book club girls —he is well behaved and adapts to wherever he is.


His foster has been doing consistent training with him. He’s super smart (and food motivated) and knows place, sit, down, heel and come. He's an easy walker and not reactive to dogs/bikes/cats/etc. People passing mention how well behaved (and handsome) he is.


He loves to run, play, be in water and do games around the house like finding hidden treats. But also chills and naps a lot. Loves to cuddle and have all of the soft things under his chin. 


He is great with kids and gently interacts with some as young as 18 months. He is always sweet with people. Great and friendly with dogs and could thrive with a buddy.


HIs foster is happy to answer any questions! And will be capturing some more varied content :)

name: Alfred
description_html: Alfred is a smart, active, and incredibly sweet boy who's eager to learn and loves having a job to do. He's fully housetrained, knows several words (especially "treat" and "food"), and will do just about anything for a piece of cheese. He can be a little shy when meeting new people, but once he warms up, he's loyal, affectionate, and very devoted. Alfred is social with other dogs, does well with cats, and enjoys playing fetch, zooming around the yard, and keeping watch from his favorite window. Athletic and graceful, Alfred runs like a gazelle but is just as happy soaking up ear scratches and butt rubs. With his brains, heart, and personality, he's ready to be a wonderful companion for the right family. 🐾

name: Phoenix
description_html:
Phoenix is a sweet, joyful boy with a heart full of love and curiosity. He’s been thriving in the play yard, where he enjoys long walks, sniffing everything around him, and splashing in the pool. Phoenix is a strong, energetic dog who loves keeping an eye on squirrels and birds, patrolling his surroundings with curiosity and excitement. He also absolutely loves playing fetch — a yard or outdoor space would be a huge benefit for him.

While not the cuddliest, Phoenix shows affection in his own way, giving gentle kisses and leaning into those moments when he wants attention. He’s easy to harness, eager to explore, and quickly warms up to people, radiating sweetness despite what seems to have been a difficult past. His face and fur are healing beautifully, and his resilient, happy nature shines through every interaction.

Phoenix is looking for a family who will celebrate his energy, patience, and loving spirit — someone who can give him space to run, sniff, and play while appreciating the gentle soul he is. Always smiling, Phoenix is truly a boy who leaves a lasting impression.

Ready for a rise through the adventure of life.

🌟Phoenix is also a celebrity after being featured on CBS Austin - check out his visit!

name: Toby
description_html:
🐾 Meet Toby

Some dogs make your life busier. Toby somehow makes it simpler.

Austin’s most eligible bachelor is a confident, social guy with big feelings who’s learning to chill. 🧡 He has a way of melting beside you at the end of the day that makes your shoulders drop, your phone stay face-down a little longer, and your couch feel like exactly where you’re supposed to be.

Life with Toby is mostly sniffaris, happy wiggles, periodic kisses, goofy stretches, and impressively deep naps. After growing up in the shelter, he’s discovering that home life can be wonderfully boring—and getting better at settling back down when his enthusiasm outruns his brakes.

💘 His type: a calm adult home with patient humans who appreciate a silly, affectionate dog with personality. All Toby really wants is someone to build an ordinary life with—and we have a feeling he’ll make it feel pretty extraordinary.

Click “Get Started” and we’ll plan your first date! 🐾

name: Jack
description_html:
Jack's had a challenging life. His people couldn't care for him, which brought him to the shelter about a dozen times over the years. Jack learned how to cope and tolerate life's storms. To say the least, he's resilient. He's great with all people, little and big. Jack is now looking for his forever home as a senior dog. We would like for him to finally have a chance at a regular dog's life. He deserves that.

His friends at ClassicCaninesATX are ready to help him, now we just need the person who wants to make a difference in this happy guys' life. Jack doesn't have to accept life laying down in a shelter - he can have a good life outside of the shelter walls, a time very well spent.

Jack loves people best, big families, little families, people of all ages. He's a champion snuggler and TV watcher and would love a spot simply hanging out in a living room. He's not a fan of cats at all but has some light dog experience and could work well with a calm, easy dog in the home- we can schedule a doggie meet up at the shelter.

Time is on the clock for Jack so don't miss out and don't skip over Jack if you're ready to help change a life forever more to give Jack the stable home life he's never had.

name: Misty
description_html:
Hi! Welcome to Misty's page, or as we like to call her: Mimi girl. While she's not at the shelter because we stole her away to foster, we live SUPER close to AAC and can drive over if that's the best location to have you meet her! Also, she's labeled as a "Husky", but she kind of looks like a cattle dog or a Podenco!


Mimi is a healthy 40lb pup, and we don't believe she'll grow much more than that. She's been an absolute joy to have in the house. Because she's a little under a year, she has that youthful, fun energy. But don't let the youthfulness scare you. While we all know dogs her age can be a handful, Mimi is the easiest foster dog our family has had. She's completely potty-trained, loves all dogs, has never met a human (child or adult) she doesn't like, does well in cars, can patiently enjoy your company at a coffee shop or bar... the list goes on and on. And get this... we've only ever heard her bark a total of 6 times - and only one small bark each time. It's a bit bizarre and we almost thought she didn't know how to!


To share a bit more about her personality, we can talk about how she does with our resident dog. We have a 150lb+ male dog who is pretty lazy given his size. At almost 5, he's mellowed out quite a bit but still has some energy. Mimi immediately recognized him as a friend. She has a ton of fun running around with him in our backyard, but once he doesn't want to play, she can read the room and runs off to play with sticks, insects, etc. Even indoors, Mimi doesn't need to constantly play with him. She adores toys and can entertain herself, but she loves her big brother.


In our home, we have two resident cats. Mimi is learning how to coexist with them, but it's not perfect yet. She doesn't understand that cats don't play the same as dogs, so she does try to chase. With time, we do think this can get better, but it will require someone who is patient with cat/dog socializing and has experience with it.


Mimi could do well alone without another dog, but we ask potential adopters to keep in mind that she is young and should have plenty of stimulation throughout the day. When we leave the house, we do put her in a crate, but this is only for 2-4hrs at a time. Mimi would love, love, love a home where she can have another dog friend or a home with kiddos. We promise she'd love them and cuddle with them (yes, she's a CUDDLER).


This is a fantastically gentle and fun girl. Let us know if you want to meet her so you can see it - you'll be glad you did!

name: Bruno
description_html:
Bruno is a happy, wiggly boy who's always ready for his next adventure! He has great leash manners and enjoys checking in with his person throughout walks, making him a fun and engaging companion. While he may occasionally get excited by squirrels or become a little jumpy in new situations, he's easily redirected with a few treat tosses and quickly gets back on track.


Smart, athletic, and highly treat motivated, Bruno would likely love learning new tricks or even trying agility. His playful personality shines through, and he enjoys meeting people and other dogs with friendly curiosity. He also loves being brushed and has a cuddly side once it's time to relax.


Bruno is looking for an active home that will enjoy exploring the world with him, continue his positive training, and appreciate his sweet, eager-to-please personality. If you're searching for a playful best friend with brains, heart, and lots of potential, Bruno is ready to meet you!

name: Princess Peach
description_html: Meet Princess Peach! She really wants you because she loves new friends. This girl enjoys walks, play time and cuddling with her friends, and if you give her a toy to carry around it will truly make her day! Princess Peach is housetrained and crate trained. She is adorable, fun, easy to walk and ignores cats and dogs. She's ready to take on the world with a toy in her mouth and a friend by her side, so say "hello" to this girl today!

name: Lil Baby Lou
description_html:
NOW HIRING: Full-Time Human Best Friend for Lil Baby Lou


Position Title: Human Companion, Couch Associate & Professional Snuggler


Salary: Unlimited love, daily laughs, and the privilege of sharing your couch with a 90-pound marshmallow.


About the Boss:

Meet Lil Baby Lou, an angelic gentleman weighing in at approximately 90 pounds of pure sweetness. While his size may suggest "linebacker," his personality is much more "oversized stuffed animal." Lou is essentially a giant marshmallow with legs—a soft-hearted cuddle expert who would happily list "snuggling" as both a hobby and a full-time career.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide couch space for evening cuddle sessions
  • Accept occasional use as a human pillow
  • Participate in leisurely car rides (Lou is an excellent passenger)
  • Receive affection from a dog who believes quality snuggle time is a critical life requirement
  • Allow Lou to demonstrate his advanced weighted blanket skills


Ideal Candidate Qualifications:

  • Enjoys sharing personal space with a very affectionate large dog
  • Appreciates quiet companionship and couch-based activities, with some daily walks or play time 
  • Can provide a pet-free workplace (Lou prefers to be your one and only furry friend) 


Professional References:

Lou comes highly recommended. Shelter volunteers absolutely adore him, and he recently completed a temporary foster placement with glowing reviews. During his foster stay, he proved himself to be:

  • Fully house trained
  • Polite and appropriate in the home
  • Able to stay in a crate when left alone at home
  • A respectful roommate who understood house manners


Housing Requirements:

Lou successfully lived in an apartment during foster care and handled apartment life like a pro. If apartment living is in the cards, having enough space to comfortably pass other dogs is important. Lou would prefer not to socialize with canine or feline coworkers and is seeking a position where he can be the sole recipient of your affection. He would also thrive in a home with a yard or daily walks! 


Employee Benefits Package:

  • Elite-level cuddle buddy services
  • Built-in emotional support
  • Heated weighted blanket functionality
  • Daily reminders that giant dogs have the gentlest hearts


To Apply:

If you've been searching for a best friend with the soul of a teddy bear, Lil Baby Lou would like to review your application immediately.

Please note: Acceptance of this position will result in a permanently occupied couch and a very full heart. To meet Lou, email his volunteer friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com

name: Canela
description_html: Canela has such a wonderful personality and is such a sweet girl. She’s playful and loves fetch with her stuffies (she’s pretty good at dropping them for you to toss too!). She also loves playing in the little puppy pools, and splashing around in them. She’s also very house trained! Once she works out her zoomies, she’s super easy on a leash. She’s a super cuddly young pup, and loves to lean against her human for pets and scratches.

name: Hendrix
description_html:
Hendrix is a two-year-old heartthrob with one goal in life: to love his person with his entire soul. He’s fully house-trained, incredibly smart, and very treat-motivated (which means training with him is basically just a snack-based friendship).


His favorite “job” at the shelter is visiting the real-life rooms on campus with volunteers, where he takes his snuggling very seriously. Couch? Claimed. Lap? Claimed. Emotional support duties? Nailed it. Hendrix doesn’t just cuddle — he commits.


This boy is affectionate, gentle, and deeply people-oriented. He’s the kind of dog who looks at you like you’re his whole world… because you are. Once Hendrix picks his person, that’s it — you’ve found your soul dog.


If you’re searching for a loyal best friend, a professional snuggler, and a dog who will love you harder than you thought possible, Hendrix is ready and waiting. Email orangedotcrew@gmail.com to learn more and kickstart this heartwarming journey! For more pupdates, follow Orange Dot Crew on Facebook and Instagram.

name: Fendi
description_html:
Fendi just wants to know one thing? If she moves in, can she bring her babies? She's one of our very sweet Classic lady dogs looking for a loving home and she's under 40lbs and will CHARM you with her personal skills. She loves her foster mommy but daddy takes the CAKE!

Very housetrained

Self-managing alone

Great household manners

A cuddler

Low shedder

Healthy, spayed and vaxxed


Fendi can be a tenderoni when it comes to boisterous, loud dogs over her energy level. If she may have a dog friend she requests they be calm and non-scary, like her. We'll be happy to help coordinate a doggie meet and greet at the shelter.

To ask about Fendi, or to meet her, apply on her link.


See her short video here and here

name: Marina
description_html:
Meet Marina

You'll love Marina - she's sweet, sensitive, a cuddler, a player, a great all around companion. She's thrived in a multi-dog home, and in a home with just one other dog.

She's a great size and nice middle age of wisdom - you can take her just about everywhere but she also stays home alone very well.

Marina is being treated for a touch of anemia and will soon be healthy again if you don't mind waiting just a bit, we'll get it sorted out. Her advocates at ClassicCaninesATX are helping her meet her health goals. To learn more contact caring@classiccanines.org

name: Bunny
description_html:
Meet Bunny

This sweet lady came to the shelter in urgent need of safety and care. She came from a tough situation and her condition was rough. She's spent the last few months on an amazing journey back to wellness, and to increased mobility. Bunny can now do everything that dogs do - besides being a great guest at home, she's house trained, she enjoys a little yard time and sunshine on her face. Short walks for exercise help her muscle strength. She's also a fish while guided in a swimming pool. She gives and receives so many affections. She's earned a reputation as a lap dog.


Bunny has a condition that makes her wobbly and unsteady on her feet, but she is aided by standard traction helpers like rugs, mats and being on flat surfaces when outdoors. Her Help Em Up harness also makes things a whole lot easier to guide her when needed. Bunny will do best in a single story arrangement as an only animal in her home.


Bunny's care includes occasional skin and eye management, and keeping her muscles in good tone. Her advocates at ClassicCaninesATX have been providing her care at an outside clinic and will help with supplies and some future veterinary care funding for an adopter.


Are you ready to make a difference in the life of a lady that has come this far already to prepare to meet you? Are you the person who will welcome her to unconditional forever love? Put her on your short list - and reach out on her link to talk with her foster provider or contact caring@classiccanines.org with questions about adoption support.


Watch her Pet of the Week highlight here!


See portions of Bunny's journey over the past few months here and here

name: Hero
description_html: Meet Hero, a gentle giant with a heart full of love! This big boy is a sweet and affectionate pup who just wants to be loved. While he can be a little timid at first, he is incredibly gentle and eager to please. Once he opens up, he is the ultimate cuddle companion, happily curling up on the couch for some quality snuggle time. He also has a playful side and likes to explore new toys. His curiosity makes every walk an adventure, as he takes in all the sights and smells around him. Despite his initial shyness, Hero is a quick learner and always ready to impress. He has already mastered "sit" and "stay" before meals, showing just how smart and willing he is to learn. He thrives on patience and kindness, and his confidence continues to grow every day. Whether he's out exploring or lounging at home, he is the perfect balance of playful and affectionate. If you're looking for a loyal, loving companion with a gentle soul, Hero is ready to steal your heart!

name: River
description_html: River showed up at the home of a nice person who gave her a chance indoors and she blossomed. While she may be shy in a kennel, she is lovable and affectionate in the home. She has a cute little void face and big eyes that blink slowly when we chat with her. She may do well with a cat friend (as most cats who come from outdoors do). River is looking for a calm place to relax and show her true self.

name: Bruce
description_html:
Looking to add more joy, presence, and sunshine to your life?

Then it’s time to stop and smell the roses… and meet Bruce!

Welcome to the wonderful world of Bruce — a place where belly rubs are currency, fetch is a national sport, and love is always in the air. To enter, you’ll need just a few essentials:

✔️ Hands for belly rubs

✔️ A hose to spray him with

✔️ A pocket full of treats (because Bruce is a firm believer in snack-based diplomacy)

Bruce is a handsome, high-energy guy who’s all about his people and living life to the fullest. Whether it’s hiking trails, exploring new parks, or just being your co-pilot for the everyday moments, Bruce is always up for the ride. He’s dog-selective, so slow intros or a solo-pet home may be best—but when it comes to humans, he’s all in.

Bruce is such a sweetheart! Bruce is a Very GOOD Boy who deserves all the best things that life can offer. He deserves a family. He deserves happiness.

If you’re searching for a loyal sidekick, an enthusiastic adventure buddy, and a reason to smile every day, Bruce might just be your perfect match. Come join Bruce World—it’s full of tail wags, playful zoomies, and unconditional love!

name: Mistletoe
description_html:
Mistletoe is looking for a patient human who is very experienced with cats! She was living in an unsafe environment, and she and several other kittens (including Pinecone) were rescued and brought to AAS.

Not yet comfortable with people, Mistletoe will need lots of time to adjust to a new household. She is very scared in the shelter, so we would LOVE to see her out of the kennel, either through adoption or foster.

Mistletoe is wonderful with other cats, and needs to have a cat buddy in her quiet home, someone she can play and cuddle with.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Mistletoe and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Teddy Bear
description_html:
He's well rounded, smart, wise, relaxed about life, and listens well. He's perfectly house trained and stays home alone well for long hours with his favorite independent activities, playing and napping with his toys. He loves affections when you are ready to dish them out and he's not demanding or pushy for them, he'll wait until your free. He's healthy too and just an overall easy dog to manage in a home.


Do you like the company of a dog to ride along for quick trips? He absolutely adores that - burgers, coffee runs and more.


Here's a couple things that really sing to his heart;

A home with a fenced yard, or if no yard, peaceful walks

He loves the peace of being an only pet but if you have a resident dog and would like to see how they hit it off, we're happy to schedule a dog meetup at the shelter.


Teddy's the kind of guy who's there for you through thick and thin, and without requiring a lot of fuss and over sight. Why not give him a try? Foster trial to adopt is an option too.


His adoption comes with extra support for a fresh stash of toys and a future vet care credit so he's easy to get established into a new home, all from his advocates at ClassicCaninesATX


He can't wait to meet you! Inquire on his link to speak with his foster about what he can do for you or write caring@classiccanines.org

Don't let this one slip by!

name: Gotham
description_html:
Gotham is a beautiful pup with his sleek dark coat, perky ears, and striking eyes—he’s guaranteed to turn heads everywhere he goes.

Despite his heroic name, Gotham isn't here to fight crime; he’s just here to steal your heart. He’s a friendly, energetic, and intelligent boy who loves playing with toys, learning new tricks, and going on adventures. After a fun session in the yard, he’s more than ready to shower you with happy smiles and affection.

Ready to meet your new superhero? Adopt or foster Gotham today!

name: Stax
description_html:
Meet Stax. He is the kind of dog who makes a house feel more like home. Whether he’s supervising dinner from the kitchen floor, watching birds from the window, carrying sticks through the snow, or resting his head on a pillow for an afternoon nap, he simply loves being part of everyday life. He has an expressive face, an infectious smile, and a goofy streak that shines through in everything from enthusiastic toy de-stuffing sessions to joyful backyard zoomies.

Life in foster homes has shown just how naturally Stax settles into a routine. He’s house-trained, sleeps through the night, rides well in the car, and is content to relax while his people work or tackle chores. He’s also bright and eager to learn—he picked up “shake” in just a few minutes—and always appreciates earning a tasty reward. Whether you’re heading out for an adventure or enjoying a quiet evening at home, Stax is happiest when he gets to come along for the ride.

Stax has spent far too long waiting for a family, but that hasn’t stopped him from forming meaningful connections everywhere he goes. He’s shared his foster homes with respectful children, happily welcomed affection, and charmed everyone from neighbors to houseguests with his warm personality. Like any dog, he’ll appreciate patient introductions to new experiences, but once he feels at home, his true personality shines: loyal, affectionate, funny, and endlessly endearing.

If you’re looking for a best friend who will make you laugh, join you on adventures, and then happily curl up nearby at the end of the day, Stax is ready to fill that role.

name: Meshe
description_html:
Meshe is a fun loving girl. She has the best smile that'll brighten your day! Meshe did very well in her foster home. She loved cuddling with her foster mom and her foster sibling. She likes to sleep a lot!

Meshe loves playing with squeaky toys and chewing on elk antlers, but is definitely not a fan of small animals. So, she'd be best with dog only families and no cats or rabbits. Reach out to the behavior team to set up a meet and greet with your dog(s) today.

Meshe also enjoys outings and car rides. She behaves well in the car, happily lying in the backseat, looking out the window.

Meshe would be a great hiking buddy. She really enjoys a good adventure! Her only hang up is no water sports. She's content to run around with her toys instead.

Meshe is a long stay pup that been fortunate to be living in a foster home these past 2 years, but her wish would be to find a loving, forever home with another dog to play with. Meshe is a cuddler and would love to snuggle next to you in bed. She truly is a joy to be around. Meshe will make you laugh and steal your heart.

name: Josie Rosie
description_html: Meet Josie Rosie, an active tripod girl who would love to be a part of your family!

name: Sushi
description_html: Sushi is shy to open up, but once she does, she's a lovebug! She's a great mix of cuddler and independent. For some parts of the day she likes to hide/do her own thing, but generally when I'm home, she's interactive. She's one of my favorite fosters ever!!! A great kitty. LOVES to eat. Likes to play too!
